title: Blog Content Coordinator (Philippines Only)
description:
You may apply using this link: 

 

About Us



Ylopo, LLC is a rapidly growing marketing and technology company providing internet marketing services and proprietary lead generation and engagement software to successful real estate agents across the country. We are seeking an outgoing, tech savvy individual to join our growing team.

 

Why work for Ylopo?



At Ylopo we offer team members:



a commitment to personal development,



guidance and support at a high level through interfacing with our Executive Team to prioritize goals as a company,



excellent leadership and mentoring for our entry-level to senior staff, and recognition of outstanding efforts,



team building events, team lunches/ happy hours, and other company wide events



a supportive, caring environment dedicated to continuous learning and growth.



The Blog Content Coordinator supports the production and publishing of engaging blog and video content. This role is responsible for transforming selected blog content into visually appealing assets and AI-generated videos using tools such as ChatGPT and HeyGen, while ensuring that the final output meets quality and presentation standards. The ideal candidate is highly organized, has a good eye for design and video quality, and understands the fundamentals of effective digital content. They should be able to recognize when an AI-generated video looks or sounds unnatural and identify issues such as mispronunciations, awkward movements, unusual sounds, or other inconsistencies before the content moves forward for review and publishing. While this is not a client-facing role, the position requires decent English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with writers and other members of the content team. 

 

Responsibilities: 



Content Asset Creation  

● Receive the blog post selected for daily production from the Blog and Content Writer.

● Use ChatGPT and other approved tools to create or support the creation of thumbnails and visual assets for blog content. 

● Add approved thumbnails and visual assets to the corresponding blog post. 

● Ensure visual elements are relevant, appealing, and aligned with the content.

  

AI Video Production  

● Prepare blog content for conversion into AI-generated video content. 

● Use HeyGen to create videos based on approved blog content and scripts. 

● Develop a strong understanding of what makes AI-generated videos look and sound polished rather than overly artificial or robotic. 

● Troubleshoot basic issues encountered during the video generation process.

 

Quality Assurance  

● Conduct an initial quality check of AI-generated videos before they are submitted for review. 

● Identify and flag issues such as: 

     ○ Mispronunciations 

     ○ Incorrect or awkward delivery 

    ○ Unnatural facial expressions or movements 

    ○ Strange sounds or audio issues 

    ○ Visual inconsistencies 

   ○ Robotic or overly AI-generated presentation 

   ○ Other quality concerns that may affect the viewer experience 

● Reprocess or adjust content when possible to improve the quality of the final output. 

● Escalate significant technical or quality issues to the appropriate team member.



 

Content Workflow Coordination 

● Maintain an organized workflow and track the status of assigned blog and video content. 

● Ensure content moves efficiently through each stage of production.   

● Coordinate with the Blog and Content Writer regarding completed videos, issues requiring review, and revisions. 

● Maintain accurate records of completed, pending, and revised content. 

● Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency and quality of the content production process. 

 

Qualifications

 

Required

● Strong organizational and time-management skills. 

● Good eye for design, visual presentation, and content quality. 

● Comfortable working with AI tools such as ChatGPT and HeyGen or similar platforms. 

● Basic understanding of digital content and what makes videos engaging and visually appealing. 

● Ability to identify unnatural or low-quality AI-generated video and audio output. 

● Decent written and verbal English communication skills. 

● Strong attention to detail. 

● Ability to follow established processes and manage recurring daily tasks. 

● Comfortable working independently in a remote environment. 

● Ability to work the required 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time schedule. 



Preferred 

● Experience working with blogs, digital content, or content management systems. 

● Experience creating thumbnails, graphics, or other digital visual assets. 

● Familiarity with social media content and video formats. 

● Experience creating, editing, scheduling, or publishing video content. 

● Familiarity with platforms such as
, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, or other social media channels. 

● Previous experience using AI-powered content creation tools. 



System Requirements:

Processor should be 2 ghz and above, Intel core 5/7 or equal is highly required

MUST have the latest Operating System

      Windows 11 64bit

      Mac Ventura / Sonoma

16GB with 100GB Free disk space

MUST have a back-up Computer with the same specs as the main device

A Headset with noise cancelling feature is a must

20 mbps minimum wired connection for main isp

Back up internet is a must (pocket wifi, prepaid wifi etc. but strictly no USB Sticks allowed)

Back up power source





Shift Schedule: 9AM - 6PM Pacific Standard

Rate: starts at Php 40,000

title: Virtual Senior Accountant / Bookkeeper (US Real Estate & Healthcare Operations)
description:
We are seeking a highly autonomous, top-tier Senior Multi-Entity Bookkeeper & Finance Specialist to manage the financial architecture of a fast-growing, diverse portfolio. This role oversees the financial operations of multiple distinct entities, including a busy medical clinic practice and an extensive real estate portfolio spanning commercial and residential properties in Arizona and Iowa.

We are specifically looking for a tech-forward, proactive professional who doesn't just manage data manually but leverages modern AI, data pipelines, and automation tools to optimize workflows and reduce manual overhead. You will be responsible for bringing our books to a strict, tax-ready close for our external US CPA firm while driving financial clarity for leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Multi-Entity Accounting: Maintain separate, pristine ledgers for multiple legal entities across healthcare operations and various real estate holding companies. Handle intricate intercompany transactions ("due to/due from" clearing accounts) without blending funds.

Healthcare Revenue & Operations: Reconcile medical billing, insurance payouts, and payer reimbursements against clinic software records. Maintain high attention to detail regarding healthcare revenue cycles.

Real Estate Portfolio Tracking: Monitor tenant ledgers, security deposits, mortgage liabilities, CapEx (capital improvements), depreciation schedules, and escrow accounts for multi-state properties. Track state-specific property tax and insurance deadlines.

Payroll & System Integration: Partner with our third-party payroll provider (ADP). Extract payroll journals, properly map gross wages, employer taxes, and deductions, and post accurate sync entries into QuickBooks Online.

AI & Automation Workflow Design: Actively implement and manage automated receipt/invoice pipelines (e.g., Dext, Hubdoc, QBO Receipts) and explore AI-powered analytics to eliminate data entry and streamline financial reporting.

Financial Modeling & Forecasting: Build and maintain clean cash flow forecasts, budget-to-actual reports, and financial models in Excel/Google Sheets to support executive decision-making.

Required Qualifications

Experience: 5+ years of progressive finance/bookkeeping experience, ideally including healthcare/medical practice or multi-entity (real estate) work.

Software Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO ProAdvisor certification is a strong plus). Elite Excel/Google Sheets skills (advanced formulas, financial modeling).

AI & Automation Track Record: Proven experience leveraging AI tools, macros, integrations, or data pipelines to reduce manual workflows.

Industry Domain Knowledge: Solid familiarity with healthcare revenue cycles, payer reimbursements, or specialized US real estate accounting.

Communication & Mindset: Flawless English communication skills (written and verbal). High degree of integrity, absolute attention to detail, and a fierce ownership mindset—you manage the outcomes, not just the tasks.

Setup: Comfortable working independently in a remote, async-heavy structure, with the flexibility to accommodate key US business needs.

Nice-to-Haves (Highly Valued)

Active CPA, CMA, or local equivalent professional designation.

Direct hands-on experience with eClinicalWorks, Waystar, or similar medical EHR/billing systems.

Familiarity with AI-powered analytics or automated data pipeline tools.

title: Full-Time Real Estate Virtual Assistant — $4/Hour | Long-Term
description:
I’m looking for a reliable, organized, and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to join my real estate business full-time.



Pay: $4 USD/hour

Hours: 40 hours/week

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Central Time

Position: Full-Time / Long-Term

Industry: U.S. Residential Real Estate



I’m not looking for someone who knows everything already.



I’m looking for someone who is dependable, learns quickly, follows instructions carefully, communicates well, and wants to grow into a long-term position.



If you’re the type of person who notices mistakes, enjoys organizing things, and likes figuring out how to solve problems, you’ll probably do well here.



What You’ll Help With



Your responsibilities will include:



* Managing and organizing leads in GoHighLevel (GHL)

* Importing, tagging, and updating contacts

* Cleaning Excel/Google Sheets databases

* Preparing prospecting lists

* Organizing expired, canceled, and FSBO leads

* Preparing reverse-prospecting lists

* Identifying leads that need follow-up

* Organizing Google Drive files

* Assisting with listing administration

* Setting up
 campaigns

* Scheduling approved social media content

* Maintaining checklists and spreadsheets

* Preparing daily/weekly reports

* Completing miscellaneous administrative projects

*Social media content creation and video editing 



Your responsibilities may grow as you learn the business.



You DON’T Need to Know Everything



Previous experience with GoHighLevel or U.S. real estate is a plus, but it is NOT required.



I would rather hire someone who is:



Reliable + Detail-Oriented + Resourceful + Teachable



than someone with years of experience who doesn’t communicate or follow instructions.



I can teach you our systems.



You Should Be Comfortable With



* Google Sheets / Excel

* Google Drive

* Learning new software

* Working with large lists of contacts

* Following written instructions

* Following video/Loom instructions

* Working independently

* Asking good questions

* Researching solutions when you don’t know something



Basic Canva and social media experience is helpful.



What I Expect



I don’t expect perfection.



I DO expect:



* Showing up consistently

* Honest communication

* Attention to detail

* Meeting deadlines

* Asking questions when something isn’t clear

* Taking responsibility for mistakes

* Trying to solve problems before immediately asking for help



If you encounter a problem, I want you to think:



1. Check the instructions.

2. See if I’ve solved this before.

3. Research the problem.

4. Try to solve it.

5. If I’m still stuck, ask for help and tell me what I’ve already tried.



Required Work Schedule



This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position.



You must be available to work:



Monday through Friday

9:00 AM – 5:00 PM U.S. Central Time



This is the required working schedule, not simply an overlap period.



Please make sure you are comfortable working these hours in your local time zone before applying.



Compensation



Starting pay is:



$4 USD/hour × 40 hours/week



The position begins with a paid trial period.



If we’re a good fit, I’m looking for someone who wants to stay long-term and take on more responsibility as the business grows.



How to Apply



Please answer ALL of the following:



1. Tell me about yourself and your previous work experience.



2. Why are you interested in a long-term VA position?



3. Rate your experience from 1–5 with each:



* Google Sheets/Excel

* GoHighLevel

* Canva

* CRM management

* U.S. real estate

* Data entry/database cleanup

*
 marketing

* Social media scheduling



4. Have you worked for a U.S. real estate company before? If yes, explain what you did.



5. Tell me about your experience with GoHighLevel. If you’ve never used it, simply say so.



6. SCENARIO:



You receive a spreadsheet containing 2,000 leads.



Some contacts are duplicated, phone numbers use different formats, capitalization is inconsistent, some
s are missing, and some information appears to be in the wrong columns.



Explain step-by-step how you would approach cleaning this database before importing it into our CRM.



7. What would you do if I gave you an assignment and you couldn’t figure out how to complete part of it?



8. What other clients, jobs, or ongoing work commitments do you currently have?



9. What is your internet speed and what computer do you use?



10. Confirm that you are available to work Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Central Time.



11. Please provide your resume.



Finally, start the SUBJECT LINE of your application with:



DETAILS MATTER —



and then add your favorite food after it.



Example:



DETAILS MATTER — Pizza



Applications that don’t follow this instruction will not be considered.

title: Marketing Agency Operations Manager
description:
The Person Who Gets Things Done



This role is unique — because the work will be different every day.



One day, you might clean and restructure a spreadsheet. The next, you could review job applicants, check that social media content has been published correctly, improve a process, follow up with a team member or identify why a project is not moving forward.



The common thread is simple:



Something needs to get done properly, and you make sure it happens.



We are looking for an experienced, highly capable person who can work across the operations of a growing marketing agency.



You do not need to be an expert in every area of marketing. We have processes, systems and training for everything we do.



What we cannot train as easily is judgement.



You need to be able to understand the end goal, work backwards, see the steps required and notice what is missing — without becoming so caught up in minor details that nothing moves forward.



Progress Over Perfection



We care about quality, but we do not believe perfection should prevent progress.



You need to know:



Which details genuinely matter

Which issues need to be resolved immediately

Which improvements can wait

When to keep investigating

When to make a sensible decision and move forward



You will check and double-check your work, but you will not allow perfectionism to become procrastination.



We want someone who creates momentum.



What You Could Be Doing



Your responsibilities will be varied and may include:



Cleaning, organising and maintaining spreadsheets and internal data

Turning repeated tasks into clear processes, checklists and systems

Reviewing work for errors, missing information or inconsistencies

Checking that content, campaigns and social media tasks have been completed correctly

Coordinating projects across different agency departments

Monitoring deadlines, following up on outstanding work and identifying blockers

Reviewing job applications and helping us identify strong candidates

Supporting the onboarding and management of team members

Checking that our processes are being followed and improving them where required

Spotting gaps before they become problems

Taking ownership of unexpected operational tasks

Keeping projects moving without needing constant reminders

Helping us build a stronger team as the agency continues to grow



Sometimes, you will be given a clearly defined task.



Other times, you will be given an outcome and expected to determine the best way to reach it.



Who We Are Looking For



You will ideally have:



Experience working within a marketing agency

Experience in project management, operations or team coordination

Some experience managing people, freelancers or external contractors

Strong written communication and attention to detail

The ability to manage several priorities without losing sight of the main objective

Excellent judgement and practical common sense

The confidence to ask questions when something genuinely is not clear

The initiative to solve straightforward problems independently

The ability to recognise missing steps, risks and weak points

Strong emotional intelligence when working across different departments

A calm, persistent and solutions-focused approach

A low-ego attitude and willingness to embrace the way we work



You do not need to be highly extroverted, sales-focused or comfortable spending your day in meetings.



We have very few meetings and phone calls. Most collaboration happens through written communication, tasks and clearly documented processes.



However, emotional intelligence still matters. You will work across several parts of the agency and need to understand how to communicate respectfully, follow up effectively and work with different personalities.



How We Work



We do not care where you work, what you wear or exactly when you complete your work.



We do not micromanage.



What we do care about is trust, ownership and visible progress.



Freedom comes with accountability. If you say something will be completed, we need to trust that it will be completed — or that you will communicate early if something changes.



There is no ego in our approach. It is not about who is right. It is about finding what works.



You may have done something differently in a previous role. We will listen to your ideas, but you must also be willing to learn and embrace our systems, processes and standards.



Our One Objective



Everything we do comes back to one goal:



Achieving the best possible results for our clients.



Our decisions are not driven by what creates the easiest work or the most short-term profit. We ask what will genuinely help our clients achieve a better outcome.



As we attract more clients, we need better systems, stronger processes and more exceptional people.



Once you understand and embrace that objective, you will be trusted to take ownership, make sensible decisions and pursue the outcome with grace, precision and persistence.



You Will Thrive Here If You…

Naturally take ownership instead of waiting to be chased

Enjoy bringing order to messy or incomplete information

Can move comfortably between small administrative tasks and larger operational challenges

Notice what other people miss

Care about the final result, not just completing your assigned step

Are comfortable receiving varied tasks and d
 how to approach them

Value respect, trust and direct communication

Prefer meaningful work over meetings, office politics and unnecessary bureaucracy

Want the freedom to work independently while contributing to a growing agency

This Role May Not Suit You If You…

Need every task explained step by step before you can begin

Regularly miss details because you do not check your work

Become overwhelmed when priorities change

Focus on being busy rather than producing outcomes

Avoid responsibility when something goes wrong

Need constant supervision, reassurance or reminders

Allow perfectionism to prevent work from being completed

Are more interested in proving your approach is right than finding the best solution

How to Apply



We are less interested in a long, polished cover letter than in understanding how you think.



Please include:



A brief overview of your marketing agency, project management and team management experience.

An example of a messy or unclear task you took ownership of and successfully completed.

An example of a problem or missing step you identified before anyone asked you to look for it.

How you prioritise when several tasks appear urgent.

The systems and project management tools you have used.

Your availability, time zone and expected rate.



If you are intelligent, dependable and exceptionally good at turning intentions into completed work, we would love to hear from you.

You must also have significant digital marketing agency and GoHighLevel experience because you need to understand the work your team is responsible for delivering.

* Helping leadership make hiring and staffing decisions

* Developing future team leaders

* Maintaining team morale while keeping standards high

* Building systems that make the team more effective



We want someone who is comfortable being responsible for other people’s performance.



If someone repeatedly misses deadlines, you address it.



If instructions aren’t being followed, you figure out why.



If a department is falling behind, you reorganize it.



If an employee needs additional training, you identify it.



If someone is exceptional, you help develop them.



Extremely Strong English Is ESSENTIAL



You will serve as a major communication bridge between our U.S. leadership and Philippines-based team.



Your English must be exceptional.



You must have:



* Near-fluent spoken English

* Excellent written English

* Excellent comprehension

* Strong conversational ability

* Confidence leading meetings in English

* Ability to understand detailed instructions from U.S. leadership

* Ability to communicate those instructions clearly to the team

* Ability to explain problems, solutions, and recommendations clearly



Strong English is non-negotiable for this position.



Applicants should expect to complete part of the interview entirely through live English conversation.



Extensive GoHighLevel Experience Is REQUIRED



Our agency operates heavily inside GoHighLevel (GHL).



You need enough GHL expertise to understand and manage employees working on:



* Agency and sub-accounts

* SaaS accounts

* Workflows and advanced automations

* CRM configuration

* Opportunities and pipelines

* Calendars

* Forms and surveys

* Websites and funnels

* Domains

*
 and SMS

* A2P

* Integrations and webhooks

* Custom fields and values

* User permissions

* Troubleshooting



Basic GHL experience will not qualify.



Digital Marketing Knowledge Is REQUIRED



You should have strong working knowledge of:



* Website development

* SEO

* Google Business Profiles

* Google Ads

* Meta/Facebook Ads

* Lead generation

* CRM and automation

* Conversion tracking

* Domains and DNS

* Agency client fulfillment



You don’t need to personally be the best technician in every area.



You need to know enough to manage, question, evaluate, and hold accountable the people who are.



We’re Looking for a Leader Who



* Has significant people-management experience

* Has managed Filipino remote teams

* Has extensive digital marketing agency experience

* Has extensive GoHighLevel experience

* Communicates exceptionally well in English

* Is confident and decisive

* Holds people accountable

* Can have difficult conversations professionally

* Develops employees instead of simply assigning tasks

* Identifies problems early

* Creates processes instead of repeatedly fixing the same problems

* Understands how to delegate

* Knows when to coach and when to escalate

* Can operate independently

* Takes ownership of results



What Success Looks Like



Our U.S. leadership team shouldn’t need to individually manage every Filipino team member.



That’s your responsibility.



Leadership communicates priorities to you.



You turn those priorities into clear expectations for the team.



You make sure everyone knows what they’re doing.



You monitor execution.



You address problems.



You hold people accountable.



You report back to leadership.



Ultimately, we want someone who can help us build a Philippines-based team that is organized, accountable, technically capable, and increasingly independent.



Requirements



* Exceptional/near-fluent English – REQUIRED

* Significant people-management experience – REQUIRED

* Experience managing Filipino employees – HIGHLY PREFERRED

* Extensive GoHighLevel experience – REQUIRED

* Significant digital marketing agency experience

* Strong website and SEO knowledge

* Strong understanding of Google Ads and Meta Ads

* CRM and marketing automation knowledge

* Strong leadership and problem-solving ability

* Full-time availability



How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your resume

2. A 2–3 minute video introducing yourself in English

3. The largest team you’ve directly managed

4. How many years you’ve managed employees

5. How many years you’ve worked with GoHighLevel

6. The most advanced things you’ve managed or built inside GHL

7. Your digital marketing agency experience

8. An example of an underperforming employee you’ve successfully managed

9. An example of a team/process you’ve improved

10. Your expected monthly salary in PHP



Start your application with “PEOPLE & OPERATIONS MANAGER” so we know you read the entire posting.

Superannuation

journals

accruals

prepayments

balance sheet reconciliations

title: Social Media Assistant
description:
About the Role:



We’re hiring an Engagement Strategist to act as the voice and connector for the personal brands we manage.

This role is not about posting content.

It’s about starting conversations.

You will engage on behalf of our clients inside comments, replies, and DMs to build relationships, create familiarity, and naturally guide conversations toward a next step when appropriate.



Core Responsibilities:



Social Media Engagement & Relationship Building

– Engage on other people’s content to spark natural conversations

– Respond to comments, replies, and DMs in each client’s brand voice

– Ask thoughtful follow-up questions to keep conversations moving

– Recognize when to transition a conversation toward connection or booking

– Maintain professionalism, warmth, and clarity in all written communication



Story & Light Content Support

– Assist with Instagram Stories (text, polls, replies, short clips)

– Repurpose approved content across platforms when needed



Tracking & Admin

– Track daily engagement activity (comments, DMs, conversations started)

– Monitor response quality and engagement patterns

– Assist with light content scrubbing for short video clips



Required Skills & Traits

– Excellent written English (grammar, tone, vocabulary, clarity are non-negotiable)

– Strong conversational instincts and emotional intelligence

– Familiarity with Instagram and LinkedIn (comments, DMs, Stories, basic analytics)

– Ability to sound human and brand-aligned, never scripted or robotic

– Organized, self-directed, and comfortable with feedback



Working Hours:

This role has set engagement windows:

– 4:00am–7:00am PST

– 3:00pm–6:00pm PST

– Monday through Thursday minimum

Occasional brief admin tasks may occur outside these windows.



To Apply:

Step 1: Loom Video (Required)

Please record a 5–7 minute Loom answering the prompts below. We’re looking for how you think, speak, and write, not perfection.

1. Instagram Experience

How do you personally use Instagram day to day, and what features do you use most (comments, DMs, Stories, etc.)?

2. Starting Conversations

If you were networking on behalf of a client, how would you leave comments that feel natural and start real conversations?

3. Guiding Toward a Next Step

How would you naturally move a conversation from casual engagement to a potential call or appointment without sounding salesy?

4. Tone & Voice

How do you adjust your language when speaking on behalf of someone else’s brand?



Step 2: Written Questions (After Loom Review)

If your Loom is a fit, we’ll ask you to answer the questions below:

Q1: On a scale of 1–10, how confident are you using Instagram’s tools (comments, DMs, Stories, analytics)? Why?

Q2: Share an example of an online interaction that turned into a real relationship, opportunity, or next step.

Q3: How do you d
 when to keep a conversation casual versus when to guide it toward a next step?

Q4: How do you ensure your written English stays clear, professional, and aligned with someone else’s voice?

Q5: Are you open to a short paid test project (1 hour or less) to demonstrate engagement and comment strategy?



Step 3: Test Project

Selected candidates will receive a short paid engagement exercise using real examples so we can evaluate comment quality, DM tone, conversation flow, and judgment.

title: Booking Agent
description:
PIKT Entertainment is an events company in Melbourne, Australia. We supply the DJs, photographers, photo booths and 360 booths for weddings, engagement parties, 21st birthdays and school formals.



People enquire through our website every week and we do not call them all back fast enough. That is your job.



What you will do



Call people who have already enquired. These are warm leads, not cold calls.

Ask about their event, recommend the right package, send the quote.

Follow up until they book or say no. Most people book on the third or fourth call.

Log every call in our CRM.

Hours



9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Manila time, Monday to Friday. Day shift. No graveyard.



Pay



$250 USD per month, plus $[5] USD for every booking you close. 



What you need



Clear spoken English. Australians need to understand you easily on a phone line.



At least 1 year on the phone. Sales, appointment setting or BPO.



Stable internet, 25 Mbps minimum, with a backup connection.



A USB headset with a proper microphone, and a quiet room to work in.



What we give you



You call from our Melbourne number through a browser dialer. You pay nothing for calls.

Full training on our packages, pricing and scripts.

Paid on time every month via [Wise / PayPal].

How to apply



Start your message with MELBOURNE.

Attach your resume.

Record a voice recording on your phone, 60 seconds maximum. Say your name, then tell us about the best party you have ever been to. Speak normally, do not read a script.

No voice recording, no interview. This is a phone job, so we want to hear you.



Notes for you (do not post)

 

Set the bonus properly. At $250 base the bonus is what makes this competitive, so make it worth chasing. $15 a booking is a starting point, not a recommendation, since I do not know your margin per job. Whatever the number, put it in the ad. "Bonuses available" reads as nothing.



Expect entry-level. $250 full time sits at the floor of the platform, so you will get people with less phone experience than the ad asks for. The voice recording is what protects you. Listen to it before you read anything else, and reject anyone you have to concentrate to understand.



The MELBOURNE keyword will remove most of the mass-appliers on its own.

First week should be paid training with you listening in, not solo dialling.

Australian and Philippine public holidays differ. Agree in writing which calendar they follow.

Calls are recorded through the CRM. Tell them, and make sure they tell the customer. Australian law requires it.

title: Telecom / Radio Engineer
description:
We are looking for a highly motivated Network Engineer / Two-Way Radio Engineer to support the deployment, operation, and maintenance of professional communication systems, including IP networks, TETRA, DMR, LTE, microwave, and dispatch solutions.



Key Responsibilities



Network Engineering

• Configure and maintain LAN, WAN, VPN, and wireless networks.

• Troubleshoot network connectivity, routing, switching, and firewall issues.

• Configure and support routers, switches, firewalls, and network servers.

• Monitor network performance and implement corrective actions.

• Support integration of communication systems over IP networks.



Two-Way Radio Engineering

• Install, configure, commission, and maintain radio communication systems.

• Support TETRA, DMR, conventional radio, dispatch, and recording systems.

• Program radios, repeaters, and base stations.

• Perform RF testing, coverage testing, and system optimization.

• Troubleshoot radio infrastructure, antennas, feeders, power systems, and network interfaces.

• Conduct site surveys and prepare technical reports.



Qualifications

• Bachelor's Degree in Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, IT, Telecommunications, or related field.

• Experience in IP networking, routing, switching, VPN, and wireless technologies.

• Experience with radio communication systems is an advantage.

• Knowledge of TETRA, DMR, LTE, Microwave, CCTV, or Dispatch Systems is preferred.

• Familiarity with Cisco, Mikrotik, Huawei, Fortinet, or similar networking platforms.

• Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.

• Willing to travel and perform field work nationwide.

• Willing to work overtime/weekends/holidays when required.



Preferred Certifications

• CCNA, HCIA, HCIP, MTCNA

• TETRA or DMR Technical Training

• Network Security Certifications

• RF or Telecommunications Certifications

title: Social Media Manager
description:
About Us



Dreambound is a mission-driven education startup. We help Americans find purposeful work by connecting people with training programs, from trade schools to colleges, that help them build better careers. We’re a fast-growing company (4x last year), backed by top investors like Union Square Ventures and Arrive (Roc Nation).



About the Role



We’re looking for a full-time Social Media Manager to run Dreambound's day-to-day social presence across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and
. We set the strategy and hand you the briefs, then you turn them into a steady flow of content: planning the calendar, publishing, keeping the editor moving, and growing our visibility socially. You also keep an eye on what's working to help shape what we make next. You live and breathe social. You know what’s trending, why things get net positive attention, and how to turn that into a plan the team can execute. As we scale, there's room to grow into owning organic social end-to-end.



What You’ll Be Doing



- Briefing: Take our creative briefs and direction and turn them into clear, specific asks for the video editor/designer. 

- Publishing: Schedule, publish, and manage day-to-day posting across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and
.

- Community: Engage the audience, monitor comments and DMs, and grow the community.

- Copywriting: Write captions, hooks, and on-screen text tailored to each platform.

- Trend Spotting: Stay ahead of platform trends and surface fresh ideas for the team to green-light.

- Collaboration: Work closely with the video editor/designer to keep output on schedule and on-brand.



You’re the Right Fit If



- You can work U.S. PST hours.

- You are a Social-Media Native: You know what’s trending, you know why certain videos go viral, and you can replicate that “feeling” in your work.

- You’re a Visual Problem Solver: You can take a text-based brief and instantly see the visual story in your head.

- You Balance Speed and Quality: You thrive in a startup environment where we move fast, but you never sacrifice the brand’s look and feel.

- You have the “Knack”: You have an intuitive sense for layout, typography, and pacing.

- You’re a strong writer who can craft scroll-stopping captions and hooks.

- You can translate creative strategy briefs into clear ideas that a creative team can execute on.



Experience



- Mid-level social media management experience

- A track record of growing social accounts not just editing good and posting daily



Nice to Have



- A good know-how of reporting the necessary metrics, so you can see what’s working. 

- Comfort using AI tools in your content, reporting, and/or overall workflow. 



What We Provide



- The strategy, direction, and brand guidelines.

- A dedicated video editor/designer to produce the content.

- A collaborative startup environment where your work directly impacts growth.



What We Offer (Full-Time)



- Competitive salary (negotiable by experience)

- 13th-month pay, internet allowance, U.S. holiday leave

- HMO, PhilHealth, SSS, Pag-Ibig after probation

- Paid sick leave and time-off

- Pay increase possible after 6-month probation based on performance



To Apply



Please use the code DreamTeam when applying. Submit your resume, a short note on your approach to social media, and examples of accounts or campaigns you’ve managed (with results, if you have them).

- Go-to-market, lead generation, and business development

- General operations and administrative tasks

- Product management, design, or engineering

- Workflow automation and process improvement

- Data organization, analysis, tracking, and reporting

- Adaptability to execute ad hoc projects across a fast-moving team



You're a Strong Fit If You...



- Genuinely love to use AI and are able to use it creatively. You should be able to articulate how you've used AI to do things faster, better, or that you couldn't have done otherwise

title: Trailer Repair Admin
description:
GH Logistics and AJG Transport operate a high-performance freight brokerage and asset-based transportation network specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, clear communication, and accountability. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup through delivery.



If you have experience coordinating equipment repairs, working with drivers and repair vendors, and keeping trailer operations moving during overnight hours, this role provides an opportunity to take ownership of a critical part of our Trailer Management operation.



Role Overview

The Trailer Repair FMT is responsible for maintaining overnight control of trailer repair activity and supporting off-tour Trailer Management operations. Your primary responsibility is to coordinate trailer repairs during the night shift, including high-volume on-road repair activity, while ensuring trailer records, repair statuses, documentation, and operational updates remain accurate in real time. You will work closely with the night repair team, drivers, carriers, repair vendors, facility personnel, and the Trailer Management team to keep equipment issues moving toward resolution. 



The night team is also responsible for verifying and completing work handed off by the day team and delivering a fully reconciled and accurate board for the incoming day shift. This is an operations and repair coordination position. You will not physically repair trailers and you will not have authority to approve company spending.



What You’ll Be Doing



Overnight Trailer Repair Coordination

• Serve as the primary Trailer Management point of coordination for overnight and on-road trailer repairs, working with drivers, carriers, facilities, roadside providers, mobile mechanics, and repair vendors.

• Review reported trailer defects, gather photos, inspection details, diagnoses, estimates, parts information, and other documentation needed to determine the appropriate next step.

• Coordinate roadside service, mobile repairs, terminal repairs, inspections, trailer swaps, or equipment repositioning and follow up on vendor status, parts availability, completion timelines, and return-to-service expectations.

• Continue follow-up on repairs handed off by the day team until they are resolved or properly documented and returned to the day team.

• Escalate repair costs, safety concerns, major equipment issues, and matters requiring financial approval to authorized leadership; this role has no authority to approve spending.



Fleetio and Data Integrity

• Maintain Fleetio records overnight in real time and enter all repair, trailer, and operational updates handled during the shift.

• Ensure trailer repair statuses, locations, assignments, conditions, and related records remain accurate and current.

• Conduct overnight data integrity checks and investigate missing, outdated, conflicting, or incomplete information.

• Update and maintain records involving misused trailers, partner carrier trailers, repair activity, vendors, and supporting documentation.

• Identify and resolve discrepancies between operational information and system records before the morning handoff whenever possible.



Off-Tour Trailer Operations

• Run the required overnight trailer classification sweep and identify trailers requiring correction, investigation, or follow-up.

• Close operational gaps and unfinished trailer-related work handed off by the day team.

• Assist carriers requiring trailers and coordinate trailer availability, loading, seating, assignments, and related movements.

• Monitor and address trailer concerns that may affect drivers, facilities, customers, freight movement, or equipment availability.

• Handle additional overnight trailer-related tasks and maintain communication with facility personnel and designated internal operational contacts.



Documentation and Morning Handoff

• Maintain complete and organized trailer repair paperwork and supporting documentation throughout the shift.

• Clearly document completed work, pending repairs, vendor responses, equipment concerns, unresolved issues, and required follow-ups.

• Verify items handed off by the day team and document what was completed, remains pending, or requires escalation.

• Ensure every unresolved item has clear ownership, an accurate current status, documented next steps, and a proper handoff.

• Deliver the 8 AM handoff complete and on time, including a reconciled board accurately reflecting trailer locations, statuses, repairs, outstanding issues, and required follow-ups.



What Success Looks Like

• Overnight and on-road trailer repairs are acknowledged quickly, coordinated effectively, and consistently followed through toward resolution.

• Fleetio, trailer classifications, repair records, and other operational data remain accurate and updated in real time throughout the shift.

• Drivers, carriers, vendors, facilities, and internal teams receive timely and clear communication regarding repair and trailer needs.

• Repair documentation, escalations, and unresolved issues are complete, organized, and properly handed off without unauthorized spending decisions.

• The day team receives a complete 8:00 AM handoff with a fully reconciled trailer board showing completed, pending, and escalated items.



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in trailer management, fleet operations, dispatch, transportation, roadside assistance, or maintenance coordination.

• Knowledge of common trailer repairs, components, equipment defects, and maintenance terminology; repair coordination experience preferred.

• Able to review driver reports, photos, inspections, diagnoses, and estimates, ask the right follow-up questions, and determine appropriate next steps.

• Strong communication, attention to detail, problem-solving, prioritization, and follow-through in a fast-paced overnight operation.

• Comfortable working independently and using Fleetio or similar fleet systems; Samsara, LoadStop, Microsoft Office, and Google Workspace experience is a plus.

• Minimum 50 WPM typing speed, strong written and verbal English, and a reliable remote setup with backup internet and power.



Schedule and Work Setup

• Long term and full time remote independent contractor role

• Direct engagement with a US company, not an agency or BPO

• Current shift availability: Tuesday - Saturday 8 PM - 6 AM CDT

• Consistent availability during the assigned US shift is required

• Zoom presence with camera on throughout the shift is required

• Time tracking software, including Hubstaff or another platform, may be implemented as operationally required



What You’ll Get

• Independent contractor setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend, with eligibility beginning 30 days after hire

• Reliable biweekly payments

• A stable, long-term opportunity that is not seasonal or project-based

• Direct exposure to a live US transportation and fleet operation

• Meaningful responsibility over overnight trailer repair activity

• Opportunities to develop deeper experience in Trailer Management, fleet maintenance, repair coordination, and transportation operations

• Potential growth within Trailer Management, Fleet Operations, Maintenance Coordination, or broader logistics operations



This role is built for someone who can keep control of trailer repairs after hours. You will not simply receive repair requests and pass them along. You will coordinate the response, maintain accurate Fleetio records, follow open repairs, support overnight trailer needs, clean up operational discrepancies, document what happened, and make sure the day team receives a reliable and reconciled picture of the operation every morning.

title: Accounting & Marketing Assistant
description:
You have successfully maintained the books and accounting for an Australian business turning over $5 million or more and are now looking for a broader role where you can take on greater responsibility and contribute beyond finance in a key position.



Reporting to the Australian management team, you'll take ownership of the day-to-day bookkeeping and financial administration. You'll maintain accurate financial records, complete reconciliations, manage accounts payable and receivable, and prepare timely financial information and management reports. You'll also work alongside our external accountant, who manages the BAS and taxation requirements.



Beyond the accounting responsibilities, you'll enjoy a varied role supporting the business in other key areas. This includes coordinating marketing activities with our Australian team to grow Yum Tasmanian’s online presence, assisting with grant applications, and contributing to a range of business initiatives.



Yum Tasmanian is a proudly Australian, family-owned business that has been supplying premium potatoes throughout Australia for more than 30 years. Beginning as an organic potato producer in 1994, the business has grown into a nationally recognised supplier to major retailers including Coles, Woolworths, IGA, independent retailers and wholesale markets.



Today, the group operates across several businesses within agriculture, fresh produce and related industries. As the business continues to grow, there is a strong focus on building the Yum brand, educating consumers and expanding its online presence through organic marketing.



We want you to be a driver in helping us build Yum into Australia's most recognised online potato brand by growing our organic digital presence to over 1 million Instagram and
 followers through organic marketing.



The role is Monday to Friday, working from an office. In return for your great performance, you’ll be supported with autonomy, rewards and more opportunity for growth over time.

title: Senior Digital & Social Performance Marketing Lead
description:
We have ambitious plans to grow rapidly. Our entire ecosystem has been divided into 4 new positions. We are looking for people who have the knowledge and experience to join our team and take our 23 year old company to the next level.



Feel free to browse our 4 open positions, but do not apply to any if you do not have the experience required. Thanks you.



Here they are:



1. Senior Technical & Ecommerce SEO Lead

2. Off-Page SEO & Paid Search Performance Specialist

3. Creative Strategy & Advertising Content Lead

4. Senior Digital & Social Performance Marketing Lead



This ad is for position #4

4. Senior Digital & Social Performance Marketing Lead



Paid Social • Ecommerce Growth • Customer Acquisition • Retargeting • Lifecycle Marketing

Full-Time Permanent Position — 40 Hours Per Week

JOB OVERVIEW



We are a 23-year-old printing and manufacturing company looking for an exceptional Senior Digital & Social Performance Marketing Lead.



This is NOT a social-media posting position.

This is NOT a content-creator position.

We have separate employees responsible for creative production and staff who can assist with repetitive posting and routine engagement.



We are looking for the marketing brain.

You will be responsible for determining:



WHO we should market to.

WHAT we should market to them.

WHERE we should reach them.

WHEN we should reach them.

WHAT offer they should see.

WHAT stage of the buying journey they are in.

HOW much we should spend acquiring them.

HOW we bring them back if they don't purchase.

HOW we turn first-time customers into repeat customers.

WHETHER the marketing actually made money.



Our objective is not followers.

Our objective is profitable growth.



YOUR MISSION

Build a sophisticated digital customer-acquisition and retention engine capable of helping scale our company toward $10+ million in annual revenue.



No single employee can guarantee that revenue.



Your responsibility is to build, operate and continuously improve the digital-marketing systems that can help us get there.



The system should move customers through:



Awareness > Interest > Consideration > Visit > Lead/Cart > Purchase > Repeat Purchase > Referral



You will work closely with:



Creative Strategy & Advertising Content Lead

Technical/Ecommerce SEO Lead

Paid Search Specialist

Management

Sales/customer-service staff

Social-media VA's



1. DIGITAL MARKETING STRATEGY

Own the complete social/digital marketing strategy.



Determine how we should use:




Instagram

TikTok

YouTube

Pinterest

LinkedIn


SMS

Influencers

Creators

Customer lists

Retargeting

Marketing automation

Landing pages

CRM data



Do not advertise somewhere merely because it exists.



You must explain:



Why we're using it

Who we're targeting

What outcome we expect

How we're measuring it



2. CUSTOMER & MARKET SEGMENTATION

We sell products that can appeal to very different customers.



For custom shirts, examples may include:



Schools

Sports teams

Restaurants

Contractors

Churches

Companies

Events

Clubs

Nonprofits

Family reunions

Gyms

Retail businesses



For yard signs:

Realtors

Contractors

Landscapers

Schools

Events

Graduations

Businesses

Political campaigns where appropriate

Property services

Community organizations



These audiences should NOT all receive the same advertisement.



Develop distinct:

Audiences

Messages

Offers

Creative briefs

Landing pages

Retargeting

Follow-up



3. CUSTOMER PERSONAS & BUYING INTENT



Understand:

Who buys

Why they buy

What problem they're solving

How quickly they need it

What prevents them from buying

What competitors they're considering

What matters most: price, speed, quality, convenience, service or customization

How often they reorder

What else they may purchase



Turn customer knowledge into marketing strategy.



4. META ADVERTISING



You must be highly experienced with:

Meta Business Manager

Meta Ads Manager

 Ads

Instagram Ads

Meta Pixel

Events Manager

Conversion API concepts

Custom audiences

Customer lists

Website audiences

Engagement audiences

Video audiences

Prospecting

Retargeting

Catalog ads where appropriate

Advantage+ tools where appropriate

Lookalike/similar audience strategies where available



You should know how to build campaigns from scratch and improve them over time.



5. TIKTOK MARKETING & ADVERTISING



Understand both organic TikTok behavior and TikTok Ads Manager.



Know how to:



Identify TikTok-native creative

Select objectives

Build campaigns

Develop audiences

Retarget

Test creative

Read performance

Use Pixel/Events data

Scale winners

Kill poor performers



Work closely with the Creative Lead to produce platform-native assets.



6. YOUTUBE



Develop opportunities through:

YouTube Shorts

Video advertising

Retargeting

Product demonstrations

Educational content

Customer-intent content



Determine which videos are brand-building and which are direct-response assets.



7. PINTEREST



Evaluate and utilize Pinterest when appropriate for visually driven products including:



Apparel

Signs

Design inspiration

Events

Weddings

Business branding

Promotional materials



Understand the difference between Pinterest content strategy and paid Pinterest acquisition.



8. LINKEDIN / B2B DIGITAL MARKETING



Develop B2B opportunities where economically justified.



Potential audiences include:



Companies

Marketing managers

Restaurants

Franchises

Schools

Organizations

Event companies

Contractors

Procurement teams



Determine when LinkedIn advertising makes financial sense and when organic outreach/content is more appropriate.



9. PAID SOCIAL MEDIA STRATEGY



Own:



Campaign architecture

Audiences

Objectives

Budgets

Placements

Bidding/optimization strategy

Prospecting

Retargeting

Testing

Scaling

Exclusions

Frequency

Creative rotation

Campaign analysis



The Creative Lead makes the creative.



You make sure the right creative reaches the right person.



10. CREATIVE BRIEFING



You must understand creative even though you are not our primary creative producer.



Example:



Instead of telling the Creative Lead:



"Make me five
 ads."



You should be capable of saying:



"We're targeting youth baseball-team managers. Price is not their biggest problem—ordering 15 different names and numbers correctly is. I want three 15-second videos built around simplifying team ordering. Give me one testimonial angle, one problem/solution angle and one demonstration."



THAT is marketing.



You provide the business/customer insight.



The Creative Lead turns it into excellent creative.



11. CREATIVE PERFORMANCE FEEDBACK



You will provide the Creative Lead with data.



Example:



Creative A:

High hook rate, low CTR.



Creative B:

Lower watch time but excellent purchase rate.



Creative C:

Strong CTR but terrible conversion rate.



Creative D:

Excellent ROAS but beginning to fatigue.



Your job is to interpret those results and request the next round of creative intelligently.



12. RETARGETING SYSTEMS



Build sophisticated retargeting journeys.



Examples:



Website visitor



Viewed shirt page.



> Shirt benefit advertisement.



Repeat visit



Still did not buy.



> Testimonial/social-proof advertisement.



Added to cart



Didn't purchase.



> Cart-recovery advertising +
/SMS.



Purchased



Remove from new-customer acquisition advertising.



> Cross-sell.



60/90/180 days later



> Reorder/win-back campaign where appropriate.



Different behavior should trigger different marketing.



13. FIRST-PARTY CUSTOMER DATA



Develop strategies around properly obtained customer data.



Segment by:



Product purchased

Purchase date

Frequency

Order value

Customer type

Geographic area

Lifetime value

Engagement

Lead vs. customer

Lapsed customer



Use appropriately on supported platforms for:



Customer Match

Custom audiences

Exclusions

Retention

Reorders

Cross-selling

Prospecting/modelled audiences where supported



Follow applicable privacy and platform requirements.



14.
 MARKETING



Own
 strategy and deployment.



Build automated flows such as:



Welcome



New subscriber> introduction > value > proof > offer.



Abandoned Cart



Cart > reminder > benefits > proof > incentive if justified.



Browse Abandonment



Visited repeatedly > relevant product reminder.



Post Purchase



Confirmation > education > review > cross-sell.



Reorder



Expected replenishment/reorder timeframe > reminder.



Win Back



Customer hasn't purchased recently > targeted return campaign.



VIP



High-value customer > special treatment/offers.



15. SMS MARKETING



Build compliant SMS programs for:



Abandoned carts

Promotions

Limited-time offers

Reorders

Product launches

VIP customers

Customer lifecycle campaigns



Avoid destroying customer trust through excessive messaging.



16. CROSS-SELLING & UPSELLING



Customers buying one product may need another.



Examples:



Business cards > flyers.



Yard signs > banners.



Custom shirts > signs.



Event printing > apparel.



Restaurant menus > uniforms/signage.



Develop data-driven cross-sell and upsell campaigns.



17. CUSTOMER LIFETIME VALUE



You must think beyond the first transaction.



Understand:



CAC

First-order value

Average order value

Purchase frequency

Repeat purchase rate

Customer lifetime value

Gross margin where provided

Payback period



Sometimes spending $100 to acquire a $75 first order can make sense.



Sometimes spending $20 to acquire a $75 order is terrible.



The answer depends on margin, repeat purchases and lifetime value.



Think like a business owner.



18. FUNNEL DEVELOPMENT



Create complete funnels.



Examples:



Social Ad > Landing Page > Purchase



or:



Video > Lead Form >
/SMS > Quote ? Sale



or:



Educational Content > Retargeting > Product Page > Purchase



or:



Customer List > Reorder Offer > Purchase



Every campaign should have an intentional next step.



19. LANDING-PAGE STRATEGY



You do not need to code the pages.



You DO need to understand what makes them convert.



Recommend:



Headlines

Offers

Layout

Social proof

Videos

Reviews

Calls to action

Forms

Product presentation

FAQs

Urgency

Guarantees

Mobile improvements



Work with our SEO/web team on implementation.



20. OFFER STRATEGY



A great advertisement cannot always overcome a bad offer.



Develop and test:



Percentage discounts

Dollar discounts

Quantity breaks

Free shipping

Bundles

Free design assistance

Limited-time offers

First-order incentives

Reorder incentives

Referral offers

Volume pricing

Seasonal promotions



Measure actual profitability.



21. A/B AND MULTIVARIATE TESTING



Develop disciplined experiments around:



Creative

Hooks

Audiences

Offers

Landing pages

Headlines

CTAs

 subject lines

SMS

Retargeting windows

Campaign structures



Do not change ten things and then claim you learned something.



Test intelligently.



22. MARKETING AUTOMATION



Design automated workflows using systems such as:



Zapier

CRM systems

/SMS platforms

Lead forms

Webhooks/integrations where available

ManyChat

Other automation platforms



Example:



 Lead >



CRM >



Immediate SMS >



Immediate
 >



Sales notification >



Follow-up >



Retargeting audience >



Conversion tracking.



23. CRM STRATEGY



Help organize customers/leads by:

Product interest

Stage

Customer type

Purchase history

Value

Follow-up status



Marketing should become smarter as our customer database grows.

You determine:

Audience fit

Expected economics

Compensation structure

Affiliate opportunities

Tracking

Offers/codes

Content usage rights

Performance



Creative Lead owns/supports creative direction.



25. ORGANIC SOCIAL STRATEGY



Our VAs can perform repetitive posting.



You determine:



Platform strategy

Posting priorities

Content mix

Frequency

Campaign themes

Promotions

Audience development

Growth opportunities



Do not spend your entire day manually posting.



Your value is strategy and growth.



26. SOCIAL MEDIA VA MANAGEMENT

Examples:

Response templates

Escalation rules

Comment procedures

CRM entry procedures



Use lower-cost execution resources intelligently so your own time remains focused on high-value marketing work.

ROAS

MER

CAC

CPL

 revenue

Margins

You must understand the difference between:

title: Concrete Estimator / Quantity Surveyor
description:
Water Built is an Australian concrete and early works subcontractor based in South East Queensland. We tender concrete packages to head contractors — structural formwork, reinforcement, place and finish, slabs, pavements and civil works — and we are looking for an estimator to take over the measurement side of that work.



WHAT THE ROLE IS



You measure. We price. You will not be asked to build rates, source suppliers or price materials — we apply our own rate library to your quantities. Your job is to produce quantities we can trust without re-measuring.



Typical work:

- Quantity takeoffs from tender drawings: concrete volume (m3), formwork face area (m2), reinforcement tonnage (t), finishes and pavements

- Working inside our Bluebeam Revu tool set, which we provide, so every takeoff is measured the same way every time

- Filling out our standard takeoff template in Excel

- Flagging drawing ambiguities, conflicts and missing information as RFIs before they become pricing errors

- Recording assumptions clearly so anyone can follow how a number was reached



Volume is steady. Tenders come in most weeks and we respond to all of them.



WHAT WE NEED



- Demonstrated concrete and structural takeoff experience: formwork, reinforcement and in-situ concrete specifically. Multi-trade generalists are not the right fit

- Confident reading structural and civil drawings, including reo schedules and section details

- Measurement experience in Bluebeam Revu, PlanSwift, CostX or similar. If you are strong in another package we will train you on our Bluebeam tool set

- Genuine attention to detail. We would rather have a correct number a day later than a fast number that is wrong

- Clear written English. You will be drafting RFIs and assumption notes that go to head contractors

- Overlap with Brisbane business hours (AEST, UTC+10)



Site experience as an engineer or supervisor is a strong advantage. Understanding why formwork gets stripped and re-erected, or why a pour break changes the number, matters more to us than software fluency.



Australian project experience is helpful but not essential. Our template and tool set are the standard you will work to, so we can bridge the gap on local conventions.



HOW WE HIRE



We start everyone with one paid trial takeoff on a job we have already measured, so we can compare your quantities against known-correct numbers. It is paid at your normal rate regardless of outcome.



This is intended to become a long-term, full-time role for the right person, working as part of our team with a Water Built
 address and full software licences provided.

title: Virtual Assistant – Product & Ingredient Researcher
description:

You'll be digging into forums, review sites, and social platforms to understand what people are actually saying, the good, the bad, and the surprising, about the ingredients we use, their causes/effects, and any supporting studies or research.



What You'll Do

Research individual ingredients (e.g., magnesium, NAC, NAD+) to understand: what benefits people report, what people actually experience when taking them, why people take them in the first place, and how they're discussed in health/wellness communities



Research ingredients, compounds, and related topics across:

Reddit (threads, comments, niche subreddits)

Quora (Q&A discussions)

Amazon reviews (product and competitor reviews)

Health/wellness forums, blogs, and news sites

Google Scholar / PubMed for relevant studies (where applicable)



Track and summarize:

Common praises and complaints

Real customer language/phrasing (for later marketing/insight use)

Any scientific studies, clinical data, or credible sources related to ingredients

Compile findings daily into an organized report (Google Sheet / Doc / Notion, whichever you prefer)

Flag anything urgent (e.g., a viral complaint, a trending topic, a notable shift in sentiment)

Stay organized and consistent, this is a recurring daily task, not a one-off project



What We're Looking For

Strong English reading comprehension and written communication

Experience with online research, VA work, or content/social listening

Comfortable navigating Reddit, Quora, Amazon, and general web research

Detail-oriented with good judgment on what's relevant vs. noise

Able to organize findings clearly (spreadsheets, docs, or similar)

Self-starter who can work independently with minimal supervision

Must have some prior experience researching in the health/wellness/supplement space

Bonus: background in health, wellness, skincare, supplements, or a related industry

Bonus: familiarity with basic data/study literacy (reading abstracts, understanding study types)



Tools You'll Use

Google Sheets / Docs (or Notion/Airtable if preferred)



How to Apply



Include the word "blue" somewhere in your application, applications without it will not be reviewed.



Please send:



A short intro about your research/VA experience

An example of a research summary you've done before (if available)

Your availability and preferred rate

This is not an entry-level role. We're looking for someone who has ideally worked within CPG, FMCG, food, or a similar product-based business and understands the level of accuracy required when working with large retailers, distributors, 3PLs, and supply chain partners. You should be comfortable taking a project or operational requirement, understanding what needs to happen, gathering the necessary information, and driving it through to completion with minimal hand-holding.



Work Structure & Requirements



Location: Remote / Virtual

Schedule: Part-time to start (approximately 20 hours per week), with strong potential to progress into a full-time role; HK Timezone

Opportunity: Long-term position working with an international business operating across the US, Europe, and Asia

Key Responsibilities

Manage and maintain accurate product master data including SKUs, UPCs/GTINs, barcodes, case configurations, dimensions, weights, ingredients, and other product specifications

Review product and packaging information for accuracy, including ingredient information and multilingual requirements

Maintain organized and accurate product information across internal databases, retailer portals, and operational documents

Assist with EDI setup and coordination, working with external EDI partners, retailers, and internal stakeholders

Prepare and organize the data required for ERP migration, integration, and system setup



4. Logistics & Supply Chain Documentation



Help manage product, logistics, and supply chain documentation for US import and 3PL operations

Coordinate information between suppliers, factories, 3PLs, retail partners, and internal stakeholders

Track and manage inbound documentation requirements to keep operations on schedule



5. Compliance & Risk Management



Identify missing, inconsistent, or incorrect information before it creates downstream issues

Proactively flag potential compliance, data, or operational issues that could lead to retailer delays, chargebacks, or penalties



Required Skills & Experience



Experience: 3+ years in operations, retail operations, supply chain, or product data — CPG, FMCG, food, beverage, or confectionery experience strongly preferred

Retail Knowledge: Experience supporting brands selling into major US retailers is highly advantageous; familiarity with retailer onboarding, item setup, vendor portals, and retailer documentation

ERP & EDI: Experience working with ERP systems and managing detailed product or inventory data; understanding of EDI and experience supporting EDI implementations is highly preferred

Tools: Strong Excel and/or Google Sheets skills

Communication: Strong written and spoken English; confident communicating with external vendors, retailers, logistics partners, and internal stakeholders

Profile: Exceptional attention to detail, naturally methodical, proactive problem solver — identifies what is missing rather than waiting to be told what to do; comfortable handling large quantities of product information without sacrificing accuracy

Kindly send your resume and introduction video
