title: Grant Researcher & Proposal Writer – Canadian Funding
description:
**Type:** Part-Time – Long-Term Opportunity

**Hours:** 20 hours per week to start

**Location:** Remote – Philippines

**Salary:** Negotiable

**Schedule:** Flexible, with some availability during Canadian Eastern Time



## About the Position



We are a Canadian organization looking for an intelligent, resourceful, and highly organized **Grant Researcher & Proposal Writer** to join our team remotely.



This is **NOT a general Virtual Assistant position.**



Your primary responsibility will be to find funding opportunities in Canada and help us develop strong applications.



We need someone who can independently research opportunities, determine whether we qualify, explain why an opportunity is worth pursuing, and prepare professional funding applications.



## Your Responsibilities



### Grant Research



You will:



* Research Canadian federal, provincial and municipal grants.

* Research foundations, corporate giving programs and community funding.

* Search government funding portals and other grant databases.

* Identify less obvious funding opportunities.

* Determine eligibility before recommending a grant.

* Identify application deadlines, funding amounts and requirements.

* Research relevant statistics and supporting information.

* Identify potential partnerships and other opportunities that could benefit the organization.



### Grant Writing



You will:



* Prepare grant applications and proposals.

* Write Letters of Intent and funding requests.

* Develop needs statements, program descriptions, objectives and measurable outcomes.

* Assist with grant budgets and supporting documentation.

* Edit and proofread applications before submission.

* Ensure applications directly answer the funder's requirements.



### Grant Management



You will maintain an organized Grant Tracker showing:



* Funding opportunity

* Funder

* Amount available

* Eligibility

* Deadline

* Application requirements

* Website/source

* Status

* Date submitted

* Follow-up date

* Result



You will also provide regular updates on upcoming funding opportunities and application deadlines.



## Who We Are Looking For



We want someone who is naturally curious and enjoys research.



You should be the type of person who doesn't stop after the first Google search.



If information is difficult to find, you keep investigating.



You should be able to come back to management and say:



“I researched this opportunity. We appear to qualify because of A, B and C. The maximum funding is X. The deadline is Y. These are the documents we need, and I recommend that we apply.”



We value **accuracy, initiative and judgment** more than simply producing a large volume of applications.



## Requirements



You must have:



* Excellent written English

* Excellent online research skills

* Strong professional writing ability

* Excellent attention to detail

* Ability to work independently

* Strong critical-thinking skills

* Ability to follow detailed instructions

* Strong organizational skills

* Experience with Google Docs and Google Sheets or Microsoft Office

* Reliable computer and internet connection



Previous grant-writing, proposal-writing, research, nonprofit, academic research or government-funding experience is strongly preferred.



Experience researching Canadian, American, UK or Australian grants is an asset.



## AI Use



You may use tools such as ChatGPT to assist with your work.



However, **AI-generated information must never be submitted without verification.**



You are responsible for checking eligibility, deadlines, funding amounts and requirements directly from reliable or original sources.



We are hiring a **researcher and thinker**, not someone who simply copies AI-generated answers.



## HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the words:



**CANADA GRANT RESEARCH**



Applications that do not begin with these words may not be reviewed.



Then answer the following:



1. How many years of research and/or grant-writing experience do you have?



2. What types of grants or funding opportunities have you researched?



3. Have you helped secure any grants? If yes, approximately how much?



4. Have you researched Canadian grants before?



5. What websites, databases or research methods do you normally use to find grants?



6. Describe one difficult research assignment you completed and how you found the information.



7. What is your expected hourly rate?



8. What hours are you available to work?



9. Please provide one writing or research sample.



## RESEARCH TEST



Please complete the following short exercise.



Imagine you are researching funding for a **Canadian nonprofit organization providing residential and community-based programs for children and youth.**



Find **TWO currently relevant Canadian funding opportunities** that the organization could potentially pursue.



For each opportunity provide:



* Name of funding program

* Funding organization

* Website/source

* Maximum funding available, if stated

* Eligibility requirements

* Application deadline

* Why the organization may qualify

* Any restrictions or concerns you identified



**Important:** Verify the information from the original funding source whenever possible.



Do not simply provide two links. We want to see your ability to **research, analyze and make recommendations.**



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an interview.



This is intended to become a **long-term position for the right person.**

title: Content Publishing VA (Claude + Scheduling, Part Time)
description:
Hi! I'm Aaron. I run a personal brand where I teach people how to build a business with AI.



Salary: $120 per month, reviewed at 90 days



I make the content. I need one reliable person to draft the copy and get everything out the door.



Right now I do all of it myself. Writing, uploads, scheduling, across LinkedIn, X, YouTube, TikTok,
, and Instagram. It eats my nights. I want to hand it off.



This starts small. If you're good, the hours and the pay go up.



What you'd do each week



Run my Claude prompts to draft YouTube descriptions, captions, hooks, and titles

Pull finished videos and graphics from a Google Drive folder

Schedule and upload everything across six platforms

Upload YouTube videos with the titles, descriptions, tags, and end screens

Post short clips to TikTok, Reels, and Shorts

Keep a simple content tracker updated

Use Claude Cowork to pull the numbers and build my report three times a week, using a template I give you



Working with Claude



Most of this job runs through Claude.



I'll give you a set of prompts I already use, loaded into a Project with my brand voice and my best performing posts. You'll run them to draft the copy.



You are not inventing the voice. I already built it. Your job is to run the prompt, read what comes back, and know when it's off. Claude will sometimes write something that reads fine but doesn't sound like me. I need you to catch that and run it again instead of shipping it.



You'll also work in Claude Cowork, the agent workspace that handles multi step tasks across files and connectors. That's what builds my report. If you've used Cowork before, say so and tell me what you built with it. If you haven't, tell me honestly and I'll train you. What I won't accept is someone claiming experience they don't have, because I'll find out in week one.



If you've used AI for real work and you have opinions about when the output is bad, you'll do well here. If you've only ever copied whatever the AI handed you, this isn't the role.



I provide the Claude account.



What you don't do



You won't set the strategy. I do that. You won't be on camera. You won't be on calls at odd hours. You won't be asked to build a following from scratch. This is careful, repeatable work.



Who I'm looking for



You've published across multiple social platforms before. Tell me which ones.

You notice details. Wrong thumbnail, missing caption, video posted the wrong way around. You catch those before I do.

You follow a written process exactly, and you ask when something isn't covered.

You reply within one business day.

Your English is good enough to read instructions, judge a draft, and write a clear update.



Nice to have



Basic Canva or Claude Design skills

You've worked with a content creator or a personal brand before



The setup



10 hours a week, flexible. I'm in California. Set your own hours as long as posts go out on schedule. Weekly check in over chat or Loom. Long term role, not a one off project.



How to apply



Put QUEUE MASTER at the top of your message. I read those first.



Then answer three things. Keep them short.



Which platforms you've published to, and which scheduler you used

Have you used Claude Cowork? If yes, what did you build with it. If no, say so and name the AI tools you do use.

A tool you taught yourself recently, and how you learned it



Then do this quick test. Fifteen minutes.



Below are three versions of the same YouTube title. My voice is simple, short, funny, and written the way I talk. No corporate words.



Leveraging AI to Fundamentally Transform Your Content Workflow

How I Post 30 Times a Week Without Losing My Mind

The Ruthless System Top Creators Use To Dominate Content



Tell me which one is mine, and why the other two are wrong. One sentence each.



Then write a fourth title that beats all three.



I'm not testing your writing. I'm testing whether you can tell good output from bad.

title: Remote Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Specialist – Canadian Company
description:
**Type:** Part-Time – Long-Term Opportunity

**Location:** Remote – Philippines

**Schedule:** Must have some availability during Canadian Eastern Time (ET) business hours



## About the Position



We are looking for a proactive and highly organized **Remote Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Specialist** to support recruitment for a Canadian organization.



This is not simply an administrative position.



We need someone who can actively **find qualified candidates, screen applications, conduct initial interviews, verify candidate information, coordinate interviews, and maintain an organized recruitment pipeline.**



You should be comfortable recruiting for positions in areas such as:



* Child and youth services

* Residential support

* Social services

* Healthcare

* Personal support workers

* Nurses

* Developmental service workers

* Child and youth workers

* Management and administrative positions

* Other professional and support positions



## Key Responsibilities



### Candidate Sourcing



* Create and post job advertisements.

* Source candidates through Indeed, LinkedIn, job boards and other recruitment platforms.

* Conduct targeted searches for difficult-to-fill positions.

* Review resumes and applications.

* Identify candidates whose education, experience and qualifications match position requirements.

* Maintain a pipeline of potential candidates for future vacancies.



### Screening & Interviews



* Conduct initial candidate screening.

* Complete telephone or video screening interviews.

* Assess candidates' communication skills, experience, availability and suitability.

* Identify employment gaps or concerns requiring clarification.

* Prepare candidate summaries and recommendations for management.

* Coordinate second interviews with management.



### Recruitment Administration



* Schedule interviews and send interview invitations.

* Follow up with candidates.

* Maintain an organized recruitment tracker.

* Track each candidate through the recruitment process.

* Request references and required employment documents.

* Assist with reference checks.

* Assist with employment offers and onboarding documentation.

* Maintain accurate and confidential recruitment records.



### Recruitment Research



You may also be asked to:



* Research Canadian recruitment platforms.

* Identify new sources for qualified candidates.

* Research typical salaries and hourly rates for positions.

* Research qualification requirements for different professions.

* Identify colleges, professional associations and other potential recruitment sources.

* Develop strategies for difficult-to-fill positions.



## What We Are Looking For



We want someone who takes ownership of recruitment.



You should not wait for management to tell you what to do with every application.



You should be able to review a job description, understand the type of candidate required, search for candidates, screen them and present management with a strong shortlist.



A good candidate recommendation should explain:



**“I recommend interviewing this candidate because they meet the education requirement, have three years of relevant experience, have worked with the target population, and their availability matches the position.”**



We want **quality candidates, not simply a large number of resumes.**



## Requirements



* Previous recruitment or talent acquisition experience.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Strong interviewing and communication skills.

* Excellent online research skills.

* Experience reviewing resumes.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Excellent organizational and follow-up skills.

* Ability to work independently.

* Comfortable communicating professionally with candidates.

* Experience with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Office.

* Reliable computer and internet connection.



Experience recruiting for **Canadian, U.S., UK or Australian employers** is a strong advantage.



Experience recruiting healthcare, social-service, residential-care or community-service professionals is also an asset.



## Performance Expectations



The Recruiter will be expected to maintain an accurate recruitment pipeline showing:



* Position

* Candidate name

* Contact information

* Application date

* Qualifications

* Screening status

* Interview date

* Interview outcome

* Reference-check status

* Documentation status

* Offer status

* Start date

* Follow-up required



Recruitment performance will be assessed based on the **quality and suitability of candidates presented**, responsiveness, organization, accuracy and ability to fill vacancies—not simply the number of applicants contacted.



## HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with:



**CANADA RECRUITER**



Applications that do not begin with these words may not be reviewed.



Please answer the following:



1. How many years of recruitment experience do you have?

2. What types of positions have you recruited for?

3. Have you recruited for Canadian or North American companies?

4. Which recruitment platforms have you used?

5. Have you conducted candidate screening interviews?

6. How do you determine whether a candidate should be shortlisted?

7. Tell us about a difficult position you successfully helped fill.

8. What is your expected hourly rate?

9. What hours are you available to work?

10. Please attach your resume.



## SHORT RECRUITMENT TEST



Imagine you have been asked to recruit a **Residential Support Worker for a Canadian organization supporting children and youth.**



The position requires experience working with vulnerable youth, strong documentation skills, the ability to respond appropriately to challenging behaviours, and the ability to work rotating shifts.



In your application, briefly explain:



1. Where you would look for candidates.

2. What you would look for when reviewing resumes.

3. Five questions you would ask during the initial screening.

4. Three reasons you would reject or not shortlist a candidate.



We are looking at your **recruitment judgment and thought process**, not simply your ability to provide generic answers.



This position has the potential to become a long-term role for the right person.

title: Lead Software Engineer (Full-Stack)
description:
Lead Software Engineer (Full-Stack) — Remote, Philippines



*Company:* Archer Wealth · Sydney, Australia

*Type:* Full-time independent contractor · Fully remote (Philippines-based)

*Hours:* AEST overlap required (PH time is only 2 hours behind Sydney — near-full overlap)

*Compensation:* Php 85,000 - Php 110,000





The role



Archer Wealth is a Sydney-based private credit lender. Our entire technology platform — broker portal, credit workbench, warehouse reporting, loan management — has been built by the founder. It works, it's in production, and it now needs a lead engineer to take ownership of it so the founder can get out of the codebase and back to running the business. You'll be the first dedicated engineering hire, working directly with the founder, with a genuine path to owning the platform end to end.



About Archer Wealth



We're a non-bank lender originating first mortgage, second mortgage, bridging, development, commercial, and caveat loans through an accredited broker channel, funded through institutional warehouse facilities. Small team, real revenue, regulated industry, no bureaucracy. The tech you build moves real money and real loans.



What success looks like in 12 months



You've taken over day-to-day ownership of a multi-app production monorepo, shipped features across the broker portal and credit workbench without regressions, tightened our release and testing practices, and become the person the founder trusts to say "handled."



What you'll do



- Own feature development across a React 18 + Vite monorepo (broker portal, credit workbench, ops tooling, warehouse reporting)

- Build and maintain the Supabase (Postgres) data layer — schema migrations, RLS policies, PostgREST queries

- Maintain integrations: Salesforce (Flows/Apex webhooks), Azure AD auth, Azure Document Intelligence, Claude API document extraction

- Write disciplined, idempotent SQL migrations and respect existing conventions (we have strong opinions and a documented house style)

- Communicate in clear written English: async updates, Loom walkthroughs, honest estimates



What we're looking for



*Required*



- 5+ years full-stack experience with React and modern JavaScript

- Strong SQL/Postgres — you can design schemas and debug row-level security, not just call an ORM

- Experience owning production systems solo or in a very small team

- Excellent written English and a habit of proactive async communication

- Comfortable working within an established codebase's conventions rather than rewriting to your preferences



*Preferred*



- Supabase, Netlify, or Azure AD/Entra experience

- Fintech, lending, or other regulated-industry background

- Salesforce integration experience (Flows, Apex, REST)

- Experience with LLM/document-AI integrations



How to apply



 
 with your CV and a short note on a production system you've owned. Shortlisted candidates complete an online assessment, then a paid 1–2 week trial project.

title: Lead Software Engineer (Full-Stack)
description:
Company: Archer Wealth, Sydney, Australia

Location: Remote, Philippines

Type: Full-time independent contractor

Hours: 40 hours per week, with strong overlap with Sydney business hours

Salary: PHP 110,000 to PHP 140,000 per month



The opportunity

We are a Sydney-based private credit lender with a substantial in-house technology platform supporting our lending business.

Our platform includes:

• Broker portal

• Credit assessment workbench

• Loan management system

• Operations tooling

• Institutional warehouse reporting

• Document automation and AI integrations

The platform is already built, live and used in production.

We are now looking for our first dedicated senior engineer to take day-to-day ownership of the platform, work directly with the founder, and progressively become responsible for the technology function.

This is not a maintenance-only role. You will build new features, improve existing systems, solve production problems and have significant influence over how the platform develops.

What you'll do

• Own feature development across our React 18 + Vite applications

• Maintain and extend our Supabase/Postgres backend

• Design database schemas, SQL migrations and RLS policies

• Debug production issues across the full stack

• Build and maintain PostgREST queries and APIs

• Maintain integrations with Salesforce, Azure and third-party services

• Work with Azure AD / Entra authentication

• Support Azure Document Intelligence and AI-powered document processing

• Build and maintain Claude API integrations

• Improve automated testing, deployment and release processes

• Review existing architecture and improve it without unnecessarily rewriting working systems

• Document important technical decisions and workflows

• Provide clear written progress updates and Loom walkthroughs

What we're looking for

Required

• 5+ years of professional full-stack software engineering experience

• Strong React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript experience

• Strong SQL and PostgreSQL knowledge

• Ability to design schemas, migrations and database logic yourself

• Strong understanding of authentication, permissions and row-level security

• Experience owning or being highly responsible for a production application

• Strong debugging and problem-solving skills

• Excellent written English

• Proactive communication and ability to work independently

• Comfortable joining an established codebase and understanding it before changing architecture

You should be the type of engineer who can be given a problem, investigate it properly, propose a solution and then take responsibility for getting it into production.

Highly regarded

Experience with any of the following would be valuable:

• Supabase

• Vite

• Netlify

• Azure / Microsoft Entra ID

• Salesforce Flows, Apex or REST APIs

• Financial services, fintech or lending

• Regulated industries

• LLM or AI integrations

• Document extraction / OCR systems

• Monorepo architectures

• CI/CD and automated testing

What success looks like

Within 12 months, you will have:

• Taken ownership of the day-to-day engineering of the platform

• Developed a strong understanding of our lending and credit workflows

• Shipped meaningful features across our broker, credit and operations applications

• Improved testing and deployment reliability

• Reduced production issues and regressions

• Improved documentation and engineering processes

• Become the person the business trusts to take a technical problem and get it handled

For the right person, there is significant scope to grow with the company as our technology team expands.

How to apply

Please apply here with:

1. Your CV

2. Your LinkedIn and/or GitHub profile

3. A short description of the most significant production system you have personally owned or been responsible for

4. The size of the engineering team you worked within

5. Your experience with React, PostgreSQL and Supabase

6. Your current monthly salary and expected monthly salary

7. Your availability to start

Please do not send a generic cover letter.

We are particularly interested in hearing what you personally built, owned and solved.

Shortlisted candidates will complete a technical assessment, followed by a paid practical trial project before a final offer.

title: Video Editor for YouTube

YouTube Channel:

We are looking to bring on multiple editors (approximately 10–20) to support consistent content production.

title: URGENT: Experienced Video Editor (PHP 75.000/month + BONUS)
description:
Most editing jobs hand you footage and a deadline.



This one hands you a script. You create everything else.



We're a fast-growing DTC health & beauty brand.



We scale on Meta cold traffic, so the creative is the business. A winning ad pays for months. A loser dies in 48 hours.

We need someone who can build ads out of nothing but AI tools and taste.



Why work for us:



- You earn on every winner. Base salary plus a bonus on every ad that wins. Your ads get real budget. When they perform, you get paid for it. Month after month, as long as it runs.



- You'll get seriously good at this. You'll learn direct response creative from people spending real money every week. Hooks, pacing, angles, why a 3-second open d
 everything. You'll see the performance data on everything you make. Most editors never find out if their work worked. You will.



- You grow with the team. This is a core seat, not a gig. Salary reviewed at 3 months, then regularly. As we scale, this role becomes creative lead. First person in gets that shot.



- You work when you work best. Flexible hours. We measure output, not screen time. Some overlap with the team, the rest is yours.



- Every tool paid for. Higgsfield, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, the full stack. Covered.



- One brand. One direction. No five clients with five opinions. Clear briefs, direct feedback, fast decisions.



What you'll do



You get a script. You deliver a launch-ready ad.



- Build AI avatars in HeyGen that don't look like AI avatars



- Direct ElevenLabs voiceovers with real emotion — we'll teach you our system



- Generate b-roll, product motion and 3D sequences in Higgsfield



- Cut it: pacing, pattern interrupts, sound, captions





Who you are:



- You've edited real DTC ecommerce ads that ran as paid traffic. Not weddings. Not explainers.



- You use AI video tools daily. You need a brief, not a tutorial.



- You can do 3D or motion work — product animation, mechanism visuals, kinetic type.



- You're fast in Premiere, After Effects, CapCut Pro or DaVinci.



- You have taste. You know which cut holds attention.



- You take direct feedback well. "Recut the first 3 seconds" is normal here.



- Solid English. Reliable on deadlines



$1,200 – $1,800 USD/month depending on experience. Plus a performance bonus on every winning ad. Reviewed every month.



How to apply



No DTC ad portfolio = no reply. We need to see ads that ran as paid traffic for real product brands.



Send me:



- 3–5 DTC ads you edited.



- Tell me which is the best one.



- Your AI tool stack. What you use, how often.



- One AI-generated video you've made. Any subject.

title: SEO, GSC & Analytics Specialist
description:
Seeking a highly experienced SEO, Google Search Console, and Analytics Specialist to take ownership of our organic-search performance, technical SEO, conversion measurement, reporting, and performance-recovery planning.



This is not a basic content-publishing, indexing, or keyword-entry position. We need someone who can independently analyze complex performance data, identify declines before management discovers them, determine their likely causes, and develop measurable plans that improve qualified traffic, conversions, and business growth.



Primary Responsibilities



SEO Performance and Google Search Console



* Monitor GSC clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position

* Separate branded and non-branded search performance

* Analyze results by page, query, device, country, and search appearance

* Identify the highest-gaining and highest-declining queries and pages

* Proactively report material ranking, impression, CTR, indexing, and traffic changes

* Diagnose whether losses resulted from rankings, search demand, migration issues, content changes, cannibalization, technical problems, or other causes

* Identify commercial, informational, local, branded, and decision-stage opportunities

* Create and maintain a prioritized keyword-to-URL map

* Identify content overlap, search-intent conflicts, and keyword cannibalization

* Develop recovery plans for declining and underperforming pages

* Monitor completed changes after 7, 14, and 28 days



Reports must go beyond exported data. They must explain what changed, why it matters, which URLs and queries are affected, what actions are recommended, and how success will be measured.



Technical SEO and Website Auditing



* Audit redirects, canonicals, robots directives, XML sitemaps, and indexing controls

* Review HTTP/HTTPS and www/non-www configurations

* Identify 404 errors, redirect chains, broken links, duplicate pages, and crawl issues

* Evaluate website migrations and redesigns for lost URLs, changed content, missing redirects, altered internal links, and ranking impact

* Establish pre-change and post-change baselines for redesigns and major website updates

* Monitor Core Web Vitals, mobile SEO, crawlability, renderability, and page performance

* Review titles, metadata, headings, schema, internal links, and URL architecture

* Determine when pages should be created, updated, consolidated, redirected, retained, or removed

* Maintain a detailed SEO change log

* Coordinate technical implementation with WordPress developers or implement changes directly when qualified and authorized

* Validate significant changes before and after deployment

* Use staging, backups, testing, and rollback procedures for changes that could affect the live website



Repeatedly testing or resubmitting URLs is not considered a substitute for diagnosing the underlying indexing, canonical, content-quality, or technical problem.



GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Lead Attribution



* Audit or configure GA4 and Google Tag Manager from the ground up

* Install and verify GTM and GA4 across the website

* Configure tags, triggers, variables, events, and key events

* Track consultation forms, calls, appointment bookings, signups, CTA clicks, and other qualified lead actions

* Configure source, medium, campaign, landing-page, device, and conversion attribution

* Prevent duplicate, missing, or incorrectly triggered events

* Test configurations through GTM Preview, Tag Assistant, and GA4 DebugView

* Exclude internal, developer, spam, and other inappropriate traffic

* Create useful GA4 reports, Explorations, or Looker Studio dashboards

* Connect organic landing-page performance with engagement, lead activity, and conversion results

* Document the complete tracking configuration and monitor its continued accuracy

* Clearly distinguish general events from actual leads, appointments, enrollments, and other business outcomes



The specialist must understand that increases in total users or events do not automatically demonstrate SEO or business growth. Performance conclusions must separate Organic Search from Direct, Social, Referral, Paid, internal, and unassigned traffic.



Reporting and Performance Accountability



Extensive and accurate reporting is a core requirement of this position. Reports must provide decision-ready analysis—not screenshots, automated summaries, raw exports, or lists of completed activities.



The specialist will establish reliable historical baselines, compare current performance with relevant prior periods, identify developing trends, recommend corrective actions, and measure whether completed actions produced the intended results.



Initial Baseline Report



The initial report must establish the website’s condition before major corrective work begins, including:



* Available historical GSC and GA4 performance

* Pre-redesign, redesign, launch, and post-launch comparisons when data is available

* Current clicks, impressions, CTR, average position, users, sessions, engagement, and qualified lead activity

* Branded versus non-branded performance

* Organic versus Direct, Social, Referral, Paid, internal, and unassigned traffic

* Leading and declining queries, pages, and landing pages

* Commercial versus informational search visibility

* Current indexing, canonical, redirect, sitemap, Core Web Vitals, mobile, and technical status

* Current conversion events, tracking gaps, and attribution limitations

* Confirmed findings, reasonable hypotheses, immediate risks, and recommended priorities



Weekly Performance Report



A complete report will be required every Monday and must include:



* Current 7-, 28-, and 90-day performance compared with corresponding prior periods

* Clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position

* Branded and non-branded search performance

* Top gaining and losing queries

* Top gaining and losing pages

* Organic traffic by landing page

* Qualified leads and conversion rates by source, medium, landing page, campaign, and device

* Significant ranking, indexing, technical, or conversion changes

* Exact URLs affected and supporting evidence

* Work completed during the previous week

* Results of previously completed changes

* Items awaiting recrawl, implementation, additional data, or validation

* Corrective actions for declining performance

* Priorities for the next seven days, ranked by expected impact

* Risks, blockers, and decisions requiring management attention



Monthly Trend and Business-Impact Report



The monthly report must include:



* Month-over-month and year-over-year trends when sufficient data is available

* Progress against established baselines and performance targets

* Commercial versus informational visibility

* Organic traffic quality and engagement

* Consultations, signups, qualified calls, appointments, and other tracked lead actions

* Pages and queries producing meaningful business activity

* Actions that produced measurable improvements

* Actions that did not produce the expected results

* Content that should be retained, refreshed, retitled, consolidated, redirected, expanded, or stopped

* Technical issues affecting growth

* Priorities for the next 30, 60, and 90 days



Change and Validation Reporting



Every significant SEO or analytics change must document:



* Exact URL or tracking component

* Date of change

* Previous condition and baseline

* Problem being addressed

* Supporting evidence

* Action completed

* Person responsible

* Expected result

* Validation method

* Status after 7, 14, and 28 days

* Actual result

* Decision to retain, revise, expand, or reverse the change



Material performance declines, tracking failures, indexing problems, or website issues must be reported when discovered. The specialist should not wait until the next scheduled report when an issue could materially affect rankings, traffic, leads, or website functionality.



Strategy and Performance Planning



The selected specialist must transform data into a prioritized performance plan—not simply provide screenshots, exports, generic recommendations, or lists of completed activities.



The specialist will be expected to:



* Identify and explain material declines proactively

* Separate verified findings from reasonable hypotheses

* Prioritize the highest-impact actions based on evidence

* Create realistic 30-, 60-, and 90-day performance plans

* Establish baselines, targets, and measurable success indicators

* Protect existing informational authority while expanding commercial visibility

* Improve qualified organic traffic, search CTR, service-page visibility, consultations, and lead activity

* Connect work to specific URLs, queries, business objectives, and expected outcomes

* Develop on-page, technical, content, local, and legitimate off-page recommendations

* Review completed work and change direction when the data does not support continuing the same activity

* Communicate risks before making changes that could affect rankings, traffic, tracking, or website functionality



Content and Website Coordination



The specialist will provide or approve SEO content briefs containing:



* Approved topic and working title

* Primary and supporting queries

* Search intent and intended audience

* Create, update, consolidate, or redirect decision

* Target URL

* Existing pages checked for overlap

* Recommended outline and questions to answer

* Internal links and anchor text

* CTA and conversion destination

* Metadata and schema requirements

* Measurement checkpoint



A content and WordPress assistant may implement approved instructions, but the SEO specialist will remain responsible for strategy, performance analysis, and validation.



The specialist is not automatically expected to build complete websites. However, they must be highly trained in WordPress technical SEO and capable of directing developers during redesigns, migrations, page-speed work, plugin changes, and other SEO-sensitive projects.



Advanced Website Development — Preferred



Advanced website-development experience is not required for the core SEO and analytics position, but it is a significant advantage. A candidate who can safely implement complex website improvements—not merely identify or recommend them—may qualify for additional hours and higher compensation based on demonstrated ability.



Preferred development capabilities include:



* Advanced WordPress development beyond basic page builders

* HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and child-theme customization

* Custom post types, templates, hooks, and theme modifications

* Plugin configuration, conflict diagnosis, and safe troubleshooting

* Website migrations, staging environments, backups, and rollback procedures

* Redirect implementation, canonical controls, schema, robots directives, and sitemap configuration

* Core Web Vitals and advanced page-speed optimization

* Database, hosting, CDN, caching, DNS, SSL, and server-level troubleshooting

* Secure form, CRM, API, webhook, and third-party platform integrations

* Mobile-responsive and conversion-focused website development

* Ability to diagnose frontend, backend, plugin, hosting, and performance problems

* Ability to document, test, validate, and safely deploy changes without disrupting the live website



Basic WordPress page building, theme installation, or plugin installation alone will not be considered advanced development experience. Candidates claiming advanced development skills must be prepared to demonstrate them through a live technical walkthrough and provide examples of completed work.



A candidate with verified development abilities may also be assigned:



* Website redesigns and new website builds

* Technical SEO implementation

* Complex WordPress corrections

* Website migration and launch management

* Performance and Core Web Vitals improvements

* Plugin, theme, hosting, and server troubleshooting

* Conversion-focused landing-page development

* GA4/GTM, CRM, form, and API integrations



These additional assignments may increase the available weekly hours and approved hourly rate. Expanded hours, responsibilities, and compensation will be determined by demonstrated skill, project requirements, quality of work, and prior approval.



Required Experience



* Advanced hands-on SEO experience with measurable results

* Expert-level Google Search Console analysis

* Strong GA4 and Google Tag Manager implementation experience

* Proven experience diagnosing and recovering ranking or traffic losses

* Experience managing SEO-sensitive website redesigns and migrations

* Advanced technical SEO and WordPress knowledge

* Strong understanding of keyword intent, content architecture, cannibalization, and internal linking

* Experience configuring lead and conversion attribution

* Extensive experience producing actionable SEO and analytics reports

* Ability to establish historical baselines and interpret short- and long-term trends

* Ability to identify performance problems without waiting for management to point them out

* Ability to prioritize high-impact work instead of repeatedly completing low-impact routine tasks

* Ability to independently validate AI-assisted findings, recommendations, and technical instructions

* Ability to explain complex findings in clear business language

* Strong documentation, testing, prioritization, and reporting skills



Experience within consumer finance, credit, financial services, legal, healthcare, or another high-trust/YMYL industry is strongly preferred.



This Position Is Not a Fit If You



* Primarily rely on AI-generated recommendations without independently validating the data or possessing the advanced knowledge required to correct problems and improve performance

* Can explain advanced SEO concepts in writing but cannot demonstrate them using live data, tools, and real website examples

* Only perform basic content publishing, metadata entry, internal linking, or indexing requests

* Report completed activities without connecting them to rankings, qualified traffic, conversions, or measurable outcomes

* Provide automated reports or screenshots without analysis, trends, causes, recommended actions, and expected results

* Treat impressions, total users, total events, or short-term increases as proof of SEO or business growth without reviewing traffic sources and comparison periods

* Cannot distinguish Organic Search from Direct, Social, Referral, Paid, internal, or unassigned traffic

* Wait for management to identify major performance declines before investigating them

* Cannot diagnose redesign- or migration-related ranking losses

* Recommend continuing routine on-page work when the data indicates a more urgent technical or strategic problem

* Provide generic audits without exact URLs, evidence, priorities, ownership, validation, and review dates

* Make URL, redirect, canonical, plugin, caching, or technical changes without documentation and testing

* Use cache purges, plugin adjustments, or repeated indexing submissions as trial-and-error solutions without identifying the root cause

* Claim expertise in GA4, GTM, technical SEO, or WordPress troubleshooting but cannot demonstrate hands-on implementation

* Cannot work collaboratively with content assistants, WordPress developers, and automation specialists

* Cannot demonstrate experience through a live technical walkthrough



Estimated Weekly Commitment



The anticipated commitment is approximately **15–20 hours per week during the initial audit, GA4/GTM setup, reporting, and SEO-recovery phase**.



After the initial implementation, ongoing SEO and analytics work is expected to average approximately **8–12 hours per week**, depending on performance needs and approved priorities.



Candidates with verified advanced website-development skills may receive additional project hours for approved website builds, redesigns, migrations, technical corrections, performance improvements, and integrations. Major development projects will be scoped and approved separately.



Hours worked beyond the approved weekly schedule must receive prior authorization.



Application Requirements



Please provide:



1. Your requested hourly rate

2. Weekly availability and preferred working schedule

3. Earliest available start date

4. Years of hands-on SEO, GSC, GA4, GTM, and WordPress experience

5. A brief example of a traffic or ranking decline you independently identified, diagnosed, and corrected

6. A brief example of a website redesign or migration you monitored or recovered

7. A brief example of a GA4/GTM lead-tracking system you implemented

8. An example of how your reporting identified a trend and led to measurable improvement

9. The tools you regularly use for crawling, technical SEO, reporting, and performance analysis

10. An anonymized SEO report, technical audit, dashboard, change log, or recovery plan

11. Examples of advanced WordPress or website-development work, if applicable

12. Two professional references or verifiable client reviews, if available



Please answer in your own words. You may use tools to organize your application, but you must be able to independently explain and demonstrate every statement, recommendation, and example during the live verification.



Technical Verification



Final candidates will participate in a live screen-sharing session. During the session, they may be asked to:



* Analyze sample GSC page and query data

* Identify material performance losses

* Separate branded and non-branded search activity

* Diagnose one declining landing page

* Explain how a redesign or migration could have affected performance

* Identify technical, content, reporting, and conversion risks

* Prioritize corrective actions under a limited time or budget

* Explain how results would be validated after 7, 14, and 28 days

* Design a GA4/GTM lead-event tracking plan

* Explain how they distinguish general activity from qualified lead actions

* Demonstrate how they would present findings, trends, and recommendations to management

* Demonstrate advanced development abilities if claiming those qualifications



The purpose of this session is to verify practical experience, independent reasoning, technical ability, reporting quality, and the ability to connect SEO and analytics findings with measurable business outcomes.



Engagement



This is a remote contractor position. Initial hours will be based on the technical audit, analytics setup, recovery priorities, and ongoing performance-management needs.



Continued work will depend on:



* Communication and responsiveness

* Accuracy and independent reasoning

* Proactive identification of problems

* Documented and validated execution

* Reporting quality

* Efficient use of approved hours

* Measurable progress toward qualified traffic, conversions, and business growth



To apply, use the subject line:



SEO & Analytics Specialist – [Your Name]

title: Senior Roofing Estimator – Australian Roofing Experience
description:
Part-Time | Remote



We are looking for an experienced and Senior Roofing Estimator to join our team on a part-time, fully remote basis.



We're specifically looking for someone with strong hands-on experience estimating Australian roofing projects. This is not a general estimating position or for junior estimators — roofing experience is essential.



Minimum Requirements:

- Minimum 3 years' experience estimating Australian roofing projects

- Strong experience completing detailed roofing takeoffs and estimates

- Good understanding of Australian roofing plans, specifications and construction details

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy

- Reliable and able to consistently meet deadlines

- Good written and spoken English

- Available for part-time remote work

- Senior Roofing Experience***



You should be confident estimating items such as:



- Metal roof sheeting

- Flashings and cappings

- Gutters and downpipes

- Fascia

- Valleys

- Roof penetrations and accessories

- Insulation and roof-related components

- Material quantities and wastage



Experience across residential, commercial and architectural roofing projects will be highly regarded.



Software



Experience with takeoff and estimating software is required.



Experience using roofing-specific takeoff or estimating software will be considered a strong advantage.



Please include the software you have used and your level of experience with each.



Experience in Roof Wizard/Applicad is a BONUS! Please list any experience



The Role



You'll be responsible for reviewing project documentation, completing roofing takeoffs and preparing estimates for Australian roofing contractors.



The role is:



- Part-time

- 100% remote

- Ongoing for the right person

- Focused specifically on Australian roofing projects



We're looking for someone who already understands roofing estimating and can become productive quickly rather than someone who needs to be trained in the fundamentals.



To Apply



Please include:



- How many years you've been estimating Australian roofing projects

- The roofing systems and materials you have experience with

- The types of roofing projects you've estimated

- Takeoff/estimating software you've used

- Any roofing-specific estimating software experience

- Your availability and preferred working hours

- Your CV

- Examples of previous roofing takeoffs or estimates, if available

- Any additional trades you have experience in Takeoffs for



Please only apply if you have at least 3 years of hands-on Australian roofing estimating experience.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

title: OpenClaw Agent Engineer - Build AI Agents and Keep Them Running
description:
READ THIS FIRST

 

You must have used OpenClaw before. You must be able to prove it.

 

If you have not used OpenClaw, please do not apply. We will not read your message. We are saying this clearly so we do not waste your time or ours.

 

 

THE JOB IN ONE SENTENCE

 

You build OpenClaw agents. You keep them running. You make them faster, cheaper and more reliable every week.

 

That is the whole job.

 

 

ABOUT US

 

We are a health and wellness company. We sell products online. We have a small remote team in several countries.

 

We are building a team of AI agents to run parts of our business.

 

 

WHAT IS AN AGENT HERE

 

An agent is a small program that does one job. It runs by itself on a timer. Nobody starts it by hand. It runs at 3am while everyone is asleep.

 

We want 10 to 20 agents. Each one does one job.

 

Three real examples:

 

1) STORE WATCHER. Every 3 hours it checks our online shop. Is checkout working? Is any product priced wrong? Are we selling stock we do not have? If yes, it reports. If no, it says nothing.

 

2) INBOX READER. Twice a day it reads
, Slack, Asana and meeting notes. It works out what is waiting on the owner. Then it writes the replies for him to approve.

 

3) COMPETITOR WATCHER. Once a week it checks what our competitors changed. It only reports the changes.

 

Above all the agents sits one main agent. We call it the Chief of Staff. It manages the other agents. It is the only agent that talks to the owner.

 

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 

1) BUILD THE PLATFORM. One AWS account. OpenClaw installed and running on a timer. A safe place to store passwords and API keys. A log of every run. A stop button.

 

2) BUILD THE AGENTS. One at a time. We give you a written brief for each one. You d
 how to build it.

 

3) KEEP THEM RUNNING. This is half the job. An agent that stops quietly is worse than no agent at all, because we will trust a silence that means nothing is being checked.

 

4) MAKE THEM BETTER EVERY WEEK.

- Using too much money? Make them cheaper.

- Too slow? Make them faster.

- Sending too many messages? Reduce the noise.

- Failing sometimes? Find out why and fix it.

 

You will send a short report every week: how many runs, how many failures, how much it cost, and what you improved.

 

5) OWN IT. You will be the only person who understands this system. We need you to write things down so that stays safe.

 

 

YOU MUST HAVE

 

1) OPENCLAW EXPERIENCE. This is not optional. You have installed OpenClaw yourself. You have run it. You have fixed it when it broke. We need proof. See the PROOF section below.

 

2) AWS. You have set up EC2 yourself. You know IAM. You have used Secrets Manager or something like it.

 

3) PYTHON. You write code that runs on a server. Not only in a notebook.

 

4) API EXPERIENCE. REST APIs. OAuth. Webhooks. You have handled rate limits and retries. You have worked with an API that gave you wrong data.

 

5) LLM API EXPERIENCE. OpenAI, Anthropic or similar. Inside real code. Not only in a chat window.

 

6) CLEAR WRITTEN ENGLISH. Most of our work is written. You must be able to explain a technical decision in writing.

 

7) TIME OVERLAP. At least 4 hours per day that overlap with Sydney, Australia business hours.

 

 

PROOF OF OPENCLAW EXPERIENCE

 

Your application must include at least one of these. Two is better.

 

OPTION A - A SHORT SCREEN RECORDING. 2 to 3 minutes. Record your own screen. Show OpenClaw running on your machine or your server. Show the config. Show the logs. Show it doing something.

 

OPTION B - A REPOSITORY. A GitHub link with your commit history, showing your OpenClaw setup or an agent you built for it.

 

OPTION C - A LIVE SYSTEM. Something running now that we can look at, or that you can show us on a call.

 

Screenshots alone are not enough. Anyone can send a screenshot. We need to see you working with it.

 

AND ANSWER THESE FIVE QUESTIONS. These are simple if you have really used it. Please answer all five.

 

1) Did you install OpenClaw yourself, or did you use a one-click hosting service or a template? Both answers are fine. We just need to know which one.

 

2) What machine did it run on? Say the operating system and where it was hosted.

 

3) How did you keep it running after you closed your laptop or logged out? Name the exact method you used.

 

4) Where do you look when you want to see what OpenClaw did? Name the file or the command.

 

5) Tell us about one time it broke. What broke, and how did you fix it?

 

 

PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF

 

- You have never used OpenClaw

- You cannot show us proof

- You have only used no-code tools and never written code that runs on a server

- You want a job where every task is fully explained before you start

- You are sending the same message to many jobs today

 

 

ONE MORE THING, AND WE MEAN IT

 

We need you to tell us the truth about what you can and cannot do.

 

If something is too hard for you today, say so. We will pay for the course. We will give you the time.

 

What we cannot work with is a date that was never real, or a yes that was really a maybe.

 

Before you start each piece of work, we will ask you to rate it from 1 to 10. 1 is very easy. 10 is very hard. We want the real number. If it is an 8, say 8.

 

This is a real part of the job. It is not a nice sentence in a job advert.

 

 

HOW TO APPLY

 

Send a message with all five things below. If anything is missing, we will not read it.

 

1) Start your message with the word HEARTBEAT. This shows us you read the post.

 

2) Your proof of OpenClaw experience. Recording, repository or live system.

 

3) Your answers to the five OpenClaw questions above.

 

4) Your answers to these three questions. Short answers are better than long ones.

 

   a) Tell us about one program you built that ran by itself for 30 days or more. Something broke while nobody was watching. How did you find out it had broken?

 

   b) Your program runs at 3am. Nobody is logged in. It needs an API key to do its job. Where do you keep that key, and why there?

 

   c) Twenty different agents all send messages to one busy person. After one month, that person stops reading them. What do you build so this does not happen?

 

5) Your rate. USD per month, for 40 hours per week.

 

Please write your application yourself. We read a lot of AI writing every day. We are hiring for good thinking, not for good grammar.

 

 

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

 

1) We read your proof and your answers.

2) A 30 minute video call.

3) A paid test project. One week. One small agent. We pay your normal rate. You keep the money even if we do not continue.

4) If it goes well, full time and long term.

title: Senior Account Manager – Healthcare Compliance (B2B, Remote PH)

The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.



MP1 Solutions pioneered the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined compliance programs for decades. Built on the foundation of MedPro Disposal, the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company serving 35,000+ providers across 48 states over the past 15 years, MP1 Solutions extends that operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview:

We're hiring a Senior Account Manager to own a portfolio of mid-market B2B healthcare clients — serving as their single point of accountability, growing the relationship, and protecting long-term retention. This isn't a transactional support role: you'll build executive-level trust, run business reviews, and drive measurable growth within your book of business.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Strategic Client Partnership



• Serve as the executive relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of strategic client accounts.

• Develop trusted partnerships with key decision-makers and executive stakeholders.

• Gain a deep understanding of each client's business objectives, operational challenges, and compliance priorities.

• Act as the client's strategic advisor by recommending solutions that improve business outcomes and strengthen the overall partnership.

• Conduct recurring Executive Business Reviews to demonstrate value, review performance, and align future initiatives.

• Develop and execute a Customer Council program and plan industry conferences, medical compliance forums, networking events, and educational sessions that build a strong MedPro and MP1 community, strengthen customer relationships, showcase the company's expertise and thought leadership, and position MedPro and MP1 as a trusted leader in the medical compliance industry.



2. Client Success & Experience



• Own the end-to-end client experience from implementation through renewal.

• Lead onboarding validation by ensuring services, billing, contacts, and operational expectations are accurately established.

• Monitor customer health and proactively address risks before they impact the client experience.

• Coordinate internal resources to ensure timely resolution of client issues and escalations.

• Drive customer satisfaction, loyalty, and advocacy through proactive communication and continuous engagement.



3. Portfolio Growth & Value Creation



• Develop and execute strategic account plans for each assigned client.

• Identify opportunities to expand partnerships through additional services, compliance solutions, or operational improvements that create measurable client value.

• Lead renewal planning and contract discussions while protecting long-term client relationships.

• Maintain an active pipeline of expansion opportunities within the assigned portfolio.

• Achieve portfolio growth objectives while ensuring every recommendation aligns with the client's business needs and long-term success.



4. Portfolio Health Management



• Own the overall health and performance of an assigned client portfolio.

• Monitor client engagement, retention risks, service utilization, and satisfaction trends.

• Develop recovery strategies for at-risk accounts and coordinate cross-functional action plans.

• Maintain accurate account plans, forecasts, client documentation, and CRM records.

• Utilize portfolio insights and performance metrics to drive continuous improvement.



5. Cross-Functional Leadership



• Serve as the central point of coordination between clients and internal teams.

• Partner closely with Operations, Customer Support, Compliance, Finance, Product, and Sales to ensure a consistent client experience.

• Advocate for client needs while balancing operational capabilities and business objectives.

• Share customer insights to influence product enhancements, service improvements, and organizational priorities.

• Foster collaboration that enables MedPro and MP1 to consistently exceed client expectations.

• 3–5 years of experience in Strategic Account Management, Customer Success, Client Success, Business Development, or • Account Management.  

• Proven experience managing a portfolio of B2B clients while driving client satisfaction, retention, and account growth.  

• Demonstrated success conducting business reviews, renewal discussions, and identifying expansion opportunities.  

• Strong consultative communication and relationship-building skills with multiple stakeholder levels.  

• Experience collaborating across Operations, Customer Support, Finance, Product, and Sales to deliver client outcomes.  

• Proficient in CRM systems, account planning, and customer performance analysis.  

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Healthcare Administration, Communications, or a related field preferred.

• Equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience will be considered.

• A portfolio of mid-market clients — moderate to high complexity accounts requiring active relationship management

•Experience utilizing Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, to prepare executive presentations, account reviews, and business insights.

•Demonstrated ability to handle protected health information (PHI) and confidential client data in accordance with HIPAA and MedPro and MP1's information security policies.

title: Amazon Product Research Specialist – New Seller Account
description:
We are looking for an experienced Amazon Product Research Specialist to help us identify profitable products for a new Amazon seller account.

The main goal is to find ungated, low-risk products with good profit potential that are suitable for a new seller.



Responsibilities

Conduct detailed Amazon product research for wholesale/online arbitrage opportunities.

Find products that are automatically ungated or available for new sellers.

Analyze sales potential, competition, pricing, estimated sales, BSR, reviews, and profitability.

Check product restrictions and seller eligibility before submitting leads.

Calculate estimated profit, ROI, Amazon fees, and potential margins.

Avoid products with excessive competition, poor margins, or high risk of price drops.

Provide accurate product links, supplier/source information, and research data.

Continuously look for new opportunities rather than submitting common or over-saturated products.

Application Requirement – IMPORTANT

To apply, please submit 5 Amazon product leads that meet the following criteria:

Auto-ungated / suitable for a new seller account

Good profit potential

Strong ROI

Reasonable competition

Consistent sales potential

No obvious intellectual-property or listing-risk concerns

Include your estimated buy cost, selling price, Amazon fees, estimated profit, and ROI

Include the Amazon product link and source/supplier link

Do not submit random products. The 5 leads will be used to evaluate the quality and accuracy of your product research.

Ideal Candidate

Previous experience with Amazon product research

Understanding of Amazon FBA fees and profitability calculations

Familiarity with ungating/restriction checks

Able to identify products appropriate for new Amazon sellers

Strong attention to detail

Can provide reliable and well-researched leads

Experience with tools such as Keepa, SellerAmp, BuyBotPro, or similar research tools is a plus

What We Expect

We are looking for someone who can consistently find profitable, realistic opportunities, not just products that appear profitable at first glance.

If your 5 sample leads meet our requirements, we will discuss ongoing product research work.
salary: 500 a month with room to grow

* Short-form educational videos

* Inspirational content

* Travel and lifestyle content connected to the founder’s personality and brand

* Reels based on current trends

* Carousels and educational graphics

* Workshops, courses and educational products



The founder already creates a significant amount of original content, ideas, footage and educational material.



Your job is to turn that material into strong social content and manage the execution.



## Our Bigger Goal



Our goal is not simply to sell through social media.



We want to become one of the most trusted voices in education, literacy and children’s writing.



Our audience should follow because they genuinely learn from the content.



We want parents and educators to think:



“I always learn something from this page.”



“This explains something about my child I hadn’t understood before.”



“I trust what she says about teaching and learning.”



For this reason, we care about more than sales.



We care about:



* Reach and audience growth

* Shares and saves

* Meaningful engagement

* Educational value

* Building trust and credibility

* Strong thought leadership

* Creating content people remember

* Growing a community that sees the brand as a trusted source of education



Commercial results still matter, but they should grow from genuine trust, authority and value — not constant selling.



## What Is Happening Currently



Our current results vary significantly depending on the type of content.



Trend-based travel, funny and inspirational Reels can receive approximately 3,000–4,000 views.



Podcast and educational Reels typically receive approximately 500–1,500 views.



Some professionally designed/static posts receive only around 200 views.



We do not want someone who simply continues creating more content because a calendar needs to be filled.



We want someone who can look at the data, understand what is working, identify what is not working and continuously improve the strategy.



## Your Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



* Researching relevant Instagram and TikTok trends

* Identifying trend opportunities that suit our brand

* Editing short-form Reels

* Editing podcast clips into engaging short-form content

* Creating strong hooks and on-screen text

* Creating selected educational carousels and graphics

* Writing or refining captions

* Repurposing existing content across Instagram,
, LinkedIn and YouTube Shorts

* Scheduling and publishing content

* Maintaining a weekly content calendar

* Organising content for approval before publishing

* Reviewing analytics and identifying what is performing

* Making recommendations based on actual results

* Helping grow the brand into a highly trusted educational voice

* Creating content that teaches, builds authority and expands reach

* Helping social media attention translate over time into trust, enquiries,
 subscribers and business growth



## What We Are NOT Looking For



Please do not apply if your strategy mainly consists of:



* Posting every day just for consistency

* Creating generic Canva graphics

* Using large groups of hashtags

* Following a fixed content calendar regardless of performance

* Producing content without reviewing analytics

* Copying trends that do not suit the brand

* Constantly pushing sales without first building trust

* Creating content that looks polished but teaches very little



We care about quality and impact more than simply filling every posting slot.



## The Ideal Person



You should have strong experience with:



* Instagram Reels

* TikTok-style short-form editing

* CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar

* Canva

* Social media scheduling tools

* Content repurposing

* Trend research

* Hooks and retention

* Storytelling

* Educational or thought-leadership content

* Social media analytics

* Strong written English



Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Higgsfield or similar is a bonus.



You must have good visual taste and understand what modern, premium social content looks like.



Because our primary market is Australia, it is important that you can create content that feels natural to an Australian/Western audience.



## Weekly Scope



The exact volume may evolve based on performance, but an initial week may include approximately:



* 3 short-form Reels

* 1–2 educational carousels or graphics

* Podcast clip repurposing

* Trend research

* Captions

* Cross-platform repurposing

* Scheduling and publishing

* A short weekly performance summary

* Recommendations for the following week



The founder will provide raw footage, podcast clips, educational ideas, voice notes and existing material.



You are expected to take ownership from there.



We want the founder reviewing and approving content — not managing every step of production.



## Compensation



Initial budget:



**USD $400–$600 per month**



Part-time ongoing role.



We are more interested in finding the right long-term person than the cheapest person.



There will be an initial paid trial before an ongoing arrangement is offered.



## To Apply



Please include ALL of the following:



1. A link to your portfolio.



2. Three examples of short-form Reels or videos that YOU personally edited.



3. One or more social media accounts you have personally managed.



4. One example where your content significantly outperformed that account’s normal performance. Tell us:



   * Normal views/reach

   * Views/reach achieved

   * What you believe made it perform better



5. Tell us what tools you currently use for:



   * Video editing

   * Graphic design

   * Scheduling

   * AI/content creation



6. Answer this question:



**If trend-based Reels on an account receive 3,000–4,000 views, educational/podcast clips receive 500–1,500 views, and designed static posts sometimes receive only 200 views, what would you change about the content strategy and why?**



7. Answer this question:



**How would you build an education founder into a trusted authority while still creating content that performs well on social media?**



8. Answer this question:



**How would you use high-reach lifestyle or trend content to strengthen trust in an education brand without making every Reel feel like an advertisement?**



9. Start your application with the words:



**PURPLE PENCIL**



Applications that do not begin with these words will not be considered.



We are looking for someone thoughtful, creative, proactive and commercially aware who understands that the goal is not just to create content — it is to build a trusted, recognisable and highly respected education brand over time.

title: Site Engineer
description:
Job Overview:

The Site Engineer is responsible for supervising construction activities and ensuring that all works are carried out in accordance with approved plans, specifications, and safety standards. The role involves technical oversight, site coordination, and quality control to support successful project delivery.



Job Descriptions:

• Oversee daily site activities, ensuring all work is performed in accordance with project specifications, schedules, and quality standards, while coordinating with site teams to maintain smooth operations.

• Monitor manpower deployment, equipment utilization, and material consumption to ensure efficient resource management, cost control, and alignment with project schedules

• Ensure all project activities comply with established safety, quality, and environmental standards, promoting a safe and sustainable work environment.

• Coordinate closely with Project Managers to ensure timely execution of site works, facilitating smooth communication and efficient workflow on-site.

• Conduct regular site inspections to ensure proper implementation of approved construction methods, maintaining quality, safety, and adherence to project specifications.

• Identify potential technical issues on-site and recommend corrective actions to prevent delays, ensure quality, and maintain compliance with project standards.

• Report daily project progress, site issues, and key accomplishments to the Project Manager, ensuring accurate and timely communication for effective project monitoring and decision-making.

• Collaborate with Project Managers, Planning, Procurement, and Design teams to address project requirements, ensure alignment across functions, and facilitate smooth execution on-site.

• Capture and document daily before-and-after photos of each workstation to track progress, verify work quality, and support project reporting. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports, documenting work completed, site conditions, and any issues encountered to support project tracking and reporting.

• Conduct quality inspections at all project stages and prepare Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs).

• Ensure as-built drawings and technical documentation are properly maintained.

• Verify site measurements and assist in preparing billings and estimates.

• Support in ensuring that permits, inspections, and safety requirements are updated.

• Prepares estimate for all material requirements every two (2) weeks.











Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Industrial Engineering or equivalent.

• Licensed Civil Engineer is advantageous.

• At least 1–3 years of relevant experience in project coordination, admin support, or PMO environment.

• Proficient in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and project management tools (e.g., Notion, MS Project, Planswift, Sketchup, Autocad).

• Knowledge of construction processes and PMI methodologies is a plus

Personal Attributes:

• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to multitask.

• Proactive and capable of problem solving under pressure.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

• Committed to safety and quality.

• Disciplined, hardworking, and adaptable.

• Able to work extended hours or weekends as required by site conditions.
