title: Shopify E-Commerce, SEO & Automation Specialist
description:
Shopify E-Commerce, SEO & Automation Specialist

 

Remote — Philippines | Full-time preferred | Part-time considered

Compensation: Approximately ₱40,000–₱60,000 per month equivalent, paid hourly in Philippine pesos.



About Us

Maikai Wood Hawaii is a Japan-based specialty wood company established in 2000. We manufacture and sell Hawaiian Koa and other specialty woods for guitars, ukuleles, woodworking, furniture and architectural applications.

We already serve customers internationally and are preparing to expand our Shopify operation beyond its initial focus on Japan.

Many of our products are unique pieces or sets of wood, each with its own photographs, dimensions, grade, weight and price. Our immediate priority is getting substantially more inventory online while improving data accuracy and helping customers find suitable products.

 

About the Role

We are looking for someone who can help build, operate and improve our entire product-listing process:

Inventory information → Excel → AI-assisted preparation → validation → Shopify → SEO → search and filters → related products → quality control.

This is more than a product-upload position. We want someone who can organize data, identify repetitive work, develop practical improvements and think about how customers shop.

Website design and Shopify theme development are not the primary focus.

 

Main Responsibilities



Product Data and Shopify Operations

  - Organize product information and photographs with our Japan team.

  - Maintain accurate Excel records for SKUs, species, product types, grades, dimensions, weights, prices and inventory.

  - Prepare, validate and manage bulk product imports.

  - Maintain Shopify products, metafields, tags, collections and product categories.

  - Ensure photographs and specifications correspond to the correct products.

  - Verify published listings and resolve errors.



Excel, AI and Automation

  - Help develop a repeatable inventory-to-Shopify workflow.

  - Use ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot or similar tools to assist with data preparation and content creation.

  - Validate AI output against source information and flag missing details rather than guessing.

  - Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive manual work.

  - Document processes so other team members can follow.



SEO and Product Discovery

  - Research the terminology customers use when searching for our products.

  - Improve product titles, descriptions, SEO titles, meta descriptions and image alt text.

  - Improve collections, search, filters and navigation.

  - Help establish appropriate related products, complementary products and alternatives.

  - Review results and suggest further improvements.



For example, a customer seeking a Concert ukulele wood set might be able to use a larger Tenor set. We want to show that alternative without incorrectly labeling Tenor products as Concert.

Similarly, someone buying a Koa ukulele set should be able to discover an appropriate matching headplate or other useful components.

 

What We Are Looking For

       - Strong Excel or spreadsheet skills and confidence working with structured data.

       - Shopify experience or a strong practical foundation with demonstrated ability to learn.

       - Understanding of product SEO and customer search intent.

       - Experience using AI tools with careful verification of their output.

       - Strong attention to detail, especially with SKUs, measurements, prices and inventory.

       - Clear written and spoken English.

       - Initiative ability to investigate unfamiliar problems and communicate when blocked.

       - Initiative, propose improvements and follow agreed priorities.

       - Interest willingness to learn our products and business processes.



Approximately 1–4 years of relevant experience would be useful, briefly, but demonstrated ability matterspm matters more than years. Strongiagn recent recent graduates are welcome to apply, including relevant.

You do not need previous wood or musical-instrument material knowledge, and do not need to be expert in every tool listed below.

 

Additional Useful Skills

        - Shopify CSV imports, metafields and metaobjects

        - Shopify Search & Discovery, filters and complementary products

        - Keyword research and e-commerce merchandising

        - Excel Power Query or advanced formulas

        - Microsoft Copilot or Power Automate

        - Make, Zapier or APIs

        - Python, VBA or JavaScript



Compensation and Working Schedule

 

Full-time compensation is approximately ₱40,000–₱60,000 per month equivalent. Payment is hourly, in Philippine pesos, based on actual working hours.

The hourly rate will depend on experience, demonstrated skills and performance during the interview and practical evaluation. Exceptional candidates may be considered above the advertised range.

 

Preferred full-time schedule:

Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM–5:30 PM Philippine time, corresponding to 9:30 AM–6:30 PM Japan time.

This provides direct working overlap with our Japan staff.

 

Part-time applicants:

Strong part-time candidates may be considered. You must normally be available for at least four working hours within the 8:30 AM–2:30 PM Philippine-time window. Additional hours outside that window may be agreed upon, although daytime overlap is preferred.

 

Remote Working Arrangements

Microsoft Teams is our central communication and file-sharing platform. You will work directly with our Japan team and business owner.

 

Time Doctor Doctor is required during all Maikai working time. Employees start tracking when beginning Maikai work and stop tracking when they stop. It provides activity reports, monitors computer activity, including keyboard/mouse activity levels, and periodically captures screenshots.

Recorded Maikai working time must be devoted exclusively to Maikai work. Applicants must be comfortable with this system.

 

Our calendar generally follows Japanese business holidays, with some variation. Requests for Philippine holidays can be arranged through advance communication. Holiday and time-off arrangements will be explained before hiring, subject to applicable requirements.

 

We offer a long long-term working opportunity, periodic compensation reviews and additional benefits for established full-time staff. Eligibility and timing will be discussed during the hiring process.

 

How to Apply

Please send your CV, relevant work samples and brief answers to these questions. University and personal projects are welcome.



     1. Shopify: What have you personally done with Shopify? Include experience with bulk imports, metafields, collections, filters or product recommendations.

     2. Excel and automation: Describe a spreadsheet or repetitive process you built, automated or significantly improved. Which tools did you use?

     3. AI and accuracy: How would you use AI to help prepare 300 unique products for Shopify? How would you prevent incorrect SKUs, specifications, prices or invented information?

     4. SEO: How would you research the words customers use to find our products and apply that research to listings?

     5. Product discovery: How would you show potentially suitable Tenor sets to someone seeking Concert sets without mixing them into the Concert filter? How would you show appropriate headplates as add-ons?

     6. Availability: Are you seeking full-time or part-time work? What hours can you work in Philippine time, and when could you start?

     7. Compensation and monitoring: What hourly rate in Philippine pesos are you seeking? Are you comfortable with the Time Doctor requirements above?



Please explain your own experience and reasoning. If you have not done something before, say so and explain how you would investigate it.

 

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a small paid practical test using sample product information. We will assess both the finished result and the process used to produce it.

We value accuracy, initiative, technical curiosity, customer thinking and practical problem-solving.

title: Senior Transport Operations Officer (Dispatch / Fleet Management / Transport Operations)
description:
Job Description

Company: Priority Haulage Limited

Job Title: Transport Operations Officer

Job Type: Remote / Part-Time 

Job Hours:  ~25 Hours Per Week

Reports to: Operations Manager

Direct Reports: Transport Operations Support

Start Date: June 2026



About Priority Haulage

Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. 



Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence.



Job Summary

Priority Haulage is seeking a capable, high-capacity, and dependable Transport Operations Officer to support day-to-day operations within a fast-paced, high-accountability environment.



The role reports primarily to the Operations Manager and works closely with the Financial Controller on systems, process improvement, and operational coordination initiatives.



This position is central to maintaining operational continuity across fleet dispatch, driver management, compliance coordination, and transport administration within a structured, performance-driven business focused on operational efficiency, accountability, and scalable systems.



Role Overview

This role is suited to an operations professional who can consistently deliver reliable outcomes with minimal supervision in a deadline-driven environment. Performance will be assessed based on operational consistency, responsiveness, task completion, communication quality, and ability to maintain established workflows and standards.



Availability & Working Hours

This role requires consistent coverage aligned with New Zealand business operations, including early morning dispatch coordination and operational responsiveness throughout the day.



Core Operational Coverage (PHT)

5:00 AM – 1:00 PM: Primary operational window covering fleet dispatch, job loading, driver coordination, and daily operational tasks.



2:00 PM – 5:00 PM: Flexible operational coverage period supporting job closing activities, operational follow-up, and preparation/loading for the following operational cycle as required.



The role is workflow and task-driven, with hours and workload fluctuating depending on job volume, fleet activity, and operational requirements. Compensation is based on actual hours worked.



Final working arrangements and compensation structure will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate based on operational requirements, workflow demands, and demonstrated capability within the role. The position is expected to require approximately ~25 - 30 hours per week, with baseline workload increasing as operational responsibilities expand.



Job Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities



Fleet Dispatch

• Job Processing

• Job Quality Control



Fleet Management

• Fleet Maintenance Coordination

• EROAD Management

• Fuel Management



Driver Management

• Logbook Compliance

• Leave Management

• Uniform Inventory Management

• Driver Records Management

• Performance Management Support



Operational Support & Administration

• Support cross-functional operational workflows.

• Maintain accurate operational records and documentation.

• Assist with operational coordination and process improvement.

• Support internal communication, task coordination, and workflow follow-up.

• Assist leadership with operational reporting and action tracking where required.



Progressive Responsibilities

The successful candidate will progressively support and coordinate additional operational safety and compliance functions as part of the wider operations role, including:



• Compliance & Risk Support

• Insurance Claims Coordination

• Health & Safety Administration



Required Experience & Capability

Applicants should demonstrate proven experience operating within a structured, deadline-driven transport or logistics environment:

• Minimum 6+ years’ hands-on experience managing high-volume transport dispatch, fleet coordination, and operational workflows.

• Proven experience within transport, logistics, dispatch, or fleet operations environments.

• Strong organisational and commercial judgement, with the ability to manage multiple operational priorities simultaneously.

• Demonstrated experience using Transport Management Systems (TMS), fleet management platforms, dispatch systems, or operational workflow software.

• Ability to operate independently within a remote work environment

• Effective problem-solving capability and operational judgement.

• Intermediate Microsoft Excel capability, including, filtering, sorting, and pivot tables

• A high level of technical proficiency across the Microsoft platform and modern operational business systems, with working familiarity in tools such as:

o Notion

o ChatGPT



Preferred Experience 

• Exposure to New Zealand or Australian transport and logistics environments.

• Exposure to health & safety, driver compliance, and quality control processes.

• Demonstrated ability to improve operational workflows through process optimisation, system improvement, or automation initiatives.

• Exposure to coordinating, supporting, or overseeing operational staff within a structured operations environment.



Personal Attributes

• Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities reliably.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to contribute effectively.

• Proactive and improvement-oriented, with the ability to adapt, optimise workflows, and navigate operational change.

• Professional, dependable, and accountable, with strong follow-through and responsiveness.

• Able to remain calm and organised within a fast-paced operational environment.

• Strong ownership mindset with consistent follow-through and responsiveness.



Required Equipment and Setup

• Dedicated Workspace: Quiet, distraction-free home office suitable for video calls and focused work.

• Computer Requirements (Desktop PC or Laptop):

o Processor: Intel Core i5 or better.

o RAM: Minimum 8GB (16GB preferred).

o Operating System: Windows 10/11, compatible with required business software.

o Internet: Stable high-speed connection (minimum 10 Mbps download/upload).

• Monitor Setup: Dual monitors preferred, or a laptop paired with an external monitor.

• Headset: Noise-cancelling for clear communication during virtual meetings.

• Webcam: High-quality external or integrated camera for video calls.

• Power Backup: Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or generator ensuring at least 3 hours of operational uptime during outages.

• Internet Backup: Secondary internet connection (e.g., mobile data or alternative wireless) for uninterrupted connectivity.



Application Requirement

In your application submission, include the word “Motivated!” in the title.

title: Product Category Manager
description:
PRODUCT CATEGORY MANAGER



Company: EVORETRO

Department:Product & Commercial Operations

Employment Type:Full-Time



 POSITION SUMMARY:



The Product Category Manager is responsible for managing and growing assigned product categories from assortment planning and product development through launch, sales performance, inventory management, and continuous optimization.



This role will work cross-functionally with Product Development, Sales, Marketing, Marketplace, Customer Service, and Supply Chain to ensure that each product category meets customer needs, achieves sales targets, maintains healthy inventory levels, and contributes to overall business growth.



The ideal candidate is highly analytical, commercially minded, organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced e-commerce and collectibles environment.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:



1. Category Strategy & Planning

• Develop and execute category strategies aligned with company goals.

•  Analyze category performance, sales trends, customer demand, and market opportunities.

•  Identify opportunities for category expansion, new products, and product improvements.

•  Maintain a balanced and competitive product assortment.

• Monitor competitor products, pricing, positioning, and market trends.



2. Product Assortment & Product Lifecycle



• Manage the product lifecycle from concept and development through launch, growth, and phase-out.

•  Evaluate existing products and recommend which products should be expanded, improved, repositioned, or discontinued.

•  Work closely with Product Development to identify and prioritize new product opportunities.

• Ensure product information, specifications, pricing, images, and other required assets are complete and accurate.



3. Sales & Category Performance



• Monitor sales performance by SKU, product, and category.

• Track revenue, units sold, margins, conversion, and other relevant KPIs.

• Identify underperforming products and develop corrective action plans.

• Recommend pricing, promotions, bundles, and merchandising strategies to improve performance.

• Work with Sales and Marketing to maximize product visibility and revenue.



4. Inventory & Forecasting



•  Collaborate with Supply Chain and Operations to maintain appropriate inventory levels.

• Monitor inventory movement, sell-through, stock levels, and potential stockouts.

• Provide input into demand forecasting and purchasing decisions.

• Identify slow-moving and excess inventory and recommend appropriate actions.

• Coordinate product launches with inventory availability.



5. Product Launch Management



•  Coordinate new product launches across relevant teams.

• Develop launch timelines, priorities, and required deliverables.

•  Ensure products are ready for launch across e-commerce and marketplace channels.

•  Coordinate with Marketing regarding launch campaigns, promotions, content, and product positioning.

•  Monitor post-launch performance and recommend adjustments.



 6. Marketplace & E-Commerce Optimization

title: Delivery & Operations Manager
description:
We need the person who makes sure nothing gets missed.



We're an established Australian growth agency in a highly regulated health sector, building brands, websites, CRM systems and lead nurture journeys — plus internal brands of our own: a 20,000-member community, an education platform and a product brand. Small senior team, founder-led, heavily AI-integrated: Claude is part of daily work here, and it will be part of yours.



This is a project management and delivery operations role first. There is systems work in it, but if you're mainly a funnel builder looking for build hours, this isn't your seat. We're hiring the person who runs the machine while our specialists do the work.



What you'll own:



The board (the core of the job). Client requests arrive by portal,
, Slack, WhatsApp and Messenger — every one becomes a ClickUp task the same day, with an owner, a due date and a brief clear enough that the assignee knows what "done" looks like. You run all active projects across ~10 client accounts: deadlines, dependencies, blockers, scope. Nothing client-facing gets missed. This outranks everything else in the role.



The weekly rhythm. Monday planning with the founder, Wednesday board audit, Friday end-of-week report, weekly per-account check-ins, monthly client performance reports, fortnightly payroll submission. The rhythm already exists and is documented — your job is to run it without being chased, then improve it.



The team's delivery. A senior designer, developer, video editor and social media manager do the work — you brief them, sequence them, chase them and QA against our standards. When something's overdue with no comment, you're the one in their DMs asking what's blocking, with a deadline attached.



The clients. Delivery-side client communication: clarifying requests, chasing approvals and assets, running webinar and newsletter logistics, keeping clients informed without the founder in the loop. Clients deal with you for delivery; the founder for strategy.



The founder. He is the bottleneck on approvals — that's the honest reality of a founder-led agency. You manage the review queue, batch it, chase it with consequences attached ("if this isn't approved by Thursday, the send moves"). If managing your own boss sounds uncomfortable, stop reading. If it sounds like the missing piece of every PM job you've had — keep going.



The systems (the minority of the week, and it matters). Our stack is GoHighLevel, ClickUp, WordPress, Pabbly/n8n, AgencyPro. You don't need to be a master builder — but you need to be technical enough to administer GHL (contacts, workflows, calendars, sub-accounts), make small website updates without a developer, troubleshoot an automation, and write SOPs as processes stabilise. You'll work alongside AI tools daily to draft, document and automate.



You're probably a fit if:



You've spent 3+ years running delivery in an agency or multi-client environment — briefing specialists, chasing deadlines, managing clients — and you can tell us about specific projects you kept on the rails

You're a ClickUp (or Asana/Monday) power user who has actually run a team's board, not just your own tasks

You've administered a CRM — GoHighLevel ideally, or HubSpot/Keap/ActiveCampaign with confidence you'd pick GHL up fast

You're comfortable in WordPress for content edits and small fixes

You chase people — clients, teammates, the founder — directly, politely and relentlessly, and you ship work when an input is missing rather than letting a small blocker stall a whole deliverable

You use AI tools daily as working tools, not novelties

You're the person who notices the overdue task with no comment, the brief with no due date, the form with no success message



Bonus: GHL building experience (funnels, sequences),
 marketing, basic analytics (GA4/Search Console), Shopify, SOP libraries you've written, regulated-industry experience (health, finance, pharma).



The deal: Independent contractor, 30–40 hrs/week, AUD $12–22/hr depending on experience. 13th-month pay after 12 months. 90-day trial with written goals at day 30, 60 and 90 — you'll know exactly what success looks like. Minimum 6 hours/day overlap with AEST, with the request channels monitored morning, midday and end of day. Long-term seat reporting directly to the founder.



How to apply —
 
 with:



A note first: we use AI daily and expect you to. But these questions are about your actual work — if an AI could answer them without you, you've answered them wrong. Specifics, names, numbers and screenshots win.



Your CV.

Proof you've run a board. One screenshot from inside a ClickUp/Asana/Monday workspace you personally managed (blur client names), plus 3–5 sentences: how many people and projects it covered, and one thing you changed about how it ran.

Written answers — from your history, not a textbook:

Tell us about a deliverable that was about to miss its deadline because something was missing — an asset, an approval, an answer. What was missing, what did you actually do, and did it ship?

Tell us about chasing an approval from someone senior to you — who (role, not name), what was stuck, what did you actually say, and what happened?

Describe the messiest client request you've ever received. What did it say, what did you ask, and what did it become?

A 2–3 minute video (camera on for the intro, then screen share): 30 seconds on you — who you are, where you're based, what you're into outside work. Then walk us through a project or board you ran — show the actual thing on screen. Finish by answering this out loud, unscripted: it's Monday 9am, you've got 30 tasks across 6 clients, two are blocked on client assets, one deadline slips tomorrow, and the founder just Slacked you something "urgent" — talk us through your first hour.

title: Performance Video Editor (High Salary)
description:
Performance Video Editor

Exchange Life · Fully Remote · Full-Time Contractor · ~40 hrs/week $10–20 USD/hour depending on experience + uncapped performance bonuses



About Exchange Life

Exchange Life is one of the fastest-growing e-commerce travel jewellery brands in the US. We sell collectible country charms for traveller's, with new products launching soon. Our content machine has generated over a quarter billion views across TikTok and Instagram.



This role is video, end to end. You'll concept and cut short-form video ads for paid media across TikTok, Reels, and Meta placements, where every edit is judged on what it does to hook rate, retention, and spend. You're not making brand films or organic filler. You're making the creative we put budget behind.



We're looking for an editor who can own their output and be creative within proven marketing fundamentals, not just execute tasks. This is not a gig; it's a long-term partnership. Many of our editors have been with us 2+ years, and the people who now set our creative direction started as editors here.



You'll work closely with our Content Lead and Marketing team. We're a small, high-output team that moves fast, communicates daily, and invests in the people who show up.



Where You'll Be in Six Months

Senior Performance Video Editor.



That's the next title, and it's within reach inside your first six months if your work earns it. At that level you have full creative autonomy: you own video concepts end to end, you d
 which angles we test next instead of receiving briefs, your creatives are the ones we put real spend behind, and you start reviewing other editors' cuts and shaping how they work.



It's d
 by performance, not time served. Move faster if your work moves faster.



Compensation & Earning Potential

Base: $10–20 USD/hour depending on experience

Performance bonuses: Uncapped, paid per winning creative. Every video that hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid ads pays out.

Rate reviews: Revisited as you take on more, not on an annual calendar

Our top editors earn meaningfully more than their base because they produce winners consistently. That's the whole design: we'd rather pay a lot for creatives that work than a little for creatives that don't.



What Success Looks Like

After 3–6 months, a successful hire is consistently producing short-form video ads that scale on paid and perform organically, hitting 50%+ thumb-stop rates and 30%+ hold rates, and iterating on winning formats without needing direction from the marketing team. You'll be a trusted creative partner, not just an executor.



Core Responsibilities

Concept and edit short-form video ads for TikTok, Reels, and Meta, built around hook rate, retention, and watch time rather than aesthetics

Develop new video angles and hooks, then test them against our proven formats

Build AI-assisted video creative using current tools, and keep pace as those tools change

Review your past edits daily, identify what's working and what isn't, and improve without repeating mistakes

Work directly from paid performance data to d
 what to cut next

Turn around content quickly and communicate proactively every day, with no check-ins required

Stay on top of TikTok and Instagram trends and apply them where they'll actually convert

Must-Haves

A strong recent portfolio of short-form video edits, ideally including paid ad creative (20+ from the last few months)

You can watch a winning video ad and break down exactly what made it work

Hands-on experience across video formats: hook-led headline videos, talking heads, voiceovers, UGC-style edits, AI video

Ability to read metrics (hook rate, retention, watch time, spend) and know what to change in the next cut

Takes ownership, internalizes feedback, doesn't repeat the same mistake twice

Highly skilled in CapCut Pro or a comparable editing tool

Strong written and spoken English; able to work independently

Nice-to-Haves

Experience cutting video ads for e-commerce or DTC brands

Experience working directly against Meta or TikTok ad account data

A track record of creatives that scaled on paid

What You'll Learn Here

Most editing jobs teach you software. This one teaches you why video sells.



Direct access to paid performance data on real ad spend, so you see exactly which of your creatives print and which die

1-on-1 mentorship from our Content Lead

Paid courses and software, including the AI video tools you'll be working in

A portfolio backed by numbers, not vibes. "This cut did 4M views and scaled to $X/day" is a career asset that follows you.

Not a Fit If

Your portfolio is mostly long-form, YouTube, or event/wedding content

You can't point to a recent video ad and explain why it performed

You want to make beautiful videos more than videos that sell

You need a fixed schedule or close supervision to stay productive

You're looking for a short-term project or side gig

Working Style

Engagement: Independent contractor, paid in USD

Location: 100% remote

Hours: ~40 hrs/week, long-term role

Schedule: Fully flexible. Work whenever you want, as long as you turn work around quickly and communicate daily (async). No timezone overlap required.

Time off: Flexible PTO. Take the time you need, just coordinate with the team.

Tools: CapCut Pro (or comparable), AI video tools, TikTok/Meta analytics

Working style: No micromanagement

It takes about 5 minutes. We review every application.



APPLY HERE:

title: Full-Time Performance Static Ads Editor (AI workflow + Creative Strategy)
description:

What we mean by "concept"



A concept = a genuinely different creative hypothesis — different mechanism, avatar, emotion, belief, visual format, etc.



1 concept = 3–5 genuinely differentiated static executions with different designs/formats built around the same underlying strategic hypothesis.



We are NOT looking for 12 headline swaps.



READ THIS SECTION CAREFULLY.



APPLICATIONS THAT DO NOT MATCH WILL BE REJECTED INSTANTLY.



You should NOT apply if:



❌ You have never created paid Meta static ads for a DTC ecommerce brand.



❌ You've had less than $100,000 USD in ad spend tested behind the statics you've created collectively.



❌ You are primarily a graphic designer, not a performance creative operator.



❌ You rely entirely on manual design and do not have an AI-powered production workflow.



❌ You are applying to "learn" performance marketing. This role is for experienced operators.



If any of the above describes you, please do not apply. It'll waste both our time.



You SHOULD apply if:



✅ You focus heavily on copywriting, messaging (Design itself is easy with AI)



✅ You've created static ads for 7–9 figure DTC brands or agencies serving them.



✅ You understand direct-response psychology, not just good design.



✅ You can take a strategic angle and develop multiple genuinely different creative hypotheses from it.



✅ You've built AI workflows that let you produce high-quality creative at volume.



✅ You're obsessed with making winners, not filling folders.



✅ You get daily inspiration of top static ads



What you'll do



- Produce 12 static concepts/week, with 3–5 executions per concept

- Turn research-backed angles into high-performing Meta statics

- Create meaningful creative variations across avatars, mechanisms, emotions, beliefs, and hooks

- Use AI tools to dramatically increase production speed

- Analyze winning creatives and feed learnings back into future concepts

- Work directly with our creative strategy team — not from generic briefs



Must already be strong at



- Meta direct-response static ads

- Copywriting / messaging for paid ads

- Photoshop / Figma

- AI image generation (Flux, Midjourney, Ideogram, GPT Image, etc.)

- Prompting with Claude Code or Codex

- Understanding angles and creative hypotheses

- Fast iteration and high-volume testing



Non-negotiables



- Fast and responsive — communication is everything

- Reliable on deadlines — no chasing

- High standards for quality control before review

- Organized files and repeatable systems

- Coachable under direct, no-fluff feedback



HOW TO APPLY — REQUIRED



Applications missing ANY item below will be auto-rejected.



1. Start your application with the exact phrase:



Static Ready



2. Share ONE static ad that had your strongest performance.



Do NOT send a portfolio.



Include:



The final creative

The ad spend tested behind it

3. In 3–5 sentences, explain WHY it worked.



Break down:



The hook

The psychological angle

The avatar

Why someone stopped scrolling

4. Show us your AI workflow in Loom.



Record a 3–5 minute Loom walking through how you go from:



Research → Idea → AI generation → Final launch-ready static



NO portfolio links.



We care about your thinking and performance, not your website.



What we offer



$1,500/month + $300–$500 per winning image (SEE ALL ANALYTICS in Atria)



Uncapped performance bonus



Remote — work from anywhere



A team that moves fast, tests aggressively, and values great creative over hierarchy.



The right candidate will move to a paid trial week within 48 hours.



— Ash, Co-Founder

title: SEO Specialist
description:
About GlowMD



GlowMD Aesthetics & Wellness Institute is a physician-led aesthetics and wellness practice in Katy, Texas.



We provide personalized aesthetic, skin, medical weight management, and wellness services. We are looking for an experienced SEO Specialist to help more potential patients discover GlowMD through Google and turn organic website traffic into inquiries and bookings.



This is a hands-on SEO role for someone who enjoys improving rankings, researching opportunities, optimizing websites, and seeing their work contribute to real business growth.



Your Main Goal



Help GlowMD increase its organic visibility and qualified local traffic, with the ultimate goal of generating more patient inquiries and booked services.



We are not looking for traffic just to increase a number on a report. We want the right people finding GlowMD when they are searching for the services we provide.



What You'll Work On

SEO Strategy

• Develop and implement an ongoing SEO strategy

• Conduct keyword and search-intent research

• Identify high-value local search opportunities

• Research competitors and identify ranking opportunities

• Monitor keyword rankings and organic performance

• Recommend new pages or content opportunities based on search demand

• Local SEO



GlowMD serves patients in Katy, Texas and surrounding communities, so local SEO will be an important part of this role.



You will help:



• Improve visibility for relevant local searches

• Optimize our Google Business Profile

• Strengthen location signals across our website

• Research local keywords and competitors

• Improve consistency of business information online

• Identify citation and directory opportunities

• Recommend strategies to improve local search visibility

• Website SEO



You will review and optimize existing pages for:



• Page titles and meta descriptions

• Headings and page structure

• Keywords and search intent

• Internal linking

• Image optimization

• URLs

• Service-page content

• Local relevance

• Calls-to-action

• Technical SEO issues



You should also be comfortable identifying issues that may be preventing pages from ranking or converting.



Content & Blog SEO



GlowMD regularly publishes educational content about aesthetics, skin health, wellness, medical weight management, and treatments.



You will help determine:



• What topics we should target

• Which keywords have the best opportunities

• How existing blogs can be improved

• How blogs should link to our service pages

• Which content gaps exist

• How content can support both rankings and patient inquiries



You will work alongside our content/social media team rather than being responsible for producing all marketing content yourself.



SEO Audits & Technical SEO



You should be comfortable reviewing the website for issues such as:



• Indexing problems

• Broken links

• Duplicate content

• Page speed

• Mobile usability

• Core technical SEO issues

• Sitemap and crawlability

• Schema opportunities

• Search Console errors



You do not need to be a web developer, but you should be able to identify issues, explain their importance, and recommend or implement solutions when appropriate.



Traffic to Bookings



Ranking is important, but it is not the final goal.



We also want you to look at what happens once someone reaches our website.



You may recommend improvements to:



• Service pages

• Calls-to-action

• Booking pathways

• Page structure

• Website messaging

• Internal links

• Mobile experience

• Conversion opportunities



The goal is to create a stronger journey from:



Google Search → GlowMD Website → Inquiry → Booking



Who We're Looking For



You may be a good fit if you have:



• Proven SEO experience

• Experience with local SEO

• Strong keyword research skills

• Experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics

• Understanding of on-page and technical SEO

• Experience improving organic website traffic

• Understanding of SEO content strategy

• Experience with competitor analysis

• Understanding of conversion optimization

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Good written English

• Clear communication

• Ability to work independently and meet deadlines



Experience with healthcare, medical spas, aesthetics, wellness, beauty, or other local service businesses is a plus, but not required.



What Success Looks Like



Your key performance indicators will include:



• Increased organic website traffic

• Improved rankings for relevant local keywords

• Increased Google search visibility

• Growth in qualified organic leads

• Increased inquiries originating from organic search

• Improved organic lead-to-booking conversion

• Improved performance of key service pages

• Consistent progress in local SEO visibility



We understand that SEO takes time. We are looking for steady, measurable improvement rather than unrealistic promises of overnight rankings.



Compensation



Base Pay: $7/hour



How to Apply



Please submit your application through OnlineJobs.ph only and include:



• A short introduction about yourself

• Your SEO experience

• Your local SEO experience

• Examples of websites you have worked on

• Examples of measurable SEO results

• Case studies, screenshots, or reports if available

• SEO tools you regularly use

• A short explanation of how you would approach SEO for a medical spa serving Katy, Texas



Want to Stand Out?



This is optional, but applicants who would like to demonstrate their skills may provide a short SEO audit of:





We are not asking for a full unpaid SEO project.



Please provide approximately 5–10 bullet points covering:



• Key SEO issues you notice

• Keyword opportunities

• Local SEO opportunities

• Content opportunities

• Any website conversion opportunities you notice

• Your top priorities for the first 30 days



We are more interested in how you think and prioritize than in receiving a lengthy audit.



Who Will Thrive in This Role



We are looking for someone who is knowledgeable but also willing to learn, test, and improve.



You should be comfortable working independently, communicating your recommendations clearly, looking at data, identifying opportunities, and explaining what is and isn't working.



We don't expect you to promise #1 rankings.



We want someone who can build a strong SEO foundation, consistently improve GlowMD's organic visibility, and help connect more potential patients with our services.



Only applications submitted through OnlineJobs.ph will be considered. Thank you!

title: Funding Specialist - Business/Personal Funding
description:
Funding Specialist (Funding Success Manager)



**Fourth Quarter Consulting | Part-Time with ability to expand to Full-Time| Remote**



We help business owners get approved for $50K to $150K+ in funding through credit card stacking and personal loans. Our clients are strong borrowers with 700+ credit and clean profiles.



We're looking for a Funding Specialist to own the client experience from the moment they sign to the moment they're funded and paid. Right now that work lives in the founder's head. Your job is to take it off his plate and run it better than he could.



This is not a call center role and it's not a lead-blasting role. You'll manage a small book of high-value clients and make each one feel like they're the only one you have.



## What you'll own



- Pull and read client credit reports, then build a funding strategy: which cards, in what order, the limits to expect, and the timeline.

- Walk clients through prep so their profile is application-ready. Utilization down, no stray inquiries, business entity set up if it's needed.

- Run the application stack on schedule and log every approval, decline, and limit as it comes in.

- Keep clients calm and informed through the 2 to 4 week funding process with clear updates that go out on time, every time.

- Produce the final funding report, send the invoice, and follow through until the payment actually lands.

- Check in after funding to line up repeat rounds and referrals.

- Keep the CRM clean and current. If it's not in the CRM, it didn't happen.



## What we're looking for (MUST HAVE)



- You've read tri-merge (3-Bureau) credit reports before and you know what a fundable profile looks like. This one is non-negotiable.

- You understand credit card stacking and personal loan funding, or you've worked right next to it and you pick things up fast.

- You're the kind of organized where nothing slips. You can carry 8 to 10 active clients at once without dropping a step.

- Your written and spoken English is clean and professional. Clients trust you inside the first five minutes.

- You actually like working with clients. You follow up before they have to chase you.

- You're independent. Give you a goal and a playbook and you run with it. You don't need someone standing over your shoulder telling you what to do next.



## Nice to have



- Experience in credit repair (CFPB, FTC, DisputeFox) as well as funding.

- Time spent in a CRM like GoHighLevel, Notion, ClickUp

- You've helped build or tighten up SOPs, not just followed them.



## What you get



- A real book of high-value clients, not a spammy cold list.

- Playbooks and templates so you're not guessing. Where they don't exist yet, you'll help build them.

- Direct access to the founder. No layers, no politics. 1-1 directly under the founder.

- Room to grow into running the whole fulfillment side as we scale.



## How we'll measure you

## You'll know exactly what winning looks like. Once you're ramped, here's what we expect:



- Strategy docs out fast. Every funding strategy delivered within 3 business days of a client signing.

- Clients funded on time. Average client goes from signed to funded in 21 to 28 days. Nobody sits stuck in a stage longer than 7 days without you flagging it.

- Follow-through. 85%+ of your clients complete their prep and application steps on schedule, because you're staying on them.

- Money collected. Final report and invoice out within 3 business days of the last approval, and payment confirmed within 7 days of funding.

- Nobody goes dark. Every active client hears from you at least once a week with a real update, not a "just checking in."

- CRM stays current. Statuses and notes updated the same day, every day. No end-of-week catch-up.

- Referrals and reviews. A testimonial and referral ask on every client once they're funded and happy.



## How to apply



Send us:



- Your resume

- 2 to 3 sentences on your credit and funding experience. Be specific about what you've actually done, not what you've read about.

- One example of a time you kept a client on track through a process with a lot of moving parts.



Use the subject line: **"Green Light"**



Applications without that subject line or without real credit experience won't get read. We work in the details here, so show us yours.

title: Full-Time Video Editor — Short-Form + Long-Form Real Estate Investing Content (Vertical Reels & YouTube)
description:
Capital Unlimited is a real estate investing education and funding brand built around a working professional's real story — 21 properties, $10M+ in combined portfolio and transaction volume, built in five years while still holding a full-time corporate job. We publish two kinds of video content, both scripted in detail before they ever reach an editor:



Short-form vertical reels (Instagram + TikTok + YouTube Shorts, 9:16, 20–90 seconds) — talking-head teaching pieces, occasional gym/lifestyle b-roll cuts, and branded carousel-style slide reels.

Long-form YouTube videos (25–35 minutes, 16:9) — single-camera teaching videos with branded diagram graphics cut in at specific moments, following a written script with exact cue points for every cut.

We're looking for a full-time editor to become the dedicated hands on this pipeline — someone who can take a finished script (with its own recording notes and editing notes already written out) and a folder of raw footage, and turn it into a publish-ready file that matches our established house style every time, without needing hand-holding on the basics of what to do.



What you'd actually be doing week to week:



Cropping and reframing landscape or mixed-aspect raw footage into clean 9:16 verticals, keeping the subject centered even when the source footage shifts position mid-clip.

Cutting long-form videos to full-screen branded diagram graphics (navy background, gold accent) at exact moments named in the script — e.g. "cut to diagram-X.png exactly on 'the phrase that triggers it'" — and holding them for the specified duration.

Burning in clean, readable captions (one to two lines, centered lower third) across every piece, short-form and long-form alike, in a consistent style.

Loudness-normalizing audio so every piece plays at a consistent volume, and building simple instrumental beds into pieces that call for music (most don't — we deliberately use a lot of raw synced audio, no music, no text labels; you'll be told exactly which is which per piece).

Adding on-screen exercise/step labels to lifestyle and process b-roll where a script calls for it, checked against reference frames rather than guessed.

Doing occasional subtle punch-ins on specific lines the script flags as needing emphasis.

Delivering QA'd exports — every long clip gets checked end-to-end before it's called done, not just spot-checked.

Turning around a batch of reels or a long-form video within an agreed window, and flagging clearly (not silently guessing) if a script's instructions are ambiguous or footage is missing something the script assumes exists.

You will almost never be asked to make creative judgment calls about story, message, or structure — that part is already done before you get the file. Your job is precise, consistent execution against detailed written instructions, plus enough editorial eye to flag it when something in the raw footage doesn't match what the script assumes.



Requirements / Qualifications

2+ years of paid video editing experience, ideally with real portfolio examples of short-form vertical content (reels/TikTok/Shorts) and longer-form talking-head YouTube content — not just one or the other.

Fluent, comfortable working in Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut (tell us which is your main tool).

Strong, demonstrated eye for 9:16 reframing — cropping wide/landscape footage into vertical without losing the subject, including footage where the subject moves within the frame.

Experience burning in captions cleanly (style consistency matters more than fancy animation here).

Working knowledge of audio loudness normalization (you don't need to know the term "LUFS" going in, but you should already know audio has to be leveled consistently across a channel, not eyeballed per clip).

Comfortable following a detailed written script with named cut points and timing instructions, and matching them precisely rather than improvising a different cut.

Strong written English — you'll get instructions in writing, and you'll need to flag issues in writing too. This matters more than verbal English.

Reliable, fast home internet and the ability to handle large 4K source files without constant upload/download friction.

Available for real-time or near-real-time communication during a reasonable overlap with US working hours (exact overlap negotiable, but total radio silence for 12+ hours during a deadline week is a dealbreaker).

Nice to have, not required:



Basic motion graphics ability (simple lower-thirds, text animation) beyond static caption burn-in.

Familiarity with ffmpeg or command-line video tools.

Prior experience editing content in the real estate, finance, or coaching/education niche.



How to Apply

To help me filter for people who actually read this whole posting: start your application with the words "Cut on the cue" as the first line.



Please include:



Your resume.

A link to your portfolio or reel — ideally including at least one 9:16 vertical piece and one longer talking-head YouTube-style edit, so I can see both skills.

Which editing software you use as your main tool.

Your available start date and your current time zone / working hours.

One or two sentences on the largest volume of recurring weekly content you've edited for one client or channel before (we publish multiple reels a week plus regular long-form videos, so pipeline experience matters).



Shortlisted applicants will be given one real (paid) test edit from our actual pipeline before any longer-term offer, so you can see the real workflow and we can see real output under our actual instructions.

title: Wholesale Business Development Manager
description:
Wholesale Business Development Manager — Canvas Factory (Philippines, Remote)

About us



Canvas Factory is an Australian online photo-to-canvas and wall art business. We're growing a wholesale/trade arm — partnering with photographers who print through us at wholesale rates, and supplying canvas and wall art at trade pricing to hotels, property developers, stagers, and interior designers across Australia and New Zealand. We use AI-assisted tools to research prospects and send the first outreach touch; this role is where the human relationship takes over.



The role



We're looking for an experienced, high-energy Business Development Manager to drive new wholesale sales. You'll work warm leads (replies from our outreach campaigns), re-activate dormant accounts, and close new business — then hand each new customer off to our Account Manager for ongoing support, freeing you up to keep hunting for the next one.



This is a hunter role, not an order-taker role. We want someone who's energized by the chase, comfortable on the phone with people they've never spoken to, and disciplined enough not to let details slip when things get busy.



Key responsibilities

Respond promptly and professionally to inbound replies from our outreach campaigns (photographer wholesale partnerships and B2B trade/wall art) — qualify interest and move genuine prospects toward a sale.

Proactively call previous wholesale clients who haven't placed an order in over [X] months to re-engage them and win back repeat business.

Own the full sales cycle for new wholesale/trade accounts: qualifying, pricing conversations, objection handling, and closing.

Keep CRM records accurate and current — every call, reply, and deal stage logged properly (no lead falls through the cracks).

Once a new customer is secured, hand over a clean, complete account file to the Account Manager for ongoing support.

Flag hot leads, market feedback, and any recurring objections back to the business.

What we're looking for



Must-have:



Solid, demonstrable track record in B2B sales or business development — you can point to accounts you've personally won.

Confident, natural phone manner — genuinely comfortable cold-calling and re-engaging lapsed clients, not just handling inbound.

Excellent written and spoken English (you'll be corresponding and speaking directly with Australian and New Zealand businesses).

Strong attention to detail — accurate CRM records, no dropped follow-ups, nothing promised to a client that isn't followed through on.

Self-driven and high-energy — this role has real autonomy and we need someone who brings their own motivation, not someone who needs to be chased.

Experience with a CRM (HubSpot, Zoho, or similar) — or a fast learner if not.



Nice-to-have:



Experience selling to trade/wholesale channels, or B2B experience in print, wholesale goods, property, hospitality, or interior design.

Experience working with Australian or New Zealand clients specifically.

Hours



Full-time. We need meaningful overlap with Australian business hours (AEST/AEDT) so calls and live conversations with AU/NZ clients can actually happen during their working day — exact schedule to be confirmed with the successful candidate.



Compensation

Base: AUD $1,600/month, full-time.

Plus commission: a large, uncapped commission on each new wholesale account you close — details and exact structure to be finalized. [We'll confirm the exact % or bonus-per-account structure before this goes live — see note below.]

Tools you'll use



CRM (HubSpot or Zoho — final choice TBD),
, phone/video calling tools, and our outreach system that surfaces warm replies for you to work.



How to apply



Please send your CV along with a short note on a wholesale/B2B deal you're proud of closing and how you closed it. Include your available start date.
salary: AUD$1600 per month plus uncapped comm.

title: E-Commerce Specialist (Remote)
description:
Description

Let’s start with the perks 

☕ Work with one of Australia’s leading specialty coffee brands  

🌏 Join a B Corp, and 1% for the Planet brand  

🏡 Remote role based in the Philippines, working with a Sydney-based team (minimal time difference and no commute)  

📚 Learning and development opportunities  

🎯 Quarterly Performance Bonus 

🩺 HMO Program  

🌱 Volunteer and training leave  

☕ P&R coffee delivered to your place every month  

💡Work somewhere that genuinely values their Team, doing things differently, using tech and innovation and delicious coffee to change the world! 



Oh, and we get the team together each year in the Philippines for an epic gathering! 





A little about you 

You’re the kind of person who notices when a product page is almost right, but not quite. 



A banner is slightly off. A mobile layout could convert better. A promo flag has not been updated. A landing page could be cleaner, faster, sharper. You spot it, you fix it, or you find a smarter way to make sure it does not become a recurring problem. 



You know Shopify (inside and out). Not just “I can update a product description”… But “I can get into the theme, understand what is going on, and build or improve a page using Liquid, HTML and CSS”. You have a practical eye for UX, layout, hierarchy and mobile experience, and you care about whether the online store is easy to use, accurate, on-brand and performing properly. 



You’re organised, curious and detail-driven, not someone who wants to spend their days doing the same manual audit over and over again. You like building templates, SOPs, better ways of working and simple automations that make the job cleaner and easier next time. Work smarter, not harder. And yes, AI is a tool, not a threat when you know how to use it well. And your favourite time of year is when Shopify drop their seasonal updates. You’re quickly thinking about the application of the updates and if it aligns with our strategy and mission! 



Most importantly, you care about doing good work with great people. You’re happy working with cross functional Team Operations, Marketing, Design and Customer Support. You’re confident turning numbers, feedback and site performance into clear recommendations people can actually act on. 





About us 

Pablo & Rusty’s Coffee Roasters is a specialty coffee roaster based in Sydney, Australia. We’re a proud B Corp, Carbon Neutral Certified, and 1% for the Planet members meaning we give 1% of our revenue (not profit) to environmental partners. We’re 100% committed to using business as a force for good. 



Our mission is to positively impact people and the planet through coffee. We source specialty coffee, roast with care, support cafe partners, and help more people Drink Better Coffee™ at home, at work and beyond. 



We are digital, design-centric and sustainability-led. We have high expectations, we move quickly, and we are always looking for ways to improve how we work. We strongly believe that if we are not spending at least 10% of our time innovating, we will not succeed. 





About the role 

This is first and foremost an e-commerce role. We’re looking for an E-commerce Specialist with strong Shopify build capability, someone who understands how to improve the performance, accuracy and customer experience of an online store. Shopify build skills are important, but they’re only one part of the role.



This is a hands-on Shopify role with a strong mix of platform build, content updates, campaign support, reporting and catalogue accuracy. You’ll help keep the store clean, current and easy to use, while also building custom landing pages, supporting promotional campaigns, maintaining product information, and helping stakeholders understand what is working online and what needs to improve. 



This is not a role for someone who only wants to pass tasks on to developers or rely entirely on page-builder apps. We need someone who is comfortable getting into Shopify, working with themes, building properly, testing carefully and using good judgement. 



Okay, you’re mid way through this ad, congrats but to help ensure you’re not just using AI tools to skim the job post, make sure you include “Buy Better Coffee Online” in your application subject line. 



You’ll work closely with Operations, Marketing, Design and Customer Support to make sure the online store is accurate, on-brand, commercially useful and improving over time. 





A few things you’ll be across 

- Owning Shopify theme customisation, including hands-on use of Liquid, HTML and CSS 

- Building and maintaining sections, templates and custom landing pages 

- Keeping the Online Store 2.0 structure and theme configuration clean, current and easy for others to use 

- Applying practical UX and conversion judgement to page layout, hierarchy and mobile experience 

- Managing website content, including homepage, category pages, landing pages, promo flags, navigation and seasonal campaign content 

- Working closely with the Marketing team to execute the promotional calendar as it relates to e-com outputs. 

- Setting up and testing promotions in line with planned campaign activity 

- Coordinating assets for new product launches, sales, campaigns and e-commerce changes with Design, Marketing and the wider team 

- Supporting end-to-end online e-commerce projects, from stakeholder briefing through to testing 

- Providing real-time and monthly reporting on campaign, product and site performance 

- Translating reporting into clear, useful recommendations, not just sending raw numbers 

- Maintaining sources of truth for performance data that stakeholders can reference directly 

- Monitoring stock and maintaining accurate catalogue information 

- Auditing the site and assets to make sure all available products are live, current and accurate 

- Supporting and optimising subscription operations through Recharge 

- Building SOPs, templates and automation where possible to reduce manual catalogue and audit work over time 





What you’ll bring 

- Minimum two years’ experience in a similar Shopify-focused e-commerce role 

- Advanced Shopify experience, including hands-on theme customisation with Liquid, HTML and CSS 

- Confidence building custom landing pages and templates without relying only on third-party page-builder apps 

- Practical UX and conversion design sense, especially around layout, hierarchy and mobile experience 

- Strong attention to detail and a high standard for accuracy 

- Good written and verbal communication skills 

- Confidence working with stakeholders across Customer Support, Design, Marketing and Operations 

- Ability to turn data and reporting into clear, practical recommendations 

- Comfortable working independently across time zones, while still being part of a collaborative team 

- Confidence using Microsoft 365 systems, tools and a willingness to learn new apps, plugins and systems. Bonus points if you’ve got Microsoft Business Central experience. 

- A continuous improvement mindset, you notice repetitive work and look for better ways to get it done 



Highly regarded 

- Experience with Recharge or a comparable subscription app 

- Experience with Yotpo or a comparable rewards app 

- Experience with Shopify Plus, including Plus migration experience 

- Familiarity with Figma or a similar design/collaboration tool 

- Experience in online coffee, food and beverage, retail, subscription, or multi-channel e-commerce (including Amazon, TikTok Shop, Google Shopping) 

- Experience using AI or automation tools to improve workflows and reduce manual effort 





What success looks like 

- The online store is accurate, organised, current and easy to manage 

- Product catalogue data is clean, reliable and well maintained 

- Campaigns and assets are turned around within agreed timelines 

- Promotions are uploaded, tested and launched accurately 

- Reporting leads to clear recommendations and better decisions 

- Manual audit effort reduces over time through SOPs, templates or automation 

- Stakeholders have confidence in the store, the data and the way campaign work is coordinated 

- You help make the e-commerce function smarter, cleaner, more scalable over time and ultimately a more profitable channel 





What’s in it for you 

First up: we want this role to be one of the best jobs you’ve ever had. That is our commitment to everyone in our team. 



That does not mean the work will always be easy. It will be detailed, fast-moving and sometimes full of competing priorities. But it will also be rewarding. You’ll be working with a team that genuinely cares about our mission, our customers, our impact, and each other. 



You’ll have the chance to grow your skills, improve systems, work on meaningful e-commerce projects, and help a purpose-led coffee brand keep building a better online experience. This role will be part of our growing e-com Team. 



We offer a generous package, Quarterly Performance bonus after probation, HMO Program after one year of tenure, Volunteer and Training Leave, Philippine Public Holidays converted to Annual Leave credits, access to ongoing learning and development, and an Employee Assistance Program. 



And importantly, you’ll get P&R coffee delivered directly to your place every month. 





Work schedule 

This is a full-time independent contractor role, 40 hours per week. 



The role is remote and based offshore, with working hours to overlap with Sydney business hours Monday to Friday, AEST/AEDT. Specific hours will be agreed based on business needs. 





Sounds like your kind of role?

Send us your resume and cover letter (Resume without cover letters won’t be considered), plus: 



A link to one live Shopify store you’ve personally built or theme-customised (yours, a client’s, or an employer’s), with a sentence or two on one specific section or page you built using Liquid, HTML or CSS, and why you built it that way. 

One thing you’d change on 
 right now, why and how you’d actually build that change in Shopify. 





Let’s make great coffee easier to find, buy and enjoy. ☕
