title: Full Time WordPress & Shopify Website Specialist
description:
We are an Australian business looking for a reliable, experienced WordPress and Shopify Website Specialist to join our team full time.



This is a long term position for someone who wants to work directly with one company rather than manage multiple freelance clients.



You will be responsible for helping manage and improve several of our websites across different parts of the business, including corporate websites, ecommerce, software and digital signage.



What You Will Be Doing - Your main responsibilities will include:

• Managing and updating multiple WordPress websites

• Managing and updating our Shopify ecommerce website

• Creating and editing website pages

• Updating products, content, images and website sections

• Making layout and design changes within existing themes and page builders

• Maintaining website content and keeping information up to date

• Reviewing websites for errors, broken links and general issues

• Uploading and formatting articles and other content

• Performing basic on page SEO work

• Updating page titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal links and website content

• Helping improve existing pages based on SEO recommendations

• Reviewing website content before it is published

• Using Google Analytics, Search Console and other tools to understand website performance

• Monitoring competitors and identifying ideas or opportunities we could implement

• Supporting the team with ongoing website improvements

• Using AI tools to help with research, content, website management and repetitive tasks



Over time, there may also be opportunities to help us improve internal workflows and introduce more AI and automation across the business.



You will not be expected to solve complex development problems alone. We have access to developers for larger technical issues.



What We Are Looking For

You should have:

• At least 2 years of hands on WordPress experience

• At least 2 years of Shopify experience, or strong practical Shopify experience

• Experience actually managing websites, not simply uploading blog posts

• Ability to create, edit and update pages independently

• Basic understanding of SEO

• Strong written and spoken English

• Excellent attention to detail

• Ability to proofread content and identify obvious mistakes before publishing

• Good problem solving skills

• Ability to follow documented processes and checklists

• Confidence learning new software and AI tools

• Reliable internet connection and your own computer

• Ability to work independently and communicate clearly with our Australian team



Experience with any of the following would be an advantage:

• Google Analytics 4

• Google Search Console

• Google Merchant Center

• Ecommerce SEO

• Product feeds

• Basic HTML or CSS

• Canva or basic image editing

• ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or other AI tools

• CRM or marketing automation platforms



Hours - This is a full time role of 40 hours per week.



We are specifically looking for someone who can treat this as their primary full time position.

Please do not apply if you are currently managing several other full time clients or intend to outsource the work to another person or team. We want to work directly with the person completing the work.



Salary

We are open to discussing salary based on your experience and capabilities.

For the right person, we expect the role to be around 70,000 PHP - 100,000 PHP per month, depending on experience.



There is room for the role and compensation to grow as you become more involved in the business.



We are looking for someone who can eventually take ownership of the day to day management of our websites.

That means we should be able to give you a task such as:

“Update this page.”

“Add these new products.”

“Improve the SEO on these pages.”

“Review what our competitors are doing.”

“Create this new website section.”

and trust that you can work through it carefully, ask questions when necessary and bring the task through to completion.

We value reliability, initiative and attention to detail more than someone who claims to know every tool.



How To Apply

Please include the following in your application:

A short introduction about yourself.

How many years of experience you have with WordPress.

How many years of experience you have with Shopify.

Links to 3 websites you have personally worked on, and briefly explain what you did on each one.

Describe the most complex WordPress or Shopify task you have completed yourself.

Tell us about your SEO experience.

Tell us which AI tools you currently use and how you use them in your work.

Confirm whether you are currently working for any other clients and approximately how many hours per week you spend working for them.

Confirm that you are looking for a full time 40 hour per week position.

Tell us your expected monthly salary in USD.



Start your application with the words DIGITAL SIGNAGE so we know you have read the entire job description.



We will shortlist a small number of applicants for an interview and may provide a short practical task before making a final decision.

title: Sales Call Center Director (New York #1 Med Spa Business)
description:
Call Center / Sales Development Director — High Performance Appointment Setting Team (Med Spa)



Position: Remote

Type: Full-time

Compensation: Up to $4000 monthly (Base + Bonus)



We're one of New York's fastest-growing aesthetics companies. We have 5 locations in New York, and are expanding to 20 locations by the end of 2027.



We run advertising at scale, and every lead that comes in is greeted by our appointment-setting team within minutes. This team is the engine of the business — and we're looking for the person who will run it. We already have a team of 8 in house appointment setters, which will double in size over the next year. We are looking for a driven and experienced leader to take ownership of this Philippines Appointment setting team.



This is not a role where you manage a queue and file reports. You will live in the call recordings, the dial data, and the conversion metrics. You will know within a week which setter is fumbling the price objection, which script line is killing bookings, and which hour of the day we're leaving money on the table. Then you'll fix it.



If you're the kind of person who gets a little obsessed with a 3-point lift in book rate, keep reading.



What You'll Own:



Coaching & Development



Run daily huddles and weekly 1:1s with every setter

Listen to and score calls every single day; deliver specific, recorded-example-based feedback

Build and maintain a call-scoring scorecard covering opening, discovery, objection handling, urgency, and close

Own onboarding and ramp for new setters — get new hires to full productivity fast, with a documented ramp plan

Side-by-side and live-listen coaching; roleplay objections until they're automatic



Performance Management:



Own the team's KPIs and report on them daily: dials, contact rate, set rate, show rate, and setter-sourced revenue

Identify underperformance early, build written improvement plans, and follow through — including tough calls on who stays

Run performance rankings and make coaching time proportional to opportunity, not seniority

Partner with leadership on incentive design, contests, and spiffs that actually change behavior



Operations & Scripts:



Own the scripts, rebuttals, voi
 templates, and SMS/follow-up cadences — and A/B test them relentlessly

Manage a 24/7 coverage schedule across a mix of US-based and offshore team members, including nights and weekends

Monitor speed-to-lead and hold the team to a minutes-not-hours standard on new inquiries

Keep CRM hygiene tight: disposition accuracy, pipeline stage integrity, no lead left untouched

Work directly with marketing on lead quality feedback, and with clinic/closing teams on smooth handoffs



Hiring & Team Building:



Recruit, interview, and hire setters as we scale

Build a culture people want to compete inside of — high standards, real recognition, zero drama



How You'll Be Measured:



Appointments set per setter, per day

Lead-to-appointment conversion rate

Show rate on booked appointments

Speed-to-lead (time from opt-in to first dial)

Setter-sourced revenue

Team retention and ramp time for new hires

You'll have a dashboard. You'll defend those numbers weekly. And when they move in the right direction, you'll get the credit.



Who You Are



Required:



5+ years managing or supervising an outbound sales, appointment-setting, inside sales, or high-volume contact center team

A track record you can actually talk through in numbers — "I took set rate from X to Y in Z months"

Genuinely strong at coaching: you can pull up a call, diagnose the miss in 30 seconds, and give feedback that sticks

Comfortable in a CRM and dialer environment; you build your own reports rather than waiting on someone else's

Data-literate — pivot tables, conversion math, and cohort comparisons don't scare you

Available for a schedule that covers a 24/7 operation, including some evenings and weekends

Direct, thick-skinned, and accountable. You raise problems early and own outcomes.



Nice to Have:



Experience in med spa, aesthetics, healthcare, or another high-volume consumer lead-gen environment (Preferred)

Experience managing offshore or remote agents

Familiarity with GoHighLevel, Zenoti, or similar CRM/booking platforms

Experience building QA scorecards or training programs from scratch



Who This Is Not For



Anyone who needs a fully built playbook handed to them

Anyone who manages by dashboard and never listens to a call

Anyone who's uncomfortable holding people accountable



What We Offer:



Competitive Compensation

Paid time off and paid holidays

Real ownership of a function that directly drives company revenue

A leadership team that makes decisions fast and gives you room to run

Clear growth path as we expand across additional Manhattan locations



TO BE ELIGIBLE, respond with a video recording (minimum 2 minutes) introducing yourself, your most recent role and why you think you would be a good fit for this role.

title: Commercial Lead Research & CRM Virtual Assistant
description:
# Commercial Lead Research & CRM Virtual Assistant



**Remote | Part-Time | Long-Term Opportunity**



## Compensation & Schedule



* **Pay:** $3-$5 per hour based on experience 

* **Initial schedule:** 10–15 hours per week

* **Initial research period:** September–December 2026

* **Location:** Remote

* **Opportunity for continued long-term work based on performance**



## About the Company



We are a New Jersey-based professional pressure washing and exterior cleaning company that currently serves residential and commercial customers.



Our primary growth objective for 2027 is to significantly expand the **commercial side of our business** and develop long-term relationships with commercial properties and organizations.



We are building a dedicated commercial prospecting system consisting of:



**Research Department → CRM Database → Calling Department → Qualified Opportunities → Owner/Sales → Estimates & Contracts**



We are hiring a highly organized, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to handle the **research and database-building portion of this system.**



*VIRTUAL ASSISTANT WILL BE IN CHARGE OF BUILDING CRM SYSTEM FOR COMPANY*



This is NOT primarily a cold-calling position.



Your responsibility will be to identify high-quality potential commercial customers, research their contact information and decision-makers, and accurately enter and maintain this information in our CRM so our calling team can focus on making calls.



---



# Your Primary Objective



Your goal is to build/create and continuously maintain a large, accurate database of potential commercial customers for our exterior cleaning services.



Our calling department should be able to open the CRM, select the next prospect, and immediately have the information needed to make the call.



**We do not want our callers spending their paid calling time searching Google for phone numbers, websites, property managers, or company information.**



Your research makes their calling possible.





Our long-term goal is to transition the company toward a predominantly **commercial exterior-cleaning business**, while continuing to service residential customers.



Your research will directly contribute to achieving these goals.



---



# Commercial Prospects You Will Research



You will research commercial properties and organizations throughout our assigned New Jersey service territories, including but not limited to:



### Highest-Priority Prospects



* Condominium communities

* Homeowners Associations (HOAs)

* Apartment complexes

* Multifamily communities

* Property-management companies

* Commercial property-management companies

* Country clubs

* Golf courses

* Wedding venues

* Event venues



### Additional Commercial Prospects



* Hotels

* Resorts

* Senior-living communities

* Assisted-living facilities

* Shopping centers

* Strip malls

* Commercial plazas

* Office buildings

* Commercial campuses

* Restaurants

* Restaurant groups

* Franchise locations

* Swim clubs

* Community pools

* Private pools/facilities

* Schools

* Daycare facilities

* Churches and religious facilities

* Municipal buildings

* Municipal facilities

* Public facilities

* Warehouses

* Industrial properties

* Car dealerships

* Medical facilities

* Gyms and fitness centers

* Other commercial properties that could reasonably require professional exterior cleaning or pressure washing



You should also identify **companies that manage multiple properties**, as these may represent especially valuable opportunities.



---



# Information Required for EACH Prospect



Accuracy is extremely important.



Each qualified prospect should contain as much of the following information as reasonably available:



### Required Basic Information



1. Business/property name

2. Commercial category/property type

3. Full property address

4. City

5. County

6. Main business telephone number

7. Company/property website

8. General business
 address, when available

9. Google/business listing information when relevant



### Decision-Maker Information



Research the person most likely responsible for hiring exterior-maintenance contractors.



Potential titles include:



* Property Manager

* Community Manager

* Regional Property Manager

* Facilities Manager

* Facilities Director

* Maintenance Manager

* Maintenance Director

* General Manager

* Operations Manager

* Director of Operations

* Purchasing Manager

* Procurement Contact

* HOA/Condominium Association Manager

* Other relevant decision-maker



When publicly available, collect:



10. Decision-maker's full name

11. Job title

12. Business telephone number

13. Business/direct telephone number, if publicly available

14. Business
 address

15. LinkedIn/profile information when useful and publicly available



**Do not collect private or inappropriate personal information. We are looking for legitimate business contact information.**



### Property/Company Intelligence



When reasonably available, also research:



16. Property-management company

17. Parent company/ownership organization

18. Approximate property size

19. Approximate number of buildings

20. Approximate number of units for condos/apartments

21. Other properties managed by the same management company

22. Other locations owned/operated by the same organization

23. Relevant notes that could help our calling team



For example:



**ABC Condominium Association → managed by XYZ Property Management → XYZ manages 11 additional communities.**



That relationship is extremely valuable and should be documented.



---



# CRM Responsibilities



You will be responsible for accurately entering and maintaining all research inside our CRM/database.



Every record should be:



* Complete

* Properly categorized

* Properly formatted

* Free of obvious spelling errors

* Checked for duplicate entries

* Assigned to the correct geographic area

* Assigned to the correct commercial category

* Updated when better information becomes available



You may also receive records from our calling department marked **"Research Needed."**



For example, a caller may discover that a condominium is managed by a particular property-management company. Your responsibility may then be to research that management company, identify the appropriate contacts, determine what other properties it manages, and add those opportunities to the CRM.



You are expected to keep our commercial prospect database organized, useful, and continuously filled with new contacts (potential customers)



---



# Productivity Expectations



We care about **quality AND quantity**.



Entering hundreds of inaccurate names and phone numbers is not acceptable.



Spending an entire hour researching only a few basic business phone numbers is also not acceptable.





These numbers are performance targets, not permission to sacrifice accuracy.



Some high-value prospects may require additional research, particularly large condominium communities, apartment complexes, property-management companies, country clubs, and wedding venues.



**One thoroughly researched property-management company responsible for 20 properties can be more valuable than 20 poorly researched businesses.**



---



# Priority System



Prospects will generally be categorized by potential value.



### A — HIGH PRIORITY



Examples:



* Large condominium/HOA communities

* Large apartment complexes

* Property-management companies managing multiple properties

* Large country clubs

* Golf courses

* Large wedding/event venues

* Multi-location commercial organizations



### B — MEDIUM PRIORITY



Examples:



* Hotels

* Senior-living facilities

* Swim clubs

* Shopping centers

* Commercial buildings

* Schools

* Large churches

* Medium-sized commercial facilities



### C — STANDARD COMMERCIAL PROSPECTS



Examples:



* Individual restaurants

* Small commercial buildings

* Smaller businesses

* Other potential commercial exterior-cleaning customers



You should always prioritize **quality, high-value commercial opportunities** over simply generating the largest possible number of records.



---



# What Success Looks Like



When you are doing your job successfully, our cold-calling team should NEVER have to spend significant time searching for companies to call.



They should be able to:



**Open CRM → Review Prospect → Call → Record Outcome → Call Next Prospect**



Your responsibility is to keep that pipeline full.







---



# Who We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate is:



* Extremely detail-oriented

* Organized

* Reliable

* Efficient

* Comfortable performing extensive online research

* Experienced with CRM systems or willing to learn quickly

* Experienced with spreadsheets/databases

* Able to follow written instructions EXACTLY

* Able to work independently

* Comfortable researching businesses and commercial properties

* Able to verify information rather than guessing

* Strong written English skills

* Consistent with formatting and data entry

* Able to recognize duplicate information

* Able to understand company relationships and decision-maker roles

* Comfortable being measured against weekly productivity goals



Experience researching property managers, real estate companies, facilities managers, commercial businesses, or B2B prospects is a major plus.



---



# IMPORTANT — APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



**Attention to detail is extremely important for this position.**



We receive many applications. One of the first things we will evaluate is whether you carefully read this entire job posting and followed the instructions below.



To apply, please do ALL of the following:



### 1. Use this exact subject line:



**COMMERCIAL RESEARCH 2027**



### 2. Begin your application with this exact sentence:



**“I read the entire Commercial Research job description and understand that accuracy and attention to detail are essential.”**



### 3. Answer these five questions:



**A.** Tell us about your previous experience researching businesses, leads, properties, or decision-makers.



**B.** What tools or websites have you previously used to find business contact information?



**C.** What CRM systems have you previously used?



**D.** If you discovered that one property-management company manages 15 condominium communities, explain what you would do with that information.



**E.** In 2–3 sentences, explain what you believe the main purpose of this position is.



### 4. Final Attention-to-Detail Test



At the **very end of your application**, after answering all five questions, write:



**LWPWS*



Do not place these words anywhere else in your application.



Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly may not be considered.



---



# Final Note



This position is extremely important to the growth of our company.



We are not looking for someone to simply copy and paste business names.



We are looking for someone who can help us build a **high-quality commercial prospecting database** that our sales/calling department can continuously work from.



The information you gather will directly support our effort to acquire commercial pressure-washing and exterior-cleaning contracts throughout New Jersey.



If you are organized, efficient, reliable, excellent at online research, and take pride in accurate work, we would like to hear from you.

title: Marketing Operations Manager
description:
LEAD THE CREATIVE OPERATION. THEN HELP BUILD WHAT COMES NEXT.

Creative Production is the center of this role at the start. You will manage the editors, own the production system, raise the quality of the work, and make sure strong creative moves from brief to final asset without senior leadership having to manage every detail.



This is not a coordinator role. It is not a virtual-assistant role. We need a Marketing Operations Manager who can operate the day-to-day work and improve the system at the same time.



A NOTE FROM OUR CMO

Before applying, watch this short video from our CMO about the role, its expectations, and what success looks like:





Once Creative Production is stable and you have demonstrated the judgment, leadership, and capacity required, the role will expand into Social Media Operations. That second phase will include the team, publishing, community, creator, affiliate, and channel systems around the content.



Phase 2 is planned to begin 60–90 days after your start date. The exact timing will depend on demonstrated readiness and business needs.



ABOUT VERITAS

Veritas builds complete Starlink Mini deployment setups—mounts, power, cables, cases, and accessories—for consumers, work teams, and government fleets.



We are a growing US company with a small, high-output marketing team in the Philippines. Several team members have grown with the company over the long term. We want the same for this role.



THE DETAILS

• Full-time independent contractor role with fixed monthly compensation of $2,000–$2,500 USD, based on experience, leadership depth, and overall fit—not an hourly position

• Approximately 45–50 hours per week, with the regular work schedule fully aligned with Pacific Time

• Philippine graveyard shift: roughly 11:00 PM–8:00 AM or 12:00 AM–9:00 AM, depending on U.S. daylight saving time

• Fully remote and long-term

• This must be your only job. No part-time employment, side hustles, ongoing freelance clients, or subcontracting

• Occasional weekend availability when production, launches, or publishing require management coverage

• Metro Manila, Rizal, Bulacan, Cavite, or Laguna required; no regular onsite office days, but occasional in-person meetings may be scheduled



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

At full production, the team aims to produce one long-form video and up to 14 supporting creative assets each week. These may include shorts/reels, static graphics, or carousels and are adapted for distribution across
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X. 



PHASE 1: LEAD CREATIVE PRODUCTION

• Manage a two-person video-editing team, including their priorities, workload, deadlines, coverage, development, and performance. 

• Turn approved priorities into clear production plans, briefs, scripts, storytelling direction, B-roll needs, and deliverables.

• Own the production pipeline: capacity, assignments, dependencies, revisions, blockers, asset readiness, and delivery visibility.

• Review short-form, long-form, ads, thumbnails, static assets, carousels, platform versions, and other creative output.

• Evaluate the full story—not only whether one shot matches one line. Check hooks, pacing, B-roll, demonstrations, captions, CTAs, factual accuracy, brand alignment, and viewer flow.

• Give editors clear, prioritized, actionable feedback and verify that required revisions were completed correctly.

• Use performance findings to identify stronger hooks, packaging, formats, V2/V3 opportunities, and creative tests.

• Build and improve SOPs, review standards, production trackers, asset repositories, AI-assisted QA, and backup coverage.

• Coordinate minor corrections and urgent production support when needed, without turning the role into a primary editing position.



PHASE 2: ADD SOCIAL MEDIA OPERATIONS

Phase 2 is planned to begin 60–90 days after your start date, once Phase 1 is operating reliably and you have demonstrated readiness for the expanded scope. At that point, you will also:

• Manage the current Social Media Moderator and future social media team members. 

• Own the publishing calendar, content inventory, platform schedules, launch pushes, and publishing verification across
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X.

• Ensure each platform receives the correct version, copy, CTA, description, tags, products, related content, links, and native-platform setup.

• Oversee community, marketing inboxes, important comments and messages, channel presentation, and routine reputation handling.

• Manage routine creator-partnership and affiliate operations, including communication, records, deliverables, logistics, and escalation.

• Own routine UTM, Bitly, campaign-link, profile-link, and destination-verification workflows.

• Review social performance and turn findings into decisions, tests, and coordinated creative recommendations.

• Build and maintain the social department’s processes, AI workflows, reporting, and continuity systems.



HOW THE ROLE FITS

You will report to and work closely with senior marketing leadership. In Phase 1, the video editors report to you. In Phase 2, the Social Media Moderator also reports to you.



You will have authority over routine departmental planning, assignments, quality, coaching, corrections, and process improvements within approved standards. Cross-functional, sensitive, contractual, financial, policy, staffing, reputation, and other material decisions remain with senior leadership.



HOW WE USE AI

Our marketing operation uses AI for context, research, briefs, feedback, quality control, documentation, analysis, automation, and institutional memory.



We want someone who uses AI heavily to improve judgment and execution—not someone who accepts raw output. Sources must be checked. Brand and product accuracy must be protected. What the team learns should improve the next workflow.



YOU'RE A STRONG FIT IF YOU

• Have at least eight years of professional work experience.

• Have at least three years managing teams and direct reports.

• Have at least two years of experience inside a creative or marketing function.

• Have meaningful corporate, in-house, agency, or field-based operating experience—not only freelance, VA, or task-based remote experience.

• Have managed a creative-production pipeline and can explain the team size, volume, process, problems, decisions, and results.

• Are exceptionally strong at storytelling and can diagnose why an edit is technically correct but still wrong for the overall story.

• Hands-on video-editing experience is an advantage, but it is not required. You must be able to direct editors, evaluate their work, and clearly explain what needs to change and why. 

• Can coach editors, address recurring mistakes, manage underperformance, and maintain accountability without becoming the bottleneck.

• Take action without waiting for step-by-step direction and consistently look for ways to improve quality, speed, visibility, and continuity.

• Use performance evidence to improve creative work—not only report numbers.

• Use AI daily with structured context, validation, human review, reusable systems, and feedback loops.

• Communicate clearly in conversational American English.

• Can sustain a Philippine graveyard schedule and occasional weekend coverage.

• Reside in Metro Manila, Rizal, Bulacan, Cavite, or Laguna and be willing to attend occasional in-person meetings.

• Have reliable primary internet, a backup connection, and backup power.

• Want one company to grow with for the long term.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

• Someone who waits for detailed instructions before acting.

• Someone whose experience is limited to task-based VA work, short freelance engagements, or managing multiple clients.

• A strong individual contributor who does not want to manage, coach, and hold people accountable.

• Someone who reviews only technical editing details but cannot evaluate the complete story and business goal.

• Someone who creates more process without improving output, visibility, quality, or results.

• Someone planning to keep another job, freelance clients, or subcontract any part of the work.

• Someone testing a graveyard schedule for the first time without a credible plan to sustain it.



HOW WE WORK

Clear priorities. Direct feedback. Strong ownership. Problems are raised early. Decisions are documented. The goal is not to look busy. The goal is to build work that performs and an operation that improves.



Our brand voice follows the same standard: short words, short sentences, confident but never salesy. Like a friend who knows the gear.



HOW TO APPLY

Use this subject line and at least 20 AP:

[INSERT REQUIRED WORD] - [X] years of professional experience - [X] years managing teams



Include the following:

• Your resume with company names, employment dates, role titles, team sizes, and whether each role was corporate, in-house, agency, freelance, or VA work.

• Have you directly managed a creative-production or video-production team? Answer Yes or No. If yes, state the team size.

• Can you provide examples of videos, campaigns, or creative projects you directly led if you advance to the next stage? Answer Yes or No. Do not send links or detailed explanations at this stage.

• In one short logistics block, confirm that this would be your only job and that you would complete all work personally. Include your city or province, most recent U.S.-hours role and actual schedule, primary and backup internet, backup power, and occasional weekend availability.



Note: Applications missing any requirement will not be considered.

title: Property Acquisition Virtual Assistant / Real Estate Investment Cold Caller
description:
We are a U.S.-based real estate investment company seeking a professional, reliable, and motivated Virtual Assistant to help identify homeowners who may be interested in selling their property directly to our investment company.



This is NOT a real estate agent or brokerage position. Our company is seeking to purchase properties for its own investment purposes and portfolio.



ABOUT THE ROLE



You will make outbound calls to property owners using company-provided lead lists and approved calling systems. Your goal is to determine whether a homeowner may be interested in discussing a potential direct sale of their property to our investment company.



You are the first voice homeowners will hear from our company, so we are looking for someone who sounds professional, confident, friendly, and natural.



This is NOT a script-reading robot position. You should be able to listen, build rapport, ask appropriate questions, handle rejection professionally, and have a genuine conversation.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



• Make outbound calls to property owners using company-provided lead lists and approved systems.



• Follow company-approved scripts, calling procedures, calling hours, and compliance requirements.



• Clearly and truthfully identify yourself and the investment company you are calling on behalf of.



• Ask property owners whether they would consider selling their property directly to our investment company.



• Have friendly and professional conversations with homeowners.



• Identify homeowners who have a genuine interest in discussing a potential sale.



• Gather approved basic information from interested homeowners, such as property condition, occupancy, motivation for potentially selling, expected timeline, and whether the homeowner has a price in mind.



• Accurately document calls, conversations, notes, follow-ups, and outcomes in our CRM.



• Categorize leads based on the homeowner's level of interest.



• Schedule a follow-up conversation with the company owner when a homeowner expresses genuine interest in discussing a potential sale.



• Conduct approved follow-up calls when instructed.



• Immediately document any request from a homeowner not to receive additional calls and follow company procedures to prevent additional outreach.



• Provide regular reporting regarding calls, conversations, interested property owners, follow-ups, and CRM activity.



IMPORTANT — REAL ESTATE LICENSING COMPLIANCE



This position is for a real estate investment company seeking to acquire properties for its OWN account and investment portfolio.



This is NOT a real estate brokerage position.



Although the owner of the investment company may separately hold a New Jersey real estate license, this position is for the property investment/acquisition business and NOT for soliciting brokerage clients or real estate listings.



The Virtual Assistant must follow all company policies designed to comply with applicable federal, state, and local requirements, including applicable New Jersey Real Estate Commission requirements.



YOU WILL NOT:



• Represent yourself as a real estate agent, Realtor®, broker, attorney, appraiser, or other licensed professional.



• Solicit homeowners to list their property with a real estate agent or brokerage.



• Solicit listing agreements or brokerage relationships.



• Offer brokerage or real estate representation services.



• Represent third-party buyers or sellers.



• Provide legal, tax, financing, appraisal, brokerage, or real estate advice.



• Provide an appraisal, CMA, or opinion regarding property value.



• Negotiate the purchase or sale of real estate.



• Make binding purchase offers or agree to purchase prices or other material contract terms on behalf of the company.



• Prepare, modify, interpret, explain, or execute real estate contracts.



• Discuss real estate commissions or brokerage compensation.



• Perform activities requiring a real estate license unless properly licensed and specifically authorized.



When a homeowner expresses genuine interest in potentially selling, your responsibility is to gather the approved information, accurately document the lead, and refer the homeowner to the company owner for further discussion.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



• Excellent spoken English — clear, confident, and easy to understand on a U.S. phone call.



• Strong communication and listening skills.



• Previous outbound cold-calling experience strongly preferred.



• Experience calling U.S. homeowners strongly preferred.



• Previous U.S. real estate investment cold-calling experience is a major plus.



• Comfortable with rejection and high call volume.



• Able to have natural conversations rather than simply reading a script.



• Friendly and professional without being aggressive or misleading.



• Organized and disciplined with CRM data entry and follow-up.



• Reliable and punctual.



• Quiet home workspace.



• Quality headset and microphone.



• Reliable high-speed internet connection.



• Backup internet connection strongly preferred.



• Reliable computer capable of operating web-based CRM and calling software.



• Spanish-speaking ability is a plus but NOT required.



TOOLS & TRAINING



The company will provide or designate the approved:



• Lead lists

• Calling/dialer system

• Calling scripts

• CRM

• Training

• Lead qualification procedures

• Calling and compliance procedures



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



Performance will be evaluated based on:



• Consistent outbound calling activity

• Number and quality of live homeowner conversations

• Qualified/interested property-owner leads generated

• Follow-up completion

• CRM accuracy

• Reliability and attendance

• Professional communication

• Compliance with company procedures



100% CRM documentation and compliance with company calling procedures are expected.



The first 30 days will be a PAID TRIAL PERIOD. Strong performance can lead to a long-term position, additional hours, increased responsibility, and compensation reviews as the company grows.



COMPLIANCE — READ CAREFULLY



All outbound calling must be conducted using company-approved lead lists, systems, scripts, calling hours, and procedures.



The VA may not independently purchase, import, source, or begin calling their own lists unless specifically authorized by the company.



The VA must never misrepresent their identity, the company they represent, the purpose of the call, their licensing status, or their authority.



If someone asks not to receive additional calls, the VA must immediately document the request and follow company procedures to prevent additional outreach.



The VA must follow all company policies regarding applicable Do-Not-Call requirements, telephone solicitation requirements, calling restrictions, privacy, caller identification, and recordkeeping.



Compliance is a condition of employment. Failure to follow company procedures may result in immediate termination.



HOW TO APPLY



Applications that do not include ALL of the following may not be reviewed.



1. Send a short message explaining:



• Why you are good on the phone

• Your previous cold-calling experience

• Whether you have called U.S. homeowners

• Whether you have worked for a U.S. real estate investor

• Approximately how many outbound calls you made per day

• Which dialers and CRMs you have used

• Your desired hourly rate

• Your availability during U.S. Eastern Time



2. Submit a 60–90 SECOND VOICE RECORDING role-playing this scenario:



You are calling a homeowner on behalf of our real estate investment company because our company is interested in purchasing properties in their area.



The homeowner says:



“I wasn't really planning on selling, but I guess I'd consider it if the price made sense.”



Continue the conversation naturally.



Your objective is to determine whether the homeowner is genuinely interested and gather appropriate basic information. Do NOT negotiate a purchase price, make an offer, provide a property valuation, or provide real estate advice.



3. Send your resume and briefly describe the best cold-calling or lead-generation results you have personally achieved.



IMPORTANT:



Begin your application with the words:



“PROPERTY INVESTMENT”



This lets us know you read the entire job posting.



We are looking for someone who wants a long-term opportunity and can grow with our real estate investment company.

title: Experienced Wix Website Designer (Project Based)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Wix website designer to design and build a new website for our existing business, Simply Pristine Ops.

We currently have a Wix website that was originally designed around our cleaning services. Our business has since evolved into a property maintenance company, and we want to start fresh with a new Wix website that better represents the company we are today and where we are headed.

Our existing website will remain available as a reference for current content, branding, and business information, but we do not want the new website to copy or simply redesign the existing layout. We want a fresh, professional direction.

We are looking for someone with strong design judgment who can take our business direction and turn it into a modern, professional, clean, B2B-focused website.



This is a one-time, project-based opportunity.



About Simply Pristine Ops

Simply Pristine Ops is a multi-market property maintenance company primarily serving property management companies.

We handle a wide range of property maintenance needs, including HVAC, plumbing, handyman/general repairs, painting, pressure washing, cleaning, turnovers, and other property-related services.

We currently serve markets in Ohio.

Our goal is to position Simply Pristine Ops as one point of contact for property maintenance needs, rather than as a cleaning company.

We will provide the selected designer with more detailed information about our business, target audience, services, markets, and website direction.



What We Need

We are looking for someone who can:

Design and build a new Wix website from a fresh starting point

Recommend the best website structure and navigation

Create a professional, B2B-focused design

Clearly present our property maintenance services

Create appropriate service area and company pages

Develop strong calls-to-action and service request forms

Help refine website copy and messaging where needed

Select appropriate imagery and visual elements

Create a consistent look throughout the website

Optimize the website for desktop and mobile

Complete basic on-page SEO setup

Review our existing website and identify any useful content that should be retained or adapted

We value creative input and professional recommendations. We do not want to dictate every section or design element. We are hiring an experienced designer because we want someone who can bring ideas to the project and recommend what will work best.



Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone with:

Strong Wix website design experience

A professional portfolio showing websites you personally designed

Strong visual and layout skills

Experience with B2B or service-based business websites

Good written English

Good communication and responsiveness

Ability to work independently from an overall business direction

Strong attention to both desktop and mobile design

Experience with property management, real estate, property maintenance, home services, construction, or similar industries is a plus.





How to Apply

Please include:

A brief introduction and description of your Wix experience.

3–5 examples of websites you personally designed

Your proposed fixed project rate.

Your estimated timeline from start to completion.

What is included in your proposed rate, including pages, revisions, forms, SEO setup, etc.

After reviewing our current website, briefly explain how you would approach creating a new property maintenance website for Simply Pristine Ops.

title: Brand Marketing and Strategy
description:

Own
 marketing — plan, build, and manage campaigns and sequences from strategy through send

Support SEO — help optimize website content, product pages, and blog/content for search visibility

Prior professional experience running marketing for a brand or business — this is a strategic/operational role, not entry-level, and not purely an execution-support position.



Demonstrated ability to interpret marketing data and turn it into clear, actionable recommendations



Eexperience with

Highly organized self-starter who can manage multiple workstreams and keep things on schedule with minimal oversight

title: Interior Designer
description:
Dwelle is a U.S.-based interior design studio creating bespoke, ready-to-shop residential interiors. We are looking for a talented Interior Designer to join us part-time, with the opportunity to grow into a long-term and eventually full-time role.



This is a hands-on design role. You will take client information—including room measurements, photos, existing furniture, inspiration, aesthetic preferences, and furnishing budget—and develop a complete finished room design using Dwelle's established design standards and presentation templates.



Responsibilities include:

• Creating accurate furniture layouts and space plans

• Sourcing furniture, lighting, rugs, textiles, mirrors/art, and accessories from U.S. retailers

• Selecting pieces appropriate to the client's room dimensions, style, and furnishing budget

• Creating realistic 3D interior visualizations

• Incorporating existing client furniture into new designs when required

• Preparing polished final presentations using Dwelle templates

• Providing product links, pricing, dimensions, and placement information

• Checking all work carefully for scale, accuracy, availability, and presentation quality before submission



We are looking for someone with a strong design eye. Our aesthetic is warm, collected, timeless, and polished with a thoughtful mix of traditional and contemporary pieces. We are not looking for generic luxury renders, matching furniture sets, overly trendy rooms, or showroom-style interiors.



Ideal candidates have experience with interior design or architecture and are comfortable with programs such as SketchUp, AutoCAD, Revit, D5 Render, Enscape, V-Ray, Coohom, Homestyler, Photoshop, Canva, or InDesign. You do not need to know every program.



Strong space-planning skills, attention to furniture dimensions, and the ability to source attractive products online are essential. Familiarity with U.S. furniture retailers is a plus.



To apply, please include:

• Your interior design portfolio

• Examples of residential floor plans or space planning

• Examples of 3D interior visualizations

• Examples of furniture or FF&E sourcing, if available

• Software you use

• Current hourly rate and weekly availability



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid sample design project before hiring.

title: Direct Response Video Editor & AI Creative Producer for E-commerce
description:
Hiring: Direct Response Video Editor

(VSLs + Competitor Ad Recreation + AI Cartoon Videos + Other AI Style Ads + Short Form Videos)

DTC / dropshipping brand doing ~$100k/month in revenue

Role: Video Editor / AI Video Producer

Read this part first

We are not looking for someone to "make our videos look nice."

We are looking for someone who understands that a video's job is to hold attention and make people buy — and who can build that video end to end, including sourcing or generating every frame of footage inside it.

If you need a folder of assets handed to you before you can start editing, this role isn't for you. If you can take a script, a product, or a competitor reference and come back with a finished, conversion-ready asset, keep reading.

Who we are

We're a direct response DTC brand currently doing around $100k/month, almost entirely on the back of paid media and creative. Creative is our growth lever. Not the site, not the offer tweaks, not the
 flows — the video.

That means the editor seat is one of the highest-leverage roles in the company. When a video wins here, it wins loudly and you'll see it in the numbers within days.

We're scaling, and we want to stop stitching together freelancers per project. We want one highly skilled person who becomes part of the team, learns our angles and our customer inside out, and gets sharper with every batch we ship.

How this role starts (please read carefully)

This does not begin as a full-time position, and that's deliberate.

We start every editor on a lighter workload — a smaller number of videos per week — for the first stretch. Not because we're testing whether you can hold a job, but because we want to see how you fit: how you take feedback, how you handle a brief or reference ad we hand you, how you communicate when something's unclear, and whether the work holds up once the novelty wears off.

It also gives you time to learn our customer, our angles, and what a "winning" video looks like in our account specifically.

The first type of work you'll primarily be doing is competitor ad recreation and localization. We'll give you proven competitor ads and your job will be to rebuild them for our brand and our market. This lets us quickly see how well you can reverse-engineer winning creative, source footage independently, match pacing and structure, and execute without needing everything handed to you.

From there it scales. As the fit proves out and your creatives start performing, the volume goes up, the pay goes up, and the arrangement moves toward a secure, permanent full-time seat — with a defined monthly retainer rather than per-project work.

To be clear about what we're offering:

Phase 1 — Fit: Lower volume, paid per project or at a smaller retainer. You'll primarily start with competitor ad recreations/localizations and short-form creatives. Heavy feedback from us. We're both figuring out if this works.

Phase 2 — Ramp: Volume increases, you take on the VSLs, AI cartoon projects, original concepts, and competitor recreations with less hand-holding. Pay increases accordingly.

Phase 3 — In-house: Full-time, secure retainer, you own the creative pipeline and have real input on direction. Room to grow into a creative lead as we bring on more editors.

We're not looking for someone to fill a gap for three months. We're looking for the person who's still here in two years running our creative. The slow start is how we get there without either of us wasting the other's time.

If you need immediate full-time income from day one, this probably isn't the right fit right now — and that's fine, just be upfront about it.

What you'll actually be making

1. Competitor Ad Recreation & Localization

This is where you'll start, and it will be a major part of your initial workload.

We actively research winning ads from competitors and other markets. We'll give you proven creatives and references, and your job is to reverse-engineer what makes them work and recreate them for our brand in Swedish.

We're looking for someone who can take a competitor ad and recreate the structure, hook, pacing, visual flow, editing style, captions, voiceover structure, and overall concept as closely as needed — while replacing the competitor's product, branding, language, footage, and other elements with assets appropriate for our brand.

In many cases, this means rebuilding an ad almost shot-for-shot.

You might receive nothing more than the competitor ad, our product information, and access to our tools. From there, you're expected to figure out how to rebuild it.

You'll be responsible for:

Breaking down exactly why the original ad works — hook, pacing, cuts, visual sequence, proof, mechanism, CTA, etc.

Translating and localizing scripts, captions, hooks, and on-screen text rather than producing awkward word-for-word translations.

Sourcing replacement footage yourself when we don't provide it.

Using AI-generated footage when the necessary shot doesn't exist or can't be sourced.

Replacing competitor products and branding with our own product wherever necessary.

Recreating visual demonstrations, product shots, graphics, animations, screenshots, and other elements when needed.

Matching the pacing and psychology of the original creative rather than simply making something that covers the same topic.

The goal isn't to blindly copy an ad. The goal is to identify the elements making a proven creative work and rebuild those elements for our product and market.

2. Long-form VSLs (Video Sales Letters)

The core of the long-form side of the role. 2–7+ minute sales videos built off scripts we provide.

You'll be responsible for:

Pacing the entire video so retention doesn't collapse — pattern interrupts, cuts, zooms, motion, sound design, text emphasis, visual proof

Sourcing your own b-roll. Stock libraries, licensed footage, UGC-style clips, screen recordings, archival, whatever the script calls for. You find it. You don't ask us to send it. In some cases we will also provide clips and we have a bunch of softwares that you can use to make this process easier aswell.

Generating AI video to fill the gaps stock can't cover — visualizing mechanisms, metaphors, before/after states, scenarios that don't exist as footage.

Building the visual language for a section, not just laying clips over a voiceover.

Kinetic text, callouts, subtitles, on-screen proof elements, testimonial treatments.

Sound design and music that carries emotional beats without burying the VO.

3. AI cartoon / animated videos (short form AND long form)

We're producing a growing volume of fully AI-generated animated content — story-driven ads, explainer content, character-led narratives.

You'll take a script and:

Build a consistent character and world (this is the hard part — character consistency across dozens of shots is a real skill and we'll be testing for it)

Generate the shots yourself using AI image + video tools

Handle lip sync, voiceover, and audio

Cut it into a video that actually flows as a story rather than a slideshow of AI clips

Deliver in both short form (15–60s, vertical) and long form formats

4. Short form paid ads

Hook-first ads for Meta / TikTok. High volume, fast iteration. Multiple hook variants of the same body.

You'll be cutting these constantly, and you'll be expected to have opinions about which hooks are worth testing.

Some will be original concepts. Others will be variations of existing winners, competitor recreations, new hooks on proven bodies, different angles, or localized versions of ads working in other markets.

The goal is speed without sacrificing quality. We want to be able to test a large amount of creative without every video becoming a week-long production.

What we need you to be good at

Non-negotiable:

Editing that converts, not just editing that looks good. You understand hooks, retention curves, pattern interrupts, why the first 3 seconds d
 everything, and how to build toward a CTA. If you've never thought about a video in terms of watch time or CPA, you're not ready for this seat.

Competitor ad recreation and localization. This is especially important because it's where you'll start. You need to be able to take a winning competitor ad, reverse-engineer it, source or recreate the necessary footage, translate/localize it into natural language, replace the branding and product elements, and deliver a perfect version that preserves what made the original creative work.

Sourcing your own footage. Independently. You know where to find good b-roll.

Generating AI video yourself. Not "willing to learn" — actually doing it now. You know how to prompt, how to iterate when a generation is wrong, how to maintain consistency, and how to upscale and clean up output so it doesn't look like AI slop.

Strong technical craft — clean cuts, deliberate pacing, proper audio levels, colour that matches across mixed sources, subtitles that don't look like an afterthought.

Speed. We ship a lot. Quality at volume is the whole game.

Ownership. You get a script, competitor reference, or brief and come back with a finished asset. You flag problems early. You don't go quiet for four days.

Tools — you should be fluent in most of these or their equivalents:

Editing: Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut.

AI video: Higgsfield, Veo, Kling, Runway, Sora, Hailuo, Seedance — or whatever you've found works better

AI image: Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana, Ideogram

Voice: ElevenLabs or similar

Upscaling / cleanup: Topaz, Magnific

Bonus: Descript, Adobe Podcast, motion graphics templating, basic scripting/automation for batching

Removing text from video: Vmake

Nice to have:

description:

Company: Amran Property Investments, LLC

Location: Remote – U.S. Real Estate Market

About the Position



Amran Property Investments, LLC is looking for an experienced and highly motivated **Real Estate Dispositions Manager** to join our team.



The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience finding, communicating with, and building relationships with real estate investors and buyers who are actively purchasing single-family homes in North Carolina.



Your primary responsibility will be to take properties that we have under contract and find qualified buyers, market the properties effectively, negotiate with buyers, and get our deals sold or assigned for a profitable return.



This is a results-driven position. We are looking for someone who already understands real estate investing, wholesaling, buyer sourcing, and dispositions—or someone with strong sales experience who can quickly learn our process.

s to potential buyers.

Use your own buyer lists, networking, investor groups, public records, online resources, and other approved methods to generate qualified buyer leads.

Continuously expand the company's buyer network.

Identify serious buyers versus unqualified or inactive buyers.

Develop relationships with repeat investors who can purchase multiple properties.

Create compelling property marketing messages for qualified buyers.

Present investment opportunities clearly and professionally.

Follow up consistently with buyers who express interest.

Buyer Qualification

Ask buyers about their investment strategy, preferred locations, property types, price ranges, and funding.

Maintain detailed buyer profiles in the CRM.

Track which buyers are actively purchasing and what types of properties they are looking for.

Negotiation & Deal Management



Negotiate purchase prices, assignment fees, and other deal terms with buyers.

Buyer Notes

Previous Offers / Transactions

Closing History

Performance Expectations

title: Software Tester - 1 to 2 Month Period
description:
We're an Australian manufacturer. We have several web and mobile applications being rolled out across the business, and we need a careful manual tester for approximately one month to find bugs before they go live to staff and customers.



This is exploratory testing, not automation. For each application you'll get login details to a test environment, a short brief on what it's supposed to do, and a set of areas to focus on. Your job is to use it like a real user would, then try to break it.



What you'll do



Learn a new application quickly from a short brief and work out what "correct" should look like

Work through core workflows — forms, uploads, search, saving and editing records — and try to make them fail

Test edge cases: empty and overlong inputs, special characters, the browser back button, refreshing mid-form, double-clicking submit, dropped connection, two tabs open at once

Test across Chrome plus one other browser, on both desktop and mobile

Log every issue in our shared tracker with steps to reproduce, expected result, actual result, browser and device, and a screenshot or screen recording

Check the existing list before logging so we don't collect duplicates

Re-test fixed issues when we push a new build



Requirements



Reliable internet, a computer, and a smartphone

Written English good enough to describe a bug precisely and unambiguously

Methodical and observant — we want someone who notices small inconsistencies, not just crashes

Comfortable working independently and asking questions when something is ambiguous

Willing to sign an NDA



Not required: coding, test automation, or QA certifications.



Hours and rate

Around 20 hours per week for approximately one month, with scope to increase based on business needs and testing periods. Some overlap with Melbourne business hours is preferred, but the work is mostly independent. Possible ongoing work on future releases if it goes well.



To apply

Start your reply with the word "teapot", so I know you've read this. Then describe the last bug you found in any app or website - what you did, what you expected to happen, and what actually happened instead.



Shortlisted applicants will be paid for a 2-hour trial task before we commit to the month.

We're hiring a remote dedicated Inbound Sales & Support Representative to own the front line of our customer experience. You'll answer calls, chats,
s, walk customers through our products, and close sales — while qualifying larger commercial leads for handoff to our sales manager.



Hours: 8am to 1pm PST



WHAT YOU'LL DO

--------------------

Answer inbound calls promptly — pick up live calls within a few rings or less.

Resolve routine retail support — shipment tracking, parts questions, order status, and general customer inquiries, start to finish.

Re-engage abandoned-cart shoppers and follow up on stalled quotes through outbound and cold calling.

Walk customers through our product lineup with clarity, confidence, and accurate detail

Work through objections, pricing pushback, and follow-ups without losing momentum, while staying alert to upsell and cross-sell openings.

Qualify incoming commercial inquiries — run a short intake call to understand scope and need, then hand off pre-qualified leads to our sales manager with clear notes.

Own the queue during scheduled leadership absences — during planned coverage windows, you're the single point of contact for all customer communications. High-value orders and urgent escalations get flagged for a same-day leadership review; everything else you handle directly.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

--------------------

Callers consistently reach a real person quickly — no missed calls, no long holds.

Retail issues get resolved on first contact whenever possible.

100% of leads are entered into the CRM, ready and pre-qualified for the sales manager.

Leadership can step away (including multi-day stretches) without customer experience slipping.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

--------------------

Experience in customer support, inside sales, or sales development — retail, e-commerce, or B2B distribution background is a plus.

Clear, confident spoken and written English communication skills, with an outgoing, people-first personality.

Sharp communication paired with genuine listening skills — comfortable being the first voice a customer hears, on the phone and in writing.

Organized and self-directed — you can triage, prioritize, and make good judgment calls without someone looking over your shoulder.

Calm, professional communication style with both everyday retail customers and commercial buyers.

Quick to learn, dependable in execution, and careful with instructions.



BONUS POINTS FOR

--------------------

Comfortable working daily inside Shopify to track orders, leads, monitor abandoned carts, and flag opportunities.

Familiarity with HubSpot or another CRM platform.

Understanding of AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude AI, etc.



HOW TO APPLY (MUST READ)

--------------------

Send the following:



Your resume

A 60–90 second voice recording (required) covering both parts below:



Voice Recording — what to include:



A. Quick intro: your name and one sentence on your background & sales experience.



B. Live sales scenario: Imagine you're calling a customer who added a vacuum cleaner to their cart but didn't check out. Walk us through how you'd turn that abandoned cart into a sale — including how you'd handle the objection "I'm not ready to buy right now."



We're evaluating tone, confidence, clarity, listening cues, and how naturally you move a prospect toward a close. Polish matters; perfection isn't expected — show us how you actually sound on a real call.



Applications without a voice recording that completes both parts will not be considered. Please include the word REAL in your subject line to confirm you've read this far.



Thank you.

The specialist will take ownership of the administrative processes surrounding Accounts Receivable, delinquency and collections, resident communication, payment commitments, notices, community compliance, legal/eviction administration, and move-out coordination.



The ideal candidate is highly disciplined, process-oriented, and exceptionally accurate with resident ledgers, dates, documentation, and legal/compliance workflows. The role requires strong communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to manage sensitive resident matters professionally while following standardized procedures.





Key Responsibilities:

Accounts Receivable & Delinquency

Maintain accurate collection queues by community and resident.



Identify newly delinquent accounts, aging balances, recurring delinquency, and high-risk accounts.

Track statutory and company deadlines.

Escalate inconsistencies or missing documentation before legal action proceeds.



Administer approved late-notice and statutory-notice workflows in Rent Manager according to state-specific procedures and required U.S./legal approvals.



Community Compliance & Enforcement

Create and maintain compliance cases in Rent Manager.



Verify supporting evidence before initiating approved resident communications.



Prepare standardized Community Guideline notices and corrective-action correspondence.



Establish cure deadlines according to approved procedures.



Communicate professionally with residents regarding required corrective actions.



Track open compliance cases and cure dates.



Coordinate reinspections with local Community Operations Specialists.



Maintain complete evidence and communication histories.



Identify repeat or serious violations and escalate unresolved matters according to approved enforcement procedures.



Maintain consistent application of Community Guidelines across communities.



Identify recurring property-level compliance issues and report patterns to Operations leadership.



Legal & Eviction Administration



Identify accounts or compliance cases that have reached an approved escalation threshold.



Assemble complete resident account and compliance documentation, including ledgers, leases, notices, payment histories, payment commitments, photographs, and communication records.



Prepare legal referral packets.



Coordinate directly with authorized U.S. management and legal counsel.



Track filing dates, hearings, judgments, writs, possession dates, appeals, and other legal milestones.



Maintain accurate legal status and next actions in Rent Manager.



Track attorney requests for additional information.



Coordinate with field personnel regarding possession or other physical-action requirements.



Maintain a portfolio-wide eviction and legal pipeline.



Immediately escalate missed deadlines, legal complications, or incomplete files.



Handle legal and eviction matters administratively and do not independently determine legal strategy, file pleadings as legal counsel, serve process, or perform actions reserved for licensed or authorized U.S. professionals.



Move-Out Coordination



Receive and document Notices to Vacate and establish expected move-out dates.



Coordinate required resident communications.



Track possession status and key returns.



Coordinate field inspections and physical documentation.



Obtain forwarding information.



Ensure resident and unit/site status is accurately updated in Rent Manager.



Trigger the appropriate vacancy, turnover, or asset-management workflow upon possession.



Coordinate the handoff to the Home Asset & Inventory Specialist when a home becomes vacant, abandoned, surrendered, or otherwise requires title or asset review.



Coordinate with the Revenue Team when marketable inventory becomes available.



Abandoned / Evicted Home Handoff

Provide the receiving asset-management team with occupant status, possession date, legal status, known ownership/title information, resident ledger, supporting legal documents, field photographs, key/possession status, known liens or claims, and the next required action.

Experience administering late notices and collection workflows.

Experience with move-out and possession administration.



Strong experience with Rent Manager, the company’s CRM/property-management software, is highly preferred, particularly with Resident Ledgers, AR/Collections, charges and payments, resident notes and history, tasks and queues, documents and notices, attachments, workflows, automation, reporting, resident communications, move-outs, legal/compliance tracking, and dashboards.



Experience building or improving Rent Manager workflows, automated task sequences, and collection/compliance queues is highly desirable.



Excellent spoken and written English.



Exceptional attention to legal dates, deadlines, resident records, and supporting documentation.



Ability to conduct difficult resident conversations professionally.



Strong emotional discipline, judgment, and professionalism.



Ability to follow standardized procedures accurately without improvising or deviating from approved processes.

Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple collection, compliance, legal, and move-out matters simultaneously.

title: Moodap | Data Engineer – Build & Own the National Data Pipeline (Ground Floor Opportunity)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Moodap (
) is a live mood-based venue discovery platform — Next.js, Supabase, PostgreSQL — currently covering 28,000+ Manhattan venues, expanding to all five NYC boroughs and then nationally across the top 1,000 US cities, with a total addressable dataset in the millions of venues.



We need a data engineer to own the pipeline that makes this possible: discovering venues from multiple sources, deduplicating them at scale, and — most importantly — extracting real insider information from unstructured review text. Vibe, best time to visit, recurring events, live music nights, specials, and other details no competitor (Google, Yelp, OpenTable) is systematically capturing. This extraction work is the core differentiator of the product, not a side task, and it needs to be built as a repeatable, ongoing process, not a one-time cleanup.



This is a pipeline-building role, not a manual-labor role. You'll build an automated, resumable system that can run largely unattended, handle rate limits and messy source data, and scale from one city to a thousand without requiring manual babysitting at each step. A business-claim flow reduces ongoing maintenance over time — once a business claims its profile, it helps keep its own data current — and your pipeline should be designed with that in mind, prioritizing claim-conversion alongside raw ingestion rather than treating them separately.



You'll work daily with Claude Code and AI-assisted extraction as the actual method of building this, not a shortcut layered on top. As the system scales, you may be running or supervising multiple parallel AI-driven extraction sessions across regions — we need someone who can verify output quality and catch when something's gone wrong, not someone who prompts once and trusts the result blindly.



You don't need years of formal "data engineer" title experience to apply. What you need is a specific, demonstrable example: a project where you pulled messy, unstructured data (reviews, documents, scraped pages) into something structured and reliable, ideally including deduplication and some form of ongoing freshness/validation — not a one-time script that ran once and was never touched again.



This role reports directly to the CTO. This is Monday–Friday, 40 hours/week, ground-floor ownership with real room to grow as the platform scales from one city to the entire country.



SKILL REQUIREMENT

JavaScript/Python | PostgreSQL | Supabase | AI-assisted data extraction (Claude Code or equivalent)

title: Growth Marketing / Customer Acquisition Manager

The primary result of this role is new customers, collected revenue, and profit. Not posts, not impressions, not reports.



Compensation is a percentage of the revenue generated by the marketing system you build. There is no income cap.



============================================================

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

============================================================



Someone who thinks like an entrepreneur and treats every company advertising dollar as their own. Someone who understands marketing, sales, and unit economics. You develop the plan, you execute it, you shut down what does not work and scale what does. You do not wait for instructions.



Technically, this is a strong generalist who uses AI to cover the workload that previously required several separate specialists: performance, SEO, content, video, and analytics.



============================================================

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

============================================================



Overall practical experience in digital / growth marketing: 5+ years, including at least 2 years independently developing and executing growth strategy.



By area:



- Performance marketing and customer acquisition with responsibility for budget and results: 3+ years

- Google Ads — independently managing campaigns and budgets: 3+ years

============================================================

WHAT YOU WILL DO
