1. STRATEGY AND GROWTH PLAN



Independently analyze the market and competitors, develop a customer acquisition plan, present it to management, and execute it. The plan covers every channel (SEO, Google Maps, Google Ads, Meta, Yelp, YouTube, content, referrals, partnerships, existing customer base marketing), new territories, locations, and services, as well as targets for CPL, CAC, conversion rate, average ticket, ROAS, and profitability.



2. MAXIMUM RESULTS WITH MINIMUM BUDGET



Increasing the advertising budget is not a strategy. Before asking for more ad spend, the manager must look for growth elsewhere: improve the offer, creatives, and landing pages; raise conversion rate and lead quality; reduce CPL and CAC; grow organic traffic, average ticket, repeat business, and referrals.



The long-term objective is marketing assets (Google Maps, SEO, content, reviews, customer base) that bring in customers without advertising costs growing proportionally.



3. PAID CHANNELS



Google Ads. Building and auditing campaigns; Search, Remarketing, Performance Max, and YouTube Ads when economically justified. Keyword management, negative keywords, search term analysis, ad copy, landing pages, conversion and call tracking, A/B testing of offers. Optimization for CPL, CAC, ROAS, and profit — not clicks.



Meta / Instagram. Strategy, original creatives, Reels, Stories, testing audiences, offers, and messaging, campaign management, organic reach growth. Every piece of content has a purpose: Attention → Trust → Lead → Customer → Revenue.



Yelp. Profiles for real locations, optimization, review responses, Yelp Ads only when the economics work. If the channel does not deliver customers at an acceptable cost, the manager recommends reducing or reallocating the budget.



4. ORGANIC CHANNELS



SEO. Strategy, technical audit, keyword and competitor research, service pages and legitimate city / service-area pages, site structure, SEO content, internal linking, backlinks, indexing and ranking monitoring. Success is measured not by the number of pages, but by calls, customers, and revenue from organic search.



Google Business Profile / Google Maps. Creating and verifying profiles only for real locations in compliance with Google requirements, full optimization, regular updates, photos and videos, a legitimate strategy for growing the quantity and quality of reviews, review responses, local ranking and competitor analysis. Each profile is a separate channel with its own tracking of calls, leads, and revenue.



YouTube. An educational channel and a long-term asset: concepts, scripts, Shorts, AI video, voice-over, editing, project and educational videos. Not treated as a source of quick ROI.



5. CONTENT



Content from every project. Every completed job is a marketing asset. We need a system that turns real projects into before / after content, Reels, Shorts, YouTube videos, case studies, and content for GBP, the website, SEO, and ad creatives. One project — multiple pieces of content for multiple platforms, using AI for speed and lower cost.



Educational content. The company should become a source of useful information for homeowners: why an air conditioner is not cooling, repair vs. replace, how to choose a heat pump, how equipment is sized, when an electrical panel upgrade is needed, why permits and inspections matter, how to compare contractor estimates, what not to save money on. The chain: Educate → Build Trust → Create Demand → Generate Leads → Generate Revenue. A person may not be looking for anything today — but when they need us, they will remember us.



Viral content. Systematically create and test material people want to share: unusual HVAC and electrical problems, breakdowns of bad installations, contractor and homeowner mistakes, myths, equipment comparisons, experiments, answers to common questions. Nobody can guarantee every video goes viral — the job is systematic work on ideas with high reach potential.



Our content must be different. Thousands of contractors publish the same thing: "Call us for all your HVAC needs." We do not need that. The constant question: why would someone watch our content? It must be original, useful, easy for a homeowner to understand, visually recognizable, and interesting even to someone who is not buying anything right now. The goal is our own media style and brand voice.



6. AI AS A WORKING TOOL



Professional use of modern AI tools for research and competitor analysis, copywriting, image and video generation, editing, AI avatars and voice-over, scripts, creatives, landing pages, SEO analysis, content repurposing, analytics, and automation. AI makes production faster and cheaper, but it does not replace strategic thinking, originality, fact-checking, or responsibility for results.



7. ANALYTICS AND FULL-FUNNEL RESPONSIBILITY



The manager owns the entire customer journey:



>> Strategy → Attention → Lead → Appointment → Customer → Sale → Payment → Collected Revenue



To do this, they build and maintain attribution: CRM, call tracking, unique phone numbers, conversion and website tracking, Google Analytics, tracking across Google Ads, GBP, Yelp, Meta, YouTube, and landing pages. The company must know the source of every customer.



A report like "Google Ads generated 100 leads" is not enough. We want to see:



>> Marketing Spend → Leads → Qualified Leads → Appointments → Customers → Sales → Collected Revenue → Profit



If there are leads but no customers, the manager finds exactly where the funnel breaks (traffic quality, offer, website, response time, call handling, qualification, scheduling, sales, pricing, follow-up) and proposes a measurable solution.



============================================================

KPI

============================================================



New and qualified leads, new customers, CPL, CAC, Lead → Customer conversion rate, jobs sold, average ticket, collected revenue, ROAS, Marketing ROI, profitability, organic acquisition growth.



The number of posts, videos, views, impressions, and clicks is not the final result.



On ROAS: $10,000 in advertising → $50,000 in collected revenue = ROAS 5x. But ROAS alone does not equal profit. The manager accounts for job costs, gross margin, CAC, refunds, chargebacks, and all marketing expenses. The goal is not an impressive number, but profitable growth.



============================================================

COMPENSATION

============================================================



The primary model is a percentage of revenue actually collected by the company from new customers that can be objectively attributed to marketing channels created or managed by the Growth Marketing Manager. There is no income cap: the company earns more → the manager earns more.



Commission is paid only on money the company has actually received. Not included: unsigned and unpaid estimates, unpaid invoices, canceled jobs, refunds and chargebacks, existing customers without a confirmed new source, personal referrals outside the marketing system, repeat business (unless separately agreed).



Customer source is confirmed through CRM, call tracking, unique phone numbers, website tracking, platforms (Google Ads, GBP, Yelp, Meta, YouTube), landing pages, and other pre-agreed attribution systems.



============================================================

PROOF OF EXPERIENCE

============================================================



During selection, the candidate must show real projects with numbers: what business, the starting situation, budget, number of leads and customers, CPL, CAC, ROAS, collected revenue, which organic channels were built, what did not work and why, and what the candidate did personally.



"I increased brand awareness" and "I managed social media" are not proof of experience. The format: Problem → Action → Numbers → Result.



============================================================

WHO THIS POSITION IS NOT FOR

============================================================



Anyone who measures success by the number of posts, clicks, and impressions; solves every problem by increasing the budget; does not work with analytics; waits for instructions and avoids decisions; is not ready to own a measurable result; does not use AI professionally; produces the same generic content as every other contractor; cannot explain how their work turns into customers, revenue, and profit.



============================================================

CORE PRINCIPLE

============================================================



The Growth Marketing Manager can answer at any moment: how much we spent, how many qualified leads and new customers we got, what one customer cost, how much revenue they brought, which channels are profitable, what to scale, what to shut down — and how to get more customers without proportionally increasing the budget.



The job is to build a marketing system that over time becomes stronger, more recognizable, more organic, cheaper, and more profitable.



The ultimate result: the maximum number of profitable customers with the minimum necessary marketing budget.

title: Part-Time Instagram DM Outreach & Social Media Assistant
description:
I own a growing holistic health business called Restore Functional Wellness, where I help women—primarily busy moms—get to the root cause of issues like fatigue, hormonal imbalances, difficult periods, digestive issues, low energy, and feeling like they don't feel like themselves.



I'm looking for a reliable, proactive, part-time assistant to help me grow my Instagram presence and, most importantly, create more genuine conversations with potential clients.



This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys social media, talking to people, and building relationships online.



The #1 Priority: Instagram DM Outreach & Lead Generation



The most important part of this role is starting conversations with new Instagram followers and identifying potential clients who may be a good fit for my services.



Your job will be to:



Reach out to new Instagram followers consistently

Start genuine, personalized conversations

Look at someone's profile and find natural ways to start a conversation

Ask thoughtful questions to understand what they're struggling with

Build rapport and make people feel heard

Identify when someone may be a good fit for my 1:1 functional health programs

Continue conversations using scripts/frameworks I provide while keeping them natural and authentic

Follow up with people who have previously expressed interest

Recognize when someone is ready to learn more and hand the conversation over to me

Keep track of warm/qualified leads so no one gets lost in the DMs



You will NOT be responsible for closing sales. Your job is to start conversations, build relationships, identify qualified prospects, and pass them to me when it's appropriate for me to step in.



The goal is quality conversations spamming people with tons of generic DMs.



Social Media & Content Support



When DM outreach is taken care of, you'll also help with simple social media tasks such as:



Editing Instagram Reels/short-form videos

Adding captions/subtitles and hooks to videos

Creating Canva graphics and carousels

Repurposing existing content into new posts or Stories

Turning existing Reels into additional pieces of content

Helping organize content ideas

Scheduling/posting content when needed

Responding to simple comments or DMs that don't require my personal response

Engaging with relevant followers' content to help create more opportunities for genuine conversations

Helping maintain a simple lead/follow-up tracker

Reach out to influencers that may want to partner



I will provide the overall content direction, ideas, brand voice, and strategy but your input and fresh ideas are always appreciated and a plus. You do not need to be a high-level marketing strategist. 



Ideal Candidate



I'm looking for someone who is:



Friendly, warm, and naturally conversational

Very comfortable talking to strangers online

Excellent at written English

Emotionally intelligent and able to build rapport

Naturally curious and good at asking questions

Understands women and women's health

Able to recognize when someone is genuinely interested versus simply being polite

Organized and detail-oriented

Reliable and consistent

Self-motivated and able to work independently

Comfortable using Instagram

Familiar with Canva

Familiar with editing Reels/short-form video

Experienced with Instagram DM outreach, appointment setting, lead generation, sales, or social media management is a major plus

Interested in holistic health, nutrition, women's health, or wellness



Hours & Schedule



This is a very part-time position to start, approximately 10 hours per week.



The primary responsibility will be consistent DM outreach during the week, with the remaining time spent on content editing, engagement, and other social media tasks.



I'm looking for someone who can consistently dedicate time to this role Monday–Friday. Preferably early morning or later in the evening your time so messages make sense going out in EST time.



There is potential for the role and hours to grow over time if we are a great fit.



What Success Looks Like



The ideal process looks like:



New follower → Genuine conversation → Build rapport → Understand their problem → Identify if they're a fit → Warm/qualified lead → Hand off to me → Strategy call



I want you to help me create more opportunities for me to have conversations with women who genuinely need the type of help I provide.



Compensation



$3-5/hour depending on experience, with potential for increased hours and compensation as the role grows and we establish a good working relationship.



Application



Please answer the following questions in your application:



Tell me a little about yourself and your previous experience with social media, DM outreach, lead generation, appointment setting, or sales.

Have you ever done Instagram DM outreach before? If yes, tell me about your experience.

What experience do you have with Canva and editing Reels/short-form videos? Please include examples of your work if available.

What social media platforms and tools are you comfortable using?

How many hours per week are you available?

What hourly rate are you looking for?

Trial Assignment



Before hiring, I may ask shortlisted applicants to complete a small paid trial assignment.



This will involve demonstrating how you would:



Edit social media posts



I'm much more interested in how you communicate and think than in having a perfect resume.



Long-Term Opportunity



I'm looking for someone who can become a trusted part of my business as it grows.



If you're personable, reliable, proactive, and genuinely enjoy connecting with people, I'd love to hear from you!

description:

They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.

Competitive Advantage

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops)



People Contacts and Interactions

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes)

Role Requirements

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent)

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents)

Remote. Long-term growth role.



Everything Kids is a booking platform for parents to find and book kids activities in one place. We're early-stage, moving fast, and hiring a small number of confident, well-spoken people to be the first human touchpoint for businesses joining the platform.



The role:



You'll run Zoom onboarding calls with activity providers, walk them through setup, solve problems on the spot, and make sure they leave feeling looked after. You are the face of the brand during onboarding. This is not a background role.



Prove yourself and the role grows: relationship management, account ownership, and eventually leading the onboarding team as we scale.



Who this is for:



You're exceptionally well spoken. Fluent, natural, confident English, not textbook. You can read the room and make a business owner feel comfortable in the first 30 seconds of a call.



You're warm, patient, and genuinely enjoy helping people. You solve problems instead of freezing. You show up on time, every time. You want to grow into something bigger, not coast in an easy job.



Not for you if you're uncomfortable on camera or need every answer handed to you.



What you get:



Full training, real responsibility early, and pay that grows as you prove your value. We're a startup, so starting pay reflects that. What we offer is a genuine long-term seat in a business that takes care of the people who build it.



How to apply:



Send a 1 to 5 minute Loom. No Loom, no review.

LOOK AT THIS NOTION: 



Cover: who you are, your experience with customers or clients, why Everything Kids, and one time you helped someone work through a problem. Don't read from a script. Talk to us like it's a client call.



Shortlisted candidates get a Zoom interview. We're not rushing this. We want the right people.

title: Part-Time Video Editor & Storyteller — Premiere Pro
description:
We are looking for a long-term, part-time video editor who is as comfortable finding the story as handling the technical edit.



This is not a special-effects-heavy role. Strong pacing, editorial judgment, clean audio, organization, and reliable communication matter more than flashy transitions.



WHAT YOU WILL EDIT



• Social Reels, Shorts, and vertical videos with clean captions, music, audio cleanup, basic color correction, and reframing

• Interview-driven recruiting, testimonial, and brand-story videos built from multiple people and longer raw interviews

• Scripted 15- and 30-second TV commercials using supplied scripts, voiceovers, graphics, and clear creative direction

• Long-form YouTube explainer videos



WHAT WE PROVIDE



• Organized footage and creative direction

• Scripts, voiceovers, and core graphics for commercials

• Brand assets and reference examples

• A standardized Synology Drive folder and file-transfer workflow

• Clear feedback and priorities



REQUIRED



• Fluent written and spoken English

• Strong Adobe Premiere Pro experience; all edits must be completed in Premiere

• Portfolio examples showing interview or documentary storytelling—not only fast-cut social clips

• Ability to identify the strongest soundbites and build a clear, emotionally compelling narrative from multiple interviews

• Solid audio cleanup, music selection, captions, basic color correction, multicam syncing, and delivery for 9:16 and 16:9

• Reliable high-speed internet, enough local SSD storage for active projects, and a computer capable of editing 4K proxy workflows

• Excellent file organization, naming, versioning, and relinking

• Proactive communication



WORKFLOW REQUIREMENTS



Synology Drive is our source of truth for file transfer and project storage. You must follow our folder structure exactly. All footage, project files, graphics, captions, licensed music, and exports must remain inside the assigned ecosystem.



Active projects will be synced locally before editing. Premiere cache and temporary files stay local. Only one person owns a project file at a time, and Premiere must be closed before the updated project syncs back. Do not upload client footage to personal cloud storage, AI tools, or third-party transcription services without written approval.



ARRANGEMENT



• Long-term, part-time role

• Initially approximately 15–18 hours per week; workload may grow

• $1,000–$1,500 USD per month depending on experience, speed, and capacity

• Some scheduled communication overlap with U.S. Central Time

• Paid editing test for selected finalists, followed by a 30-day trial

• Two reasonable revision rounds per deliverable unless the brief materially changes



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the words STORY FIRST and include:



1. One interview, testimonial, documentary, recruiting, or brand-story example that shows narrative editing.

2. One Reel, Short, or vertical social example.

3. One long-form YouTube, explainer, commercial, or advertisement example.

4. A short video introduction in English.

5. Your computer specifications, internet download/upload speed, available local storage, and current Premiere Pro version.

6. A short explanation of how you decide what to remove when turning several interviews into one concise story.

7. Your typical turnaround time and weekly availability.



Please apply only if the portfolio links are work you personally edited and you can provide organized, relinkable Premiere project files—not only finished exports.

title: Part-Time Foreclosure Data & Skip Trace Specialist (Real Estate, US Central Hours)
description:
Nationwide Equity LLC is a Texas real estate investment company. We buy homes and land headed to foreclosure across Texas, and our data team is what gets us to the seller before anyone else. We are hiring a part-time data specialist, 30 hours a week, to join that team.



WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY

- Pull the daily foreclosure notices for our Texas counties and upload every notice PDF to the correct Google Drive folder

- Enter new leads into our master Google Sheet using our column format, with no blanks and no typos in addresses, names or loan amounts

- Manually skip trace every lead in SkipGenie, one by one, and log phone numbers,
s and mailing addresses into the sheet and our CRM (GoHighLevel)

- On deceased-owner leads, go further: search obituaries and public records to identify heirs and family, then skip trace them too

- Research the 50 highest-priority leads of the day and write a short profile on each: amount owed, property details, liens or judgments, deceased-owner flag, and a plain summary of pros and cons

- Check the oldest deed-of-trust leads against obituary sites and flag likely deceased owners

- Monitor tax-sale postings from the two Texas tax law firms, PBFCM and Linebarger (
), and log new listings. PBFCM releases in the first half of each month; Linebarger posts on a rolling basis, so check it daily.

- Download the day's SkipGenie sheets and back them up to Google Drive

- Run a daily quality check on the sheet: duplicates, missing phone numbers, wrong county, bad formatting



YOU ARE A FIT IF

- You have done manual skip tracing for a US real estate investor or wholesaler before. This matters more than anything else.

- You know Google Sheets well: filters, VLOOKUP or XLOOKUP, basic formulas, keeping a shared sheet clean

- You have used SkipGenie, or a similar tool like PropStream, TLO, or BeenVerified, and GoHighLevel or a similar CRM

- Your written English is clear enough to write a two-paragraph property summary a US buyer can act on

- You can read county records, deeds of trust and foreclosure notices, or you pick that up fast. Familiarity with Texas tax sale sites such as PBFCM and LGBS is a plus.

- You are detail-obsessed. One wrong digit in a phone number wastes a cold caller's afternoon.



SETUP WE REQUIRE

- Fiber or wired internet, 25 Mbps or faster (send a speed test screenshot with your application)

- A backup connection such as pocket wifi or a mobile hotspot

- A computer with at least 8 GB RAM that can hold 15+ browser tabs without lagging

- A quiet workspace and reliable power



SCHEDULE AND PAY

- 30 hours a week, Monday to Friday, 6 hours a day inside 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central Time

- Steady pay on the 15th and 30th of every month

- 13th-month bonus

- Review at 90 days, raises tied to accuracy and output

- Full training on our exact workflow, and a direct line to the owner. Small team, no middle management.



HOW TO APPLY

 
 with the subject line "Foreclosure Data Specialist - [Your Name]" and include:

1. A few sentences on your manual skip tracing experience and the tools you used

2. Your resume

3. A screenshot of an internet speed test taken today

4. Your expected monthly salary in USD



Shortlisted applicants get a paid test task: 10 real foreclosure leads to skip trace in SkipGenie and write up using our template. We pay $25 for the test whether or not you are hired. It takes about 3 hours.



Applications that do not follow the subject line format or skip the speed test will not be reviewed.

 MARKETING

title: Full-Time Video Editor – Direct Response / Meta Ads
description:
We’re looking for a full-time Video Editor to join our creative team and produce high-performing direct-response video ads for Meta/Facebook and Instagram.



This is not a traditional video editing position.



We are not looking for someone who simply knows Premiere Pro, CapCut, or After Effects.



We are looking for an editor who understands advertising psychology, viewer retention, pacing, visual storytelling, and performance creative.



You need to understand how to take a script and turn it into an advertisement that keeps someone watching long enough to eventually purchase.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



You will receive scripts, hooks, creative direction, product assets, customer research, and reference advertisements.



Your job is to turn those materials into finished direct-response advertisements.



You should understand:



What type of footage belongs in each section of a script

How visuals should reinforce what the voiceover is saying

When a visual should demonstrate the problem

When a visual should demonstrate the desired outcome

When product footage should appear

When customer-style footage is more effective than polished brand footage

How long each clip should remain on screen

When visual changes are necessary to prevent attention from dropping

How to create pattern interrupts without making the advertisement chaotic

How to visually build curiosity

How to maintain momentum through longer advertisements

How to use subtitles, text overlays, screenshots, reviews, graphics, zooms, crops, transitions, and sound effects appropriately

How to make a 2–3 minute advertisement continue feeling engaging throughout



We do not want editors who simply place random stock footage over a voiceover.



Every clip should have a reason for being there.



This Is Performance Creative



Our advertisements are not created randomly.



Each script and creative batch is developed around specific variables such as:



Customer avatar

Market awareness level

Market sophistication

Specific customer problem

Core desire

Advertising angle

Hook

Unique mechanism

Customer objections

Proof

Emotional journey

Creative format

Specific variable being tested



As the editor, you need to understand the strategy behind the script so the visuals support it properly.



For example, if a section of the script is designed to create skepticism, curiosity, authority, urgency, or emotional tension, the footage and editing should reinforce that purpose.



You should be able to read a script and understand:



What is the viewer supposed to feel here?



What does the viewer need to see here?



What visual would make this claim more believable?



Where is attention likely to drop?



Do we need a visual change here?



Is this clip helping the story or simply filling space?



That judgment is extremely important to us.



Hooks Are Extremely Important



The first few seconds of an advertisement can determine whether the rest of the video ever gets watched.



You will regularly receive one main script with multiple hook variations.



You should understand how to make each hook feel visually distinct and compelling while transitioning naturally into the same main body of the advertisement.



We expect strong judgment around:



Opening visuals

First-frame selection

Pattern interrupts

Text placement

Curiosity

Pacing

Visual juxtaposition

Product reveals

Problem demonstrations

Emotional reactions

Authority

Results-focused openings



A weak opening can ruin an otherwise strong advertisement.



PERFORMANCE EXPERIENCE IS STRONGLY PREFERRED



We are primarily interested in editors who have previous experience producing direct-response advertisements that actually generated sales.



If you have worked on ads that scaled significantly, we want to see them.



Preference will be given to applicants who can show advertisements they personally edited that achieved:



$10,000+ in ad spend while maintaining a 2.0+ ROAS.



If you have this experience, include proof showing:



The advertisement

Spend

ROAS

Revenue or purchase performance

Relevant date range



You should also clearly explain what part of the creative you were responsible for.



If you have edited high-spend winning ads, that carries significantly more weight with us than a traditional editing reel.



What You'll Be Editing



The majority of the work will consist of direct-response social advertisements, including formats such as:



UGC-style ads

Founder/customer stories

Testimonial ads

Problem/solution ads

Advertorial-style videos

Authority-based ads

Demonstration ads

Comparison ads

Story-driven advertisements

Native-style social ads

Longer 2–3 minute direct-response ads

Shorter hook variations

Iterations of existing winning advertisements



Not every advertisement needs to look highly produced.



Sometimes the strongest creative may intentionally look like an organic phone video, customer testimonial, news clip, podcast, interview, slideshow, or social post.



You need to understand the difference between good editing and over-editing.



Finding Footage



You will not always be given every clip needed for an advertisement.



You should be comfortable sourcing or creating appropriate supporting visuals using:



Our branded footage

Stock footage

Customer-style footage

AI-generated images

AI-generated video

Screenshots

Reviews

Social media-style content

Product footage

Graphics

Other relevant assets



You should be resourceful.



If the script talks about something specific, we expect you to figure out what the viewer should see during that section rather than requiring us to select every individual clip for you.



AI Tools



Experience with AI creative tools is highly valuable.



This may include:



ChatGPT

Sora

Higgsfield

Veo

Kling

Runway

Midjourney

Gemini / Nano Banana

ElevenLabs

Other AI image/video generation tools



You do not need to use every tool listed.



We care about your ability to use modern tools to make better advertisements and solve creative problems quickly.



Editing Software



You may use whichever professional editing software allows you to produce the best work, including:



Adobe Premiere Pro

After Effects

DaVinci Resolve

CapCut

Final Cut Pro

Other professional editing software



The software itself does not matter.



The quality of the final advertisement does.



What We're Looking For



You should have:



Strong direct-response video editing experience

Strong understanding of Meta/Facebook advertising

Excellent sense of pacing

Strong visual storytelling instincts

Understanding of viewer retention

Ability to identify strong supporting footage

Strong judgment around clip duration

Understanding of hooks and pattern interrupts

Strong subtitle and text-overlay design

Good sound design

Strong attention to detail

Ability to follow scripts accurately

Ability to follow creative briefs

Ability to replicate the general editing principles of reference advertisements without simply copying them

Ability to work independently

Fast turnaround times

Reliable communication

Ability to take feedback and implement it correctly

Ability to produce a consistent volume of advertisements every week



Experience editing for DTC/e-commerce brands spending significant amounts on Meta advertising is strongly preferred.



What We Do NOT Want



Please do not apply if your editing process is essentially:



Add voiceover

Add random stock clips

Add captions

Add music

Export



That is not what we consider direct-response editing.



We need someone who thinks about the advertisement scene by scene and understands why each visual is being shown.



Attention to Detail Matters



Before delivering an advertisement, you should be checking:



Spelling

Subtitle accuracy

Audio levels

Music levels

Voice clarity

Clip resolution

Aspect ratio

Visual consistency

Awkward cuts

Repetitive footage

Unnecessary dead time

Branding

Product accuracy

Transitions

Overall pacing



The video should arrive ready to run as a paid advertisement.



Position



Full-Time / Long-Term



We are looking for someone who can become a long-term member of our creative team.



We continuously produce and test new advertisements, hooks, creative formats, stories, concepts, and iterations.



Editors who demonstrate strong creative judgment and consistently contribute to winning advertisements will have significant room to grow with us.



How To Apply



Your application should include:



Your video editing portfolio

At least 3 direct-response advertisements you personally edited

Your best-performing advertisements, if available

Any proof of advertisements you edited reaching $10,000+ in spend at a 2.0+ ROAS

A brief explanation of what YOU were responsible for on those advertisements

The editing software you use

The AI tools you currently use

Your experience editing Meta/Facebook advertisements



Please prioritize actual advertisements over cinematic reels, music videos, or traditional corporate editing examples.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid trial advertisement.



The trial will be used to evaluate your editing quality, visual judgment, pacing, ability to choose appropriate footage, ability to follow direction, attention to detail, and turnaround time.

title: Static Ad Designer - Canva + AI (DTC Apparel)
description:

What we need:



Real experience making static ads for ecom or DTC brands. Show us.

Fast in Canva. Photoshop or Figma is a plus, not required.

Already using AI tools daily

Understands hierarchy and text that's readable on a phone

Comfortable working out of ClickUp

Some overlap with US hours



The test: small paid test. A folder of assets and light direction, on purpose. We want to see how many usable concepts you come back with, and whether you ask one smart question instead of waiting to be told what to do.

title: Executive Assistant to the Founder
description:
Kranay Academy is seeking a reliable, professional, and highly organized Executive Assistant to the Founder to provide direct administrative and meeting support to the Founder.



A major responsibility of this position will be attending approved meetings on the Founder’s behalf, representing Kranay Academy professionally, taking detailed notes, gathering important information, and ensuring the Founder stays informed of decisions, opportunities, and next steps.



This is ideal for someone who is confident communicating with professionals, comfortable representing a growing organization, and able to work independently.



Responsibilities



* Attend designated virtual meetings on behalf of the Founder.

* Introduce yourself professionally as a representative of Kranay Academy.

* Take detailed meeting notes and provide concise post-meeting summaries.

* Document deadlines, action items, opportunities, and follow-up requirements.

* Ask pre-approved questions during meetings.

* Collect relevant contact information and resources.

* Communicate when an issue requires the Founder’s direct input or approval.

* Assist with scheduling, confirmations, and meeting reminders.

* Follow up with contacts after meetings when instructed.

* Maintain confidentiality regarding Kranay Academy business and internal discussions.

* Keep the Founder informed of upcoming meetings and important deadlines.



Authority & Boundaries



The Executive Assistant may represent Kranay Academy during approved meetings but may not enter into agreements, approve partnerships, negotiate or commit to financial terms, sign contracts, or make major business decisions on behalf of Kranay Academy without the Founder’s authorization.



When a decision requires approval, the assistant should communicate:



“I’ll bring this information back to Kranay for review and follow up with you.”



Ideal Candidate



We’re looking for someone who is dependable, punctual, articulate, detail-oriented, comfortable speaking in meetings, able to take excellent notes, and capable of representing the Kranay Academy brand professionally.



Experience as an executive assistant, administrative assistant, virtual assistant, project coordinator, student leader, or similar role is preferred but not necessarily required.

title: Full-Stack Developer  (Platforms, Web and LMS)
description:
Company: EDUK8U Group

Engagement: Full-time, Contract

Schedule: Monday to Friday, Manila / Malaysian business hours (no graveyard shift)



About the Role

We have several platforms in build and we need developers to help finish them, while keeping our existing websites and learning management systems running well.



This is a genuinely full-stack role across two areas of work: our internal platforms, built in TypeScript, and our public web and LMS estate, built in PHP. You will move between them.



Current platform projects include a multi-entity document and records management system, an internal audit and self-assurance platform, a recognition-of-prior-learning engine, and a workforce management system. These are compliance systems. They hold student, participant and worker records, and they are examined by regulators. Correctness matters more than speed, and you will be expected to say so when the two conflict.



Key responsibilities

Platform development:  TypeScript

• Build and complete features in existing TypeScript applications: data models, server-side logic, and the interfaces people actually use.

• Design and evolve PostgreSQL schemas, and write the migrations that change them safely against live data.

• Write automated tests for the behaviour that matters, including access-control and data-integrity rules.

• Work in containerised environments and keep them reproducible.

• Integrate with third-party systems over REST APIs.



Web and learning management:  PHP

• Build and maintain WordPress sites: custom themes, plugins and integrations.

• Turn designs and wireframes into working, accessible front-ends.

• Develop, customise and maintain Moodle plugins, themes and core functionality.

• Integrate Moodle with other systems via REST and SOAP web services.

• Apply updates and patches, maintain backups, and test that restores actually work.

• Improve site performance, technical SEO and Core Web Vitals.



Across the role

• Diagnose and resolve performance, functional and usability problems.

• Review other people's code, and have your own reviewed.

• Contribute to planning, estimation and documentation.

• Provide technical guidance to non-technical colleagues, and write the documentation they need



Essential requirements

• Three or more years building and maintaining production web applications.

• Strong JavaScript / TypeScript and strong PHP. This role needs both.

• Production experience with React. We use Next.js; adjacent framework experience is acceptable if you are willing to learn it properly.

• Production experience with WordPress and Moodle.

• Solid SQL and relational data modelling, across PostgreSQL and MySQL.

• Comfortable with Git and Docker.

• Clear written and spoken English. You will be documenting decisions, not only code.

• Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent demonstrable experience.



Desirable

• Prisma, NestJS, Node.js backend services, Python / FastAPI.

• Experience with regulated or audited systems - education, healthcare, finance.

• Identity and access management (OIDC, Keycloak) and object storage (S3, MinIO).

• eSkilled, Totara or another Moodle distribution.

• Accessibility standards (WCAG 2.2) and technical SEO.

• Experience with an Australian RTO, a UK awarding body, or another regulated training environment.



To Apply

1. Your CV.

2. A link to code you have written, GitHub, GitLab or similar or to sites and Moodle work you have built.

3. A short note about yourself would be nice.

title: Real Estate Photo Editor
description:
Full-Time In-House Real Estate Photo Editor — Individual Applicants Only



Boardwalk Media Group is an established real estate media company based in Orange County, California. We photograph approximately 60 properties per month and are looking for one talented photo editor to join our team in a stable, long-term, full-time position.



This is not a freelance overflow project. We want to build a lasting working relationship with one editor who will learn our style, maintain consistency across every property, and take pride in the final product.



Important: No Agencies or Teams



This position is exclusively for an individual editor.



We are not accepting applications from:



* Editing agencies

* Editing teams

* Account managers or brokers

* Applicants who plan to subcontract or delegate the work

* Applicants sharing an OnlineJobs.ph profile with another person



The person we interview must be the person who personally completes every part of our editing work. Our files may not be downloaded, shared, or sent to anyone else for any reason.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



* Editing bracketed and flambient real estate photographs

* Blending ambient and flash exposures naturally

* Performing clean, realistic window pulls

* Correcting white balance and mixed-light color casts

* Maintaining consistent wall and room colors throughout an entire property

* Straightening vertical and horizontal lines

* Producing natural, accurate, high-end results without an artificial HDR appearance

* Removing minor distracting objects when requested

* Editing exterior, aerial, twilight, and detail photographs

* Creating virtual twilight images when requested

* Reviewing completed images for quality and consistency

* Following Boardwalk Media Group’s editing standards

* Completing revisions promptly when necessary

* Organizing, exporting, and uploading completed files

* Communicating clearly with our project coordinator and photographers

* Meeting daily turnaround deadlines



As you grow into the position, additional responsibilities may include final quality control and preparing completed jobs for client delivery.



Required Skills



You should have:



* Strong Adobe Photoshop skills

* Experience with layers, masks, actions, blending modes, and manual selections

* Experience editing real estate, architectural, interior, or similarly complex photographs

* A strong understanding of color correction and white balance

* The ability to make multiple rooms within the same property look consistent

* Careful attention to small details

* Reliable internet and a computer capable of processing large RAW and Photoshop files

* Good written English

* The ability to accept feedback and reproduce a specific editing style consistently

* The ability to work independently without passing assignments to anyone else



Experience with Adobe Lightroom, Camera Raw, Dropbox, Google Drive, and real estate delivery platforms is helpful.



What We Value



We are not simply looking for the fastest editor. We care about:



* Consistency from one image to the next

* Accurate colors

* Natural-looking windows

* Clean flash blending

* Reliability

* Honest communication

* Coachability

* Attention to detail

* A genuine interest in becoming part of one company long-term



We will provide examples, feedback, and training on our preferred style. However, applicants should already have solid Photoshop fundamentals.



Schedule and Availability



This is intended to become a full-time, long-term position. You must be consistently available during the agreed-upon working schedule and able to meet next-business-day delivery deadlines.



You may have personal projects or clients outside your scheduled working hours, but you may not perform other client work during the hours paid for by Boardwalk Media Group.



You may never delegate Boardwalk work to another editor—even if you are sick, unavailable, or experiencing a heavy workload. If a problem occurs, you must communicate directly with us so we can make other arrangements.



Hiring Process



Shortlisted applicants will complete the following process:



1. A live video interview

2. A live Photoshop screen-sharing exercise

3. A small paid take-home editing test

4. A paid probationary period with gradually increasing volume



During the interview, you will be asked to share your screen, open Photoshop, and explain your editing process. You may also be asked to show layered PSD files from previous work when permitted by your former clients.



The quality of your live editing exercise must be consistent with the quality of your portfolio and take-home test.



How to Apply



Please begin your application with the exact words:



I AM THE EDITOR



Then answer every question below:



1. How many years have you personally edited photographs?

2. What types of photography have you edited?

3. How much real estate or architectural editing experience do you have?

4. How many real estate images can you personally edit in one working day?

5. How many clients are you currently editing for?

6. Does anyone ever assist you with downloading, blending, masking, retouching, quality control, exporting, or uploading your work?

7. If you become sick or overloaded, what do you normally do with your clients’ assignments?

8. Are you personally the owner and only user of your OnlineJobs.ph profile?

9. Are you comfortable completing a live Photoshop editing exercise while sharing your screen?

10. Are you looking for freelance projects or a stable full-time position with one company?

11. What computer, monitor, internet connection, and version of Photoshop do you use?

12. What is your expected monthly salary for a full-time position?

13. What working hours are you available in Philippine time?

14. When would you be available to begin?



Please also include:



* A link to your real estate or architectural photography portfolio

* Three complete property examples, if available—not only your best individual images

* Before-and-after examples

* A screenshot of one of your layered Photoshop files

* A short video introducing yourself and explaining your normal editing process



Please do not send work belonging to another editor, employer, or team and represent it as your own.



Do not complete an unpaid sample edit. Applicants selected for the take-home test will receive test files directly from us and will be paid for completing the assignment.



Confidentiality and Personal-Work Requirement



The selected applicant will sign an agreement requiring that:



* All editing is personally performed by the hired editor

* No work is subcontracted or delegated

* Company and client files remain confidential

* Files are never shared with another person

* Company images are deleted from personal storage according to our file-retention policy

* Client names, property information, workflows, presets, and pricing remain confidential



Unauthorized sharing or subcontracting of our work will result in immediate termination.



If you are a skilled individual editor who wants consistent work, clear expectations, constructive feedback, and the opportunity to grow with an established company, we would like to hear from you.
